jobs.title: Senior Director - Food Safety Marketing
jobs.excerpt: It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing!
jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing!

Neogen is seeking a strategic, results-drivenSenior Director, Food Safety Marketingto lead commercial marketing for our Food Safety business across the United States, Canada, and Australia/New Zealand. This senior leadership role will translate global portfolio and product strategies into regional go-to-market plans, differentiated customer value propositions, and integrated demand-generation programs that drive measurable growth.

You will lead a multidisciplinary marketing team and collaborate closely with Sales, Product Management, Finance, Regulatory, Operations, and Global Marketing to advance food safety solutions that support customers throughout the global supply chain.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute regional commercial marketing and go-to-market strategies for Neogen's food safety diagnostics portfolio across the United States, Canada, and Australia/New Zealand.
  • Translate global portfolio, product, and brand strategies into locally relevant plans informed by customer needs, market dynamics, competitive intelligence, and growth opportunities.
  • Lead market segmentation, customer research, competitive analysis, and TAM/SAM/SOM assessments to establish strategic priorities and guide investment decisions.
  • Define customer value propositions, positioning, and messaging, and oversee integrated campaigns that build awareness, generate qualified demand, strengthen pipeline, and support revenue growth.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to improve commercial effectiveness through customer-focused content, sales enablement tools, training, activation plans, and customer programs.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 13 professionals while managing marketing budgets, performance metrics, technology platforms, and resources to maximize business impact.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, life sciences, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Significant progressive marketing leadership experience in commercial marketing, portfolio marketing, demand generation, go-to-market strategy, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated success translating business, product, or portfolio strategy into measurable regional marketing plans and commercial outcomes.
  • Experience leading and developing multidisciplinary teams within a complex, matrixed, and cross-functional organization.
  • Strong expertise in market segmentation, customer insights, competitive analysis, opportunity sizing, integrated campaign development, and marketing performance measurement.
  • Experience using CRM, marketing automation, and sales enablement platforms; familiarity with Salesforce, Eloqua, Seismic, or comparable tools is preferred. Ability to travel as business needs require.

Preferred qualifications include an advanced degree and experience in food safety, food and beverage, diagnostics, life sciences, laboratory products, or another regulated business-to-business environment. Experience supporting multi-country commercial organizations, launching products, managing complex portfolios, and working with direct-sales and distributor channels is also valued.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to shape commercial marketing strategy for a business advancing food safety and quality across global supply chains.
  • A collaborative, cross-functional environment with meaningful partnership across regional and global teams.
  • The ability to lead, mentor, and develop a talented multidisciplinary marketing organization.
  • Meaningful work connecting innovative food safety solutions with customers' operational, quality, and compliance needs.
  • Opportunities for professional growth, leadership development, and strategic business impact.
  • A standard benefits package.

Neogen is committed to building an inclusive workplace where qualified individuals are considered for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics. If you are a strategic marketing leader with the commercial insight, collaborative leadership style, and customer focus to help drive growth in food safety, we'd love to hear from you. Join our team and help deliver solutions that support safer food worldwide.

Come Be Part Of A Mission that Matters!

From inside the farm gate to our dinner plates, Neogen protects the world’s food supply. Through a variety of animal healthcare products, to food safety solutions for dangerous bacteria, allergens, toxins, drug residues and much more, Neogen is there — and you can be too.

jobs.excerpt: USFS is an ISO 9001 management consulting firm with headquarters in the National Capital Region and offices and staff in 12 US states.
jobs.description:
USFS is an ISO 9001 management consulting firm with headquarters in the National Capital Region and offices and staff in 12 US states. USFS staff average 10+ years of professional experience, over 80 percent of our staff have bachelor’s degrees, and over half have advanced degrees in business and technology. USFS was founded in 2010 and provides financial management, acquisition management, program management, and data analytic support services to federal and state governments.

Acquisition Liaison

Federal Transit Administration Support

Location: Washington, DC / Primarily Remote

Company: US Federal Solutions

Why Join US Federal Solutions

US Federal Solutions (USFS) is a management consulting firm supporting federal agencies with acquisition management, financial management, program management, and data analytics services. We are seeking an experienced Acquisition Liaison to support the Federal Transit Administration’s Office of Acquisition Management.

This role is well suited for a federal acquisition professional who can serve as a trusted bridge between program offices and contracting personnel. The successful candidate will help customers develop complete acquisition packages, strengthen requirements documentation, track procurement actions, support acquisition planning, and coordinate activities throughout the acquisition lifecycle.

What You Will Do

As an Acquisition Liaison, you will provide federal acquisition subject matter expertise to program and technical staff supporting service and commercial requirements. You will work closely with Contracting Officers, Contract Specialists, Contracting Officer’s Representatives, program offices, and technical subject matter experts to help move procurement actions from initial planning through award, administration, and closeout.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide federal acquisition support to program and technical offices throughout the full acquisition lifecycle.
  • Serve as a liaison between program personnel and acquisition professionals to help ensure procurement requirements are properly developed, documented, coordinated, and submitted.
  • Assist program offices with preparing purchase request packages for entry into contracting systems.
  • Review purchase request packages to verify that required supporting documentation is complete and appropriate for the intended procurement action.
  • Review acquisition packages prior to submission to the Acquisition Office for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable acquisition requirements.
  • Assist with reviewing existing contracts for compliance with applicable laws, regulations, policies, and contractual requirements.
  • Work closely with program professionals and technical subject matter experts to develop acquisition documentation and support acquisition planning activities.
  • Assist with development of acquisition plans, Statements of Work, Statements of Objectives, Performance Work Statements, functional requirements, specifications, market research reports, determinations and findings, exception to fair opportunity documentation, and justifications and approvals.
  • Assist with development of Independent Government Cost Estimates and market research used to support IGCEs or business case models.
  • Support cost and price analysis activities as required.
  • Apply knowledge of various contract types, including Firm-Fixed Price, Cost-Reimbursable, Labor Hour, and Time and Materials.
  • Support acquisition and contract administration activities involving IDIQ contracts, task orders, delivery orders, Blanket Purchase Agreements, call orders, purchase orders, and Inter/Intra-Agency Agreements.
  • Assist with recurring contract administration functions in support of both program and acquisition offices.
  • Participate in meetings involving program offices and acquisition personnel and document relevant discussions, decisions, action items, and acquisition requirements.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders at multiple organizational levels using written, verbal, and electronic communication methods.
  • Analyze complex acquisition issues and support their resolution through coordination with appropriate Government stakeholders.
  • Validate acquisition and contract data and assist with tasks necessary to support solicitation, award, administration, and modification of contractual actions.
  • Assist with preparing contract actions for closeout and coordinating information for submission to Government closeout teams.
  • Maintain current electronic tracking spreadsheets showing the status of supported contract and acquisition actions.
  • Track contract funding levels and coordinate with Contracting Officer’s Representatives and Contract Specialists to communicate funding status and related information.
  • Conduct or support market research and analysis relevant to planned acquisitions.
  • Assist with development of source selection evaluation criteria when required.
  • Coordinate with technical experts and contracting personnel to ensure project milestones are appropriately reflected in contractual documents and project plans.
  • Assist with acquisition-related reporting requirements and other assigned procurement support activities.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Arts or Bachelor of Science degree, or higher degree.
  • At least 5 years of relevant federal acquisition or contracting experience.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and hands-on experience applying the Federal Acquisition Regulation to federal procurements.
  • Federal acquisition knowledge and experience comparable to FAC-C Level II competencies.
  • Experience supporting acquisition actions from planning through award, administration, and closeout.
  • Experience preparing and reviewing federal acquisition packages and purchase request documentation.
  • Experience developing or supporting Statements of Work, Statements of Objectives, Performance Work Statements, acquisition plans, market research documentation, and related procurement materials.
  • Experience with multiple contract types, including Firm-Fixed Price, Cost-Reimbursable, Labor Hour, and Time and Materials.
  • Experience supporting IDIQ contracts, BPAs, task orders, delivery orders, call orders, and purchase orders.
  • Experience applying acquisition procedures associated with FAR Parts 12, 13, 15, 37, and 43, as well as contract closeout requirements.
  • Experience conducting or supporting federal market research.
  • Understanding of cost and price analysis concepts.
  • Ability to independently analyze acquisition assignments and provide meaningful feedback and recommendations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Outlook, Excel, and Teams.
  • Experience using Google Workspace applications such as Calendar, Sheets, Chat, Gmail, Docs, Slides, Drive, and Meet.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using PRISM or another federal contract writing system.
  • Experience using General Services Administration Market Research as a Service or other federal market research tools.
  • Experience with Federal Supply Schedule acquisitions.
  • Experience using SharePoint.
  • Experience working with Customer Relationship Management systems.
  • Experience supporting the Department of Transportation, Federal Transit Administration, or another federal civilian agency.

Benefits

  • Employer-provided paid Medical / Dental / Vision insurance.
  • Employer matching 401K plan.
  • PTO
  • 11 Federal Holidays
  • Additionally voluntary benefits to include Short / Long Term Disability, Term Life, and AD&D Insurance.

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager
jobs.excerpt: About AMZ Advisers:AMZ Advisers is a digital media marketing agency focused on developing and implementing strategic marketing plans for the global Amazon marketplaces.
jobs.description:
About AMZ Advisers:

AMZ Advisers is a digital media marketing agency focused on developing and implementing strategic marketing plans for the global Amazon marketplaces. Working at AMZ Advisers allows you to apply your skills, expertise, and passions to directly impact the lives and business of other people and entrepreneurs. Our staff solves dynamic, quickly evolving problems with our Founders, in-house team, and network of partnered tech companies. Our Account Management team is organized into pods, consisting of Senior Account Managers (SAMs), Junior Account Managers (JAMs), and Apprentices and Interns. This structure fosters knowledge sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning.

About the Role:

We’re seeking a driven and self-motivated problem solver with exceptionally strong communication skills and the ability to build long-lasting client relationships. We offer a fast-paced, challenging, and creative environment where you will be provided the opportunity to sharpen your analytical, communication, and strategic development skills. You will be offered resources and growth opportunities to learn more about online marketing to enhance your professional career.

The ideal candidate is an independent thinker who can confidently manage multiple Amazon Seller and Vendor Central accounts while leading client relationships with a high level of ownership and professionalism. As an Account Manager, this person will be responsible for building strong strategies, guiding clients through clear and proactive communication, and ensuring their portfolio is progressing toward the right goals. They should be comfortable working closely with their Brand Strategist and cross-functional pod members, while taking the lead on day-to-day account direction, strategic execution, and client success.

This is a fully remote position. If hired, you will join a company with an amazing and talented staff.

What You’ll Do:

General Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of clients, gradually growing to approximately 10 accounts, while maintaining a high retention rate.

  • Build strong, long-term client relationships through clear, proactive, and confident communication.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring they feel informed, supported, and strategically guided at all times.

  • Set clear expectations with clients and manage those expectations throughout the lifecycle of the account.

  • Conduct regular strategy calls with clients to review performance, communicate progress, explain results, and align on upcoming priorities.

  • Build, track, and monitor KPIs for all accounts under personal portfolio management.

  • Conduct audits of client accounts and use data to identify opportunities, blockers, and areas for improvement.

  • Develop strategic growth plans tailored to each client’s goals, lifecycle stage, and account conditions.

  • Proactively identify and recommend strategies to improve account performance across sales, traffic, conversion, profitability, inventory, content, and advertising.

  • Report on account progress, key action items, and next-step priorities in a clear and organized way.

  • Plan, coordinate, and oversee promotions, launches, and marketplace initiatives in alignment with the broader account strategy.

  • Coordinate the resolution of account issues by working with internal teams and escalating through the appropriate channels when needed.

  • Use internal and external software tools to analyze account performance and support strategy development.

  • Work cross-functionally with Ads, Specialists, Content, Onboarding, and Strategists to ensure strategies are executed effectively and aligned to client goals.

  • Attend Account Management meetings, trainings, and ongoing development sessions on a weekly or bi-weekly basis.

  • Participate in daily stand-up meetings to raise blockers, align on priorities, and maintain execution momentum.

Strategy Ownership

  • Conduct account audits and turn findings into clear, actionable strategies.

  • Build client strategies based on data, marketplace trends, account health, business goals, and realistic opportunity areas.

  • Understand how to prioritize focus SKUs based on performance, profitability, traffic potential, conversion, and growth opportunity.

  • Adjust strategies as needed based on data, seasonality, competitive changes, and evolving client objectives.

  • Ensure every recommendation has a clear reason behind it and can be explained confidently to the client.

Advertising & Amazon Knowledge

  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of Amazon as a whole, including traffic, conversion, listing quality, profitability, inventory, account health, and category dynamics.

  • Understand Amazon advertising strategy well enough to contribute meaningfully to planning, decision-making, and client communication.

  • Be able to interpret ad performance, identify high-level opportunities or inefficiencies, and connect advertising decisions to the broader business strategy.

  • Work closely with the Ads team and Strategist to align ad direction with overall account goals, whether those goals are growth, profitability, ranking, launch velocity, or market share.

  • Communicate ad strategy and performance to clients in a way that is clear, accurate, and tied back to business outcomes.

Pod Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Brand Strategist within the pod to refine account strategy, validate recommendations, and escalate higher-level concerns when needed.

  • Collaborate with pod members regularly through meetings, brainstorming sessions, and strategy discussions.

  • Keep internal teams aligned by ensuring priorities, deadlines, and strategic direction are clearly communicated.

  • Support a collaborative pod environment where ideas, blockers, and opportunities are surfaced early.

Client Communication & Relationship Management

  • Lead proactive, transparent, and solutions-oriented communication with clients.

  • Build trust by not only reporting on what happened, but clearly explaining why it happened, what it means, and what should happen next.

  • Be able to handle difficult conversations, performance concerns, and conflicting client goals with confidence and professionalism.

  • Guide clients toward the right strategic decisions, even when those decisions require pushback or expectation resetting.

  • Ensure clients feel that their accounts are being actively managed, thoughtfully reviewed, and strategically guided.

  • Encourage client feedback and use it to strengthen the relationship and improve the service experience.

  • Help identify retention risks early and take action before they become larger client issues.

Check-ins, Accountability & Growth Opportunities

  • Regularly review account progress and raise issues, risks, or missed opportunities early.

  • Stay proactive in identifying upsell and expansion opportunities where appropriate.

  • Take ownership of account outcomes and maintain strong follow-through on action items.

  • Continuously look for ways to improve account performance, internal processes, and the client experience.

How We’ll Measure Success

  • Retention Rate - Percentage of retained clients from month to month.

  • Blocker/ Conflict Resolution Time - Monitor and decrease the time taken to resolve client issues or blockers.

  • Client Communication - Assess the quality and frequency of client interactions for improved satisfactions.

  • Strategy Effectiveness - Evaluate the success of client strategies considering feedback and performance metrics.

Qualifications:

  • BA in Marketing, Business Development, Management, or other related studies.

  • 2+ years with client account management.

  • 2+ years digital marketing or eCommerce experience.

  • 1+ year experience with Amazon Seller and or Vendor Central.

  • Ability to build and maintain client relations.

  • Active listening and the ability to understand client needs.

  • Proactive, go-getter mindset who functions well within a team setting but can work independently.

  • Strong ability to think outside the box, willingness to test new ideas, and develop and implement growth strategies.

  • Strong time management skills and the ability to multitask.

  • Ability and desire to learn new skills.

Technologies We Use:

  • G-Suite: Gmail, Google Drive, Google Meets, Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides

  • Microsoft: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

  • ClickUp

  • Nordpass

  • Slack

  • Sellerboard

  • Data Dive

  • Zoom

To Apply Please Include the Following:

  • Your CV/ Resume in English (ONLY English Resumes will be considered)

  • Two references who can attest to your competency in this line of work

  • Answers to the following questions:

    • Describe your experience with Amazon Seller or Vendor Central.

    • Do you have any experience leading a team?

    • Why are you interested in a new job/ this position?

    • Describe a situation in your career in which you were faced with a challenging problem and how you overcame it.

Qualified Experience / Skills / Training:

Experience:

Preferred Technical Experience:

Professional Skills:

jobs.description:
About Backblaze

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we're helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $125M in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud, managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

Role Overview

Backblaze is seeking a Director, Enterprise Systems & Architecture to own the technical vision, architecture, and operations of the company’s enterprise systems and emerging AI use cases. This is a senior leadership role with organization-wide scope — spanning commercial and financial systems, GTM technology, data architecture, and the deployment and governance of AI agents across the business.

This leader will serve as the company’s architectural authority for enterprise platforms including Salesforce, NetSuite, Zendesk, Snowflake, and their surrounding integration ecosystem. Equally important, they will support the governed infrastructure layer that enables AI agents, automated workflows, and headless capabilities to operate safely at a public company. They will partner closely with the CRO, CISO, and CFO organizations to enable velocity while ensuring systems are compliant, auditable, and built to scale.

The ideal candidate combines deep enterprise architecture expertise with hands-on platform engineering instincts and practical experience deploying AI agents in production environments. This is a build-and-operate role, not a purely advisory one. Job Description

International fast-growing IT company StellarTech is looking for a Backend Lead - Hands-on Tech Lead / Player-Coach. StellarTech is a fast-growing international product technology company looking for a Backend Lead to own the technical direction, engineering quality, and operational health of our backend ecosystem.

This is a hands-on player-coach role combining backend architecture, technical execution, engineering leadership, and people management. You will lead a small team of experienced backend engineers while remaining actively involved in technical design, critical implementation, code reviews, production troubleshooting, and technical research.

You will work in a cross-functional product environment and take responsibility not only for backend implementation, but also for product delivery, reliability, and long-term technical sustainability.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the backend technical direction and architecture across our product ecosystem.
  • Translate product initiatives into technical solutions: clarify requirements, assess feasibility, identify risks, prepare technical designs, and decompose work for the team.

  • Design scalable, reliable, and maintainable backend solutions aligned with product and business needs.
  • Build and evolve shared backend capabilities, reusable components, and platform solutions that allow the company to launch and scale multiple products efficiently.
  • Define service boundaries, data ownership, APIs, integration patterns, and communication between systems.

Make and defend pragmatic architectural decisions, including:

  • Monolith vs services.
  • Synchronous vs asynchronous communication.
  • SQL vs NoSQL.
  • Build vs buy.
  • Short-term delivery vs long-term technical sustainability.
  • Remain hands-on with Python and FastAPI through critical implementation, prototyping, debugging, code reviews, and technical research.

  • Improve engineering practices covering refinement, technical design, Definition of Done, testing, code review, CI/CD, release safety, documentation, and technical debt management.
  • Introduce and scale AI-assisted and agentic development workflows across the backend team.
  • Evaluate how AI tools affect delivery speed, engineering quality, maintainability, and team productivity.
  • Lead and develop backend engineers through delegation, regular feedback, one-to-one meetings, mentoring, performance reviews, and career development.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Platform, DevOps, QA, Frontend, and other engineering leads.
    Take responsibility for product and business outcomes, not only technical implementation.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 7+ years of backend engineering experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in a Tech Lead, Team Lead, or Backend Lead role.
  • Strong and recent hands-on production experience with Python, ideally 5+ years.
  • Strong knowledge of modern Python backend development practices.
  • Production experience with FastAPI or similar Python web frameworks.
  • Experience with asynchronous programming, testing, typing, profiling, debugging, and maintainable application design.
  • Proven experience owning backend architecture end to end, not only contributing to solutions designed by others.
  • Experience making and defending architectural decisions with Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders.
  • Experience building and operating scalable, high-load, or data-intensive production systems.
  • Strong understanding of service design, system boundaries, data flows, integrations, and distributed system trade-offs.
  • Strong experience with event-driven systems, asynchronous processing, and message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, or similar.
  • Good understanding of retries, idempotency, message ordering, delivery guarantees, dead-letter handling, and failure recovery.

Strong database fundamentals, including:

  • Data modelling.
  • Transactions and isolation.
  • Indexing.
  • Locking and concurrency.
  • Query plans.
  • Performance diagnosis and optimisation.
  • Production experience with MongoDB and an understanding of its modelling, consistency, and scaling trade-offs.
  • Production experience with relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL.
  • Experience designing APIs and integrating external platforms, third-party services, and payment or subscription systems.
  • Strong production ownership mindset, including monitoring, alerting, debugging, incident investigation, and reliability improvements.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, containerised applications, deployment tooling, and CI/CD.
  • Ability to reason about deployment safety, rollbacks, scalability, resource limits, and system capacity.
  • Proven experience improving an engineering process, technical area, or system from an unclear or immature state to a measurable target state.
  • Ability to balance product delivery speed with architecture quality and long-term maintainability.
  • Experience leading experienced engineers without micromanagement.
  • Experience with delegation, performance feedback, team development, and technical ownership distribution.
  • Strong ownership, initiative, structured communication, and ability to make decisions under uncertainty.

AI-First Engineering Experience:

We are looking for more than occasional chatbot usage or basic code generation.

A strong candidate should be able to provide concrete examples of using AI in an end-to-end software delivery workflow, such as:

  • Spec-driven or context-driven development.
  • AI coding agents.
  • Automated code review.
  • Test and documentation generation.
  • Reusable repository or company-level AI context.
  • Agentic pipelines and workflow automation.
  • AI-assisted debugging and incident investigation.
  • Evaluations and quality gates.
  • Security and data privacy controls.
  • Measuring the impact of AI adoption on delivery speed and quality.
  • Introducing AI workflows across an engineering team.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience building multi-product, multi-tenant, or platform-based architectures.
  • Experience creating internal frameworks, service templates, or reusable backend components.
  • Experience scaling products without proportional growth of the engineering team.
  • Experience with AWS, including S3, Lambda, ECS, EKS, or related services.
  • Experience with Redis.
  • Hands-on Kubernetes experience.
  • Strong Docker experience.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD tooling.
  • Experience with Temporal or another workflow orchestration platform.
  • Experience applying DDD, CQRS, event sourcing, or similar architectural patterns pragmatically.
  • Experience with B2C, EdTech, subscriptions, payments, analytics, or mobile-first products
  • Experience working in an early-stage or fast-changing product environment.

Good Fit for This Role:

This role is a good fit for someone who:

  • Remains a strong hands-on backend engineer.
  • Enjoys combining coding, architecture, and leadership.
  • Can independently assess the current technical state and define a better target state.
  • Creates engineering processes rather than only following existing ones.
  • Takes ownership of services after they are released to production.
  • Can make pragmatic architectural decisions without unnecessary complexity.
  • Thinks about product and business outcomes, not only implementation.
  • Can set a technical standard for experienced engineers.
  • Is comfortable challenging existing decisions and defending a well-reasoned position.
  • Sees AI as a way to redesign engineering workflows, not only generate code.
  • Is ready to lead both technology and people.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us:

  • Innovative environment: We are building and scaling EdTech products while actively experimenting with new technologies and development approaches.
  • Global remote work: Work with an international team from anywhere within a compatible time zone.
  • Health support: Company-provided medical expense compensation.

About the Role

In this role, you'll support digital content publishing while improving the workflows used to prepare, review, ingest, release, and maintain content. You'll split your time between hands-on publishing and quality assurance work and building automated solutions that reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and increase production speed.

You'll work closely with content managers, designers, engineers, localization partners, and external vendors to coordinate publishing activities and resolve operational issues. This role is a great fit for someone who combines strong content operations experience with practical scripting skills and enjoys turning repetitive or error-prone processes into reliable, scalable, well-documented workflows.

What You'll Do

Content Publishing and Operations

  • Prepare, review, publish, update, and maintain digital content through a content management system.
  • Perform detailed quality assurance reviews of document, spreadsheet, and presentation templates before ingestion.
  • Validate metadata, accessibility, formatting, and compliance with established publishing standards.
  • Support English language and localized bulk ingestion workflows.
  • Coordinate content handoffs among content, design, engineering, localization, and vendor teams.
  • Maintain publishing trackers, operational documentation, status reports, and audit trails.
  • Manage multiple publishing workstreams while meeting established release requirements and deadlines.
  • Proactively communicate progress, risks, dependencies, blockers, and recommendations.

Workflow Automation and Tooling

  • Identify repetitive, manual, or error-prone content processes that could benefit from automation.

  • Develop batch-processing tools, validation workflows, and internal utilities that support publishing and quality operations.
  • Create dashboards and reporting solutions that provide visibility into publishing volume, quality, turnaround time, and blockers.
  • Produce process documentation, user guides, and support materials that enable broader adoption of automated solutions.
  • Incorporate appropriate human review and publishing controls into automated workflows.
  • Continuously improve solutions based on user feedback, operational requirements, and performance results.

  • At least two years of experience with content management systems, content ingestion, metadata preparation, and structured quality assurance.
  • At least two years of strong practical experience with document, spreadsheet, and presentation productivity applications.

  • Experience preparing, publishing, updating, and maintaining content through a CMS or publishing platform.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools to create scripts, automate workflows, troubleshoot issues, or develop documentation.
  • Strong attention to detail and experience completing structured QA reviews against defined standards or checklists.
  • Ability to identify operational inefficiencies and translate them into clear technical or automation requirements.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple publishing and automation workstreams independently.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Ability to proactively identify and communicate risks, dependencies, and strategic recommendations.
  • A track record of employment stability and consistent tenure in previous roles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background working across content, design, engineering, localization, and production teams.
  • Experience designing automated solutions that are accurate, maintainable, scalable, and accessible to nontechnical users.

  • Prepare, submit IAS, BAS, Super to the ATO through Xero

  • Review timesheets and supporting records before processing.
  • Set up new employees across required systems.
  • Maintain employee records, leave information, licenses and onboarding documentation.

Operations & Administration

  • Manage and action business emails.
  • Maintain daily operational spreadsheets and records.
  • Review incoming operator/driver dockets for accuracy and completeness.
  • Assist with daily employee, truck and machinery allocations.
  • Prepare and issue quotes.
  • Follow up outstanding quotes and customer enquiries.
  • Coordinate site visits and appointments.

  • Provide general administrative support and overflow as required.

Compliance & Project Support

  • Assist in preparation of SWMS
  • Assist with quality assurance and ISO documentation.
  • Maintain required project, fleet and compliance records.
  • Identify and follow up missing documentation, purchase orders or information.

Requirements

  • Previous bookkeeping, accounts or senior administration experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of Xero.
  • Job costing and cash-flow forecasting experience.
  • Experience with payroll, invoicing and reconciliations.
  • Advanced spreadsheet skills including lookups, pivot tables and reporting.
  • Strong Google Sheets skills, including formulas, filtering and data management.

  • Strong numerical ability and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work across multiple sources of information and identify discrepancies.
  • Excellent organisation and time-management skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to work independently and manage recurring deadlines.
  • High level of confidentiality and professionalism.
  • Confidence dealing directly with customers, suppliers and employees.

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

Hey there! 👋

We are Hedepy, a scale-up and a leader in holistic mental health support for individuals and companies in Central & Eastern Europe. There are 70+ of us working remotely across 9 European countries. In 2025 we facilitated over 300,000 therapy sessions, and we are just getting started.

Lukáš (our CEO) is looking for a Head of People to take full ownership of our HR function. You report directly to him, being part of the leadership team and present to the board.

This is not a greenfield role; the function exists, and the processes work. Now we need to carry a growing contractor network across 9 countries without the HR team growing with it. Your leverage is automation, sharp prioritisation and the authority to cut scope.

One thing we are picky about. We want someone who automates the boring half so there is time left for the half that cannot be automated: the conversations, the care, support of our managers. We help people take care of their mental health for a living. It would be odd if our own HR only worked on paper.

🚀 Your mission

  • Own the full employee lifecycle for our internal team: hiring strategy, onboarding, retention, offboarding, exit interviews.
  • Lead and develop our Recruiter (Veru), including her priorities and capacity planning.
  • Run the contractual and labor law setup across 9 countries: contracts, addendums, B2B structures, and the compliance calls you make independently, with external counsel as backup rather than default.
  • Own the monthly payroll cycle across CZ, SK and PL together with our external payroll partners.
  • Redesign HR processes that do not scale, and automate them yourself with AI, Make or similar tools.
  • Build and track the people metrics leadership actually uses, from our internal data rather than an off-the-shelf HR suite.
  • Support the leadership team and the potential expansion with the people side of new markets and new setups.
  • And last but not least, be the person people come to when something is not working, and then actually fix it. Hard conversations, conflicts, exits, and teammates who need help.

Requirements

💡 What we're looking for in you

Must-have:

  • 4+ years of HR experience, including 2+ years owning the HR function in an international company of 50 to 200 people.
  • Hands-on experience doing the operational HR craft yourself: employment and B2B contracts, addendums, onboarding and offboarding admin, and stepping into recruitment when needed.
  • Independent labor law judgment in at least one CEE jurisdiction (CZ, SK or PL), including contract drafting and routine legal decisions without waiting for counsel.
  • Proven experience building working automations yourself in Make (or similar) and an ATS such as Workable, plus active use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) in your daily workflow for drafting, analysis and reporting. We will ask about this concretely.
  • Track record of building or rebuilding HR processes end-to-end and owning the result, not only the design.
  • You are as good with people as you are with systems. You can hold a hard conversation, sit with someone on a bad day, and tell a manager something they do not want to hear. We will ask you about a process you rebuilt and how you knew it started working for people, not only on paper.
  • English at C1 level, written and spoken, including leadership and board settings.
  • Native or fluent level in Czech, Slovak, Polish, Hungarian or Romanian.
  • Scale-up DNA. You have worked somewhere the process did not exist yet and you built it anyway. You decide with incomplete information, you are fine with priorities changing mid-quarter, and you ship the version that works now instead of waiting for the perfect one. Small budget, no team, still done. :)

Nice to have:

  • Experience in a remote company running B2C and B2B models side by side.
  • Payroll or contractor setup experience in HU, RO or other CEE markets beyond CZ/SK/PL.
  • Experience supporting physical locations alongside a fully remote team.

Benefits

🤝 Why join us?

  • Free psychotherapy sessions on Hedepy.
  • A real mandate: direct CEO reporting, a seat in the leadership team, board exposure.
  • Full autonomy over how the HR function is designed, tooled and automated.
  • Remote-first, async-friendly, flexible hours.
  • International team from 10+ countries, plus team offsites and workations ☀️
  • Ideal start date in the middle of November, beginning of December at the latest.

About MariaDB

MariaDB is making a big impact on the world. Whether you’re checking your bank account, buying a coffee, shopping online, making a phone call, listening to music, taking out a loan or ordering takeout – MariaDB is the backbone of applications used everyday. Companies small and large, including 75% of the Fortune 500, run MariaDB, touching the lives of billions of people. With massive reach through Linux distributions, enterprise deployments and public clouds, MariaDB is uniquely positioned as the leading database for modern application development.

The RoleYou will be responsible for the development and testing of a highly scalable, geo-distributed, highly performant database solution. You should have experience working on distributed software solutions and have a strong background working with on-premise and cloud-based solutions. You will also be responsible for managing a number of Software Engineers on the project.

Java Senior Software Engineer

Here at MariaDB we are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Java Senior Software Engineer to lead the development of our highly scalable, geo-distributed, and highly performant database solution. This role requires a strong background in distributed software solutions, experience with both on-premise and cloud-based environments, and proven leadership abilities. You’ll be joining a small, highly skilled team where your work will have a direct impact. Expect to dig deep into replication, sharding, concurrency, and performance optimization—making our systems faster, smarter, and more resilient. You’ll collaborate globally, contribute to open source, and push the limits of what a distributed database can do.

What You’ll Do

  • Ensure the scalability, performance, and reliability of the database system.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in distributed environments.
  • Profile, debug, and fine-tune performance with tools like JFR, JMC, async-profiler and VisualVM—and your own tricks.
  • Keep code clean and reviewable with Git.
  • Develop and optimize the data structures for providing the best experience accessing data in high data-intensive scenarios.
  • Implement the best way to store data to disk and send data over the network to other nodes (including failure handling and recovery after failures).
  • Implement and integrate algorithms for high availability of the whole cluster.
  • Investigate flaws in data consistency algorithms, which may require thorough debugging either on multi-node clusters and in low-level byte-represented data.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of experience in Java programming.
  • Deep knowledge of concurrency in Java and Java Memory Model and/or of concurrency model in other programming systems.
  • Excellent Java SE knowledge including IO, JVM internals, etc.
  • Experience with SQL databases.
  • Experience in troubleshooting Java applications and/or databases.
  • Excellent leadership, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
  • Experience working effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environments.
  • Deep SQL knowledge (MariaDB/MySQL/PostgreSQL/Apache Ignite/GridGain) and passion for distributed systems (Raft, MVCC, ACID etc).
  • Understands MVCC and P2PL, and the difference between Snapshot Isolation and REPEATABLE READ.

The following may be a strong plus:

  • Experience with NoSQL and/or distributed databases.
  • Experience with building highload distributed systems and algorithms.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and/or public Cloud (AWS, GCE, Azure, etc.)
  • Open-source contributions, automation expertise, or performance/load testing.
  • Active use of AI.

Location

Hybrid / Remote – Bulgaria

Remote – Croatia, Estonia, Finland, Italy, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Spain, Armenia, Cyprus.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • A globally distributed team where your work is tangible, valuable and appreciated.
  • Remote or Hybrid work options (location dependent)
  • Projects that stretch your skills and make an impact at scale.
  • Competitive pay, 25 days paid annual leave (plus holidays), and a culture that values creativity and clean engineering.

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Marketing Automation Specialist to build, manage, and optimize automated marketing campaigns, email workflows, lead nurturing programs, and CRM automation.

This is a hands-on marketing operations role focused on turning marketing systems into measurable pipeline and revenue growth.

You’ll work across:

  • HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, and other automation platforms
  • Email marketing and nurture campaigns
  • Lead scoring and lifecycle automation
  • CRM integration and lead routing
  • Audience segmentation and database management

If you enjoy building scalable automation systems, improving conversion rates, and connecting marketing activity to sales outcomes, this role is a strong fit.

Marketing Automation & Workflows

  • Create:

    • Drip sequences
    • Trigger-based automations
    • Lifecycle workflows

Email Marketing & Campaign Execution

  • Conduct A/B tests across:
    • Subject lines
    • Email copy

    • Send strategies
  • Ensure emails are mobile-responsive, brand-consistent, and conversion-focused

CRM, Lead Management & Sales Alignment

Analytics & Reporting

    • Lead-to-opportunity conversion
    • Pipeline contribution
    • Revenue impact
  • Build dashboards and reports using HubSpot, Marketo, Power BI, or Tableau
  • Analyze campaign and workflow performance
  • Provide actionable recommendations based on performance data

Marketing Operations & Optimization

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive marketing processes
  • Test new workflows, messaging, and audience strategies
  • Improve campaign efficiency and scalability
  • Support attribution and revenue reporting
  • Maintain compliance with GDPR, CAN-SPAM, and CCPA
  • Stay current with marketing automation trends and platform updates

Requirements

Must-Have Experience

  • 2+ years of marketing automation or marketing operations experience
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major marketing automation platform:
    • HubSpot
    • Marketo
    • Pardot (Account Engagement)
    • ActiveCampaign
  • Experience building:
    • Automated workflows
    • Lead nurture campaigns
    • Email campaigns
    • Lead scoring models
    • Audience segments
  • Experience working with CRM systems and lead management workflows
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Email marketing
    • Marketing operations
    • CRM workflows
    • Email deliverability
    • Data management
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills
  • High attention to detail and strong execution skills
  • Strong written and verbal English communication
  • Ability to work remotely during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • HubSpot, Marketo, or Pardot certifications
  • Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot CRM, or Zoho CRM
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, e-commerce, or growth marketing
  • Familiarity with:
    • Multi-touch attribution
    • Revenue Operations (RevOps)
    • Marketing analytics
    • Funnel optimization
  • Experience using Zapier, APIs, or third-party integrations

  • Marketo

  • Klaviyo
  • Salesforce
  • HubSpot CRM
  • Zoho CRM
  • Zapier
  • Excel / Google Sheets

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You might start by reviewing active campaigns, workflow performance, lead routing, and email engagement metrics.

From there, you’ll build or optimize nurture sequences, troubleshoot automation issues, update audience segments, review lead scoring, and ensure qualified leads are routed correctly to sales.

Interview Process

Apply today and help build scalable marketing automation systems that drive measurable business growth.

jobs.description:
Traild: Who are we? 

Traild is a high-growth SaaS company redefining how finance teams operate, combining AI, automation, and payments infrastructure to power the future of B2B finance.

Every year, businesses lose billions to fraud, errors, and mistakes. Traild exists to solve this at scale, helping finance teams move faster, stay in control, and operate with confidence.

With rapid customer growth, global expansion across APAC, North America and EMEA, and continued investment in product innovation, we are at a defining stage of our journey.

This is an opportunity to help shape the next category leader in finance automation, control and security, building technology that transforms how businesses manage, move, and protect money. At the core of this is a powerful AI-driven platform, enabling finance teams to deploy intelligent agents that do the work, surface risk in real time, and continuously improve how financial operations run.

Traild is building the infrastructure behind modern finance, protecting and powering meaningful volumes of the world’s B2B transactions.

If you’re excited by high growth, real ownership, and building something that matters, Traild is the place to do the most impactful work of your career.

Hear how Traild customers speak about us here.

The Role: Want to be a part of our exciting growth journey?

We are looking for a talented, passionate, and motivated individual to join our team as a Revenue Accountant, where you will play a critical role in making sure our subscription revenue is recognised accurately and on time, in our Finance team.

You will own subscription revenue recognition and the deferred revenue schedule in Xero, take on the fixed asset register, prepayments and intercompany reconciliations, and support month-end close alongside the wider team.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on revenue recognition experience in a subscription or SaaS business, strong Xero proficiency, and the judgement to spot a transaction that does not fit the policy.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue

  • Post subscription revenue in Xero each period, in the correct period and account, in line with our revenue recognition policy
  • Own the deferred revenue schedule and reconcile it to the general ledger every month
  • Prepare revenue schedules and supporting documentation for month-end reporting and external audit
  • Review customer contracts and billing arrangements to confirm how revenue should be recognised, and raise anything that does not fit the policy
  • Investigate revenue movements month on month and explain them to the Finance Manager

Month-end schedules

  • Maintain the fixed asset register in Xero, recording additions at cost, posting depreciation, processing disposals, and reconciling the register to the general ledger monthly
  • Own the prepayments schedule, amortising over the correct period in line with the underlying agreement and releasing expired balances
  • Prepare and post intercompany transactions, reconcile balances across Traild entities each month, and prepare settlement and foreign exchange revaluation journals

Close and compliance

  • Prepare and post assigned routine journals each period, with clear supporting documentation
  • Complete bank reconciliations and investigate differences before they reach close
  • Support the month-end close, completing assigned reconciliations and tasks within agreed timelines
  • Flag unusual or unexplained transactions before they surface in reconciliations or monthly reporting
  • Assist the Finance Manager with BAS preparation and lodgement, and provide supporting documentation for audit

Supporting the team

  • Provide accounts payable support, including invoice entry and payment processing, and assist with accounts receivable as the team's volume requires
  • Cover billing during leave and peak periods
  • Use Xero and all integrated finance systems confidently and independently, flagging system issues promptly
  • Document recurring processes clearly, so they can be followed by any team member

Who You Are:

  • 3 to 5 years in a hands-on accounting role, with genuine ownership of revenue recognition rather than invoicing alone
  • Experience recognising subscription or recurring revenue, including deferred revenue schedules, ideally in a SaaS or subscription business
  • Comfortable reading a customer contract and turning it into a revenue treatment, and confident raising a transaction that does not fit the policy
  • Hands-on Xero experience is essential, and you pick up connected finance systems quickly
  • Strong Excel or Sheets for reconciliations and supporting schedules
  • Experience with month-end schedules such as fixed assets, prepayments or intercompany reconciliations, or the appetite to take them on
  • Comfortable moving between technical accounting and transactional work, and happy to assist where the team needs it
  • Experience in a scale-up or another high-volume finance environment
  • A clear, calm written communicator who works well asynchronously across time zones and keeps a reliable daily overlap with Australian business hours
  • An accounting, commerce or finance qualification, or part-qualification. Equivalent practical experience is considered, and a CPA qualification is an advantage
  • Exposure to BAS preparation and lodgement, or other Australian compliance work, is an advantage
  • Hands-on use of AI tools to speed up accounting work, with a real example you can talk through, is an advantage

Strong collaborator with an attitude embracing growth, hands-on execution, adaptability, and the scale-up spirit.

The Perks of Working at Traild  

  • Flexibility: we offer a range of remote, hybrid and flexible working options. 

  • Global team: we are growing across APAC, NA and EMEA and have team all across the world. 

  • We are growing at an exponential rate, this is an opportunity to get involved with a true rocketship with all the excitement and opportunities that comes with it 

  • Our team genuinely loves working at Traild: our eNPS score is 68, where anything above 50 is considered world-class.

This role supervises Class A and clinical drivers and fleet administration staff and oversees the proper maintenance and modification of mobile medical clinics and support vehicles to ensure DOT/FMCSA compliance and employee safety during travel and clinic operations. Primary Responsibilities:

  • Oversee HOS compliance and the ELD program per 49 CFR Part 395: monitor logs, address violations, run exception reports, and enforce corrective actions, partnering with Fleet Coordinators on day-to-day execution.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

SAP Sales & Distribution Functional Analyst


About the role


We’re looking for an SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) Functional Analyst to join our team and play an important role in supporting and improving SAP solutions for our client.


This is a great opportunity for someone with hands-on experience in SAP SD who enjoys understanding how a business works, talking to users, solving problems and finding practical ways to make processes better.

You’ll work closely with both business users and technical teams, helping to understand what people need from SAP and turning those needs into effective solutions. You’ll be involved in everything from day-to-day support and troubleshooting through to configuration, testing, process improvements, and new developments.


You don’t need to know everything from day one. We’re particularly interested in someone who is curious, willing to learn and keen to broaden their SAP knowledge into other Logistics areas over time.


Due to the nature of the client environment, eligibility for security clearance is required for this role. To meet the current security requirements, candidates must be sole UK nationals and have lived and worked continuously in the UK for the past five years. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider dual nationals for this position.


What you'll be doing

  • Working with business users to understand their requirements, challenges and day-to-day processes.
  • Using your SAP SD knowledge to identify practical solutions that meet business needs.
  • Helping to map current processes and design improved AS-IS and TO-BE processes.
  • Configuring SAP and translating business requirements into clear functional specifications.
  • Supporting the resolution of SAP SD issues, working closely with both users and technical colleagues.
  • Helping to identify opportunities to improve existing processes and make better use of SAP.
  • Creating and carrying out test scenarios to make sure changes work as expected.
  • Supporting users through changes, including providing training and guidance where needed.
  • Working with colleagues and sharing your knowledge to help others develop their SAP skills.
  • Contributing to projects, enhancements and other SAP-related initiatives.
  • Being open to learning and supporting other areas of SAP and Logistics functionality as your experience develops.

What we're looking for

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • Relevant hands-on experience working with SAP Sales & Distribution (SD).
  • Experience in business analysis, business solutions or a similar role.
  • A good understanding of business processes and how SAP can support and improve them.
  • Experience supporting users through business process changes or improvements.
  • Experience working with both business and technical teams to resolve issues.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • The ability to listen, ask the right questions and turn business requirements into practical solutions.
  • Experience creating and executing test scenarios.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • The confidence to explain technical concepts in a way that makes sense to non-technical audiences.
  • A willingness to learn, develop and broaden your SAP knowledge.

An SAP certification would be great, but it isn't essential. We're also happy to support someone who is keen to work towards certification.


A degree or equivalent experience is preferred.


The kind of person who will enjoy this role

You’ll enjoy this role if you like getting to the bottom of a problem rather than simply fixing the symptom.

You’ll be comfortable speaking with different people across a business, from end users to technical specialists, and enjoy understanding what they need and finding a way to make things work.


We’re looking for someone who is approachable, curious and solutions-focused, with the confidence to take ownership while knowing when to ask for help.


Things don't always go to plan in SAP, so being able to manage changing priorities, stay calm when there are competing demands and work through problems logically is important.


Most importantly, we're looking for someone who wants to develop their skills and grow with the role, rather than someone who already knows everything.


Where you'll work

This is primarily a work-from-home role, giving you the flexibility to work remotely while remaining closely connected with the wider team and client.

There may be occasional travel to client sites for meetings, workshops or other business requirements.

From time to time, there may also be a requirement to work outside standard hours, including occasional weekends, depending on client and project requirements.


Why join us?

This is more than a role focused purely on keeping SAP running. You'll have the opportunity to work directly with users, understand real business challenges and see the impact of the solutions you help deliver.


In addition, DXC offers a competitive salary and a flexible benefits package designed to support you both professionally and personally — including pension, private medical cover, and wellbeing programmes.


You'll also have the opportunity to develop your SAP skills, gain exposure to wider Logistics functionality, and build your experience across both functional and business-facing areas.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

At CloudFactory, we are a mission-driven team passionate about unlocking the potential of AI to transform the world. By combining advanced technology with a global network of talented people, we make unusable data usable, driving real-world impact at scale.

More than just a workplace, we’re a global community founded on strong relationships and the belief that meaningful work transforms lives. Our commitment to earning, learning, and serving fuels everything we do as we strive to connect one million people to meaningful work and build leaders worth following.

Our Culture

At CloudFactory, we believe in building a workplace where everyone feels empowered, valued, and inspired to bring their authentic selves to work. We are:

  • Mission-Driven: We focus on creating economic and social impact.

About the Role

Energy, Oil & Gas is one of the most operationally complex and asset-intensive industries, where AI is rapidly moving from experimentation to enterprise-scale deployment.
While the opportunity is significant, many organizations struggle to move from promising pilots to production-grade AI due to fragmented data, complex environments, and strict safety and regulatory requirements.

CloudFactory is built to solve exactly this.

As Client Principal, AI Consulting (Energy, Oil & Gas), you will be the senior commercial and strategic leader for our energy sector. You will operate as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders across operators, oilfield services companies, and energy enterprises, shaping AI transformation agendas and leading engagements from origination through delivery oversight.

This is a high-impact, externally facing role for someone who can open doors, lead complex conversations, and convert opportunity into long-term partnerships.

What You’ll Do

Executive Relationships & Strategic Advisory

  • Build and lead market growth strategy across energy operators, oilfield services companies, and energy enterprises.
  • Operate as a strategic advisor on AI adoption, from identifying high-value use cases to scaling solutions in production.
  • Engage C-suite and VP stakeholders as a trusted advisor, not a vendor.
  • Navigate complex stakeholder environments across operations, subsurface, engineering, HSE, IT, and data teams.
  • Develop a deep understanding of client priorities across upstream, midstream, and downstream operations.

Business Development & Growth

  • Own new client acquisition, account expansion and P/L management accounts within the energy sector.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans with clear pathways from pilot to enterprise-scale programs.
  • Lead consultative, executive-level sales conversations and build compelling business cases for AI investment.
  • Own the full commercial lifecycle: discovery, solution framing, proposal development, and executive presentations.
  • Navigate sector-specific buying cycles, procurement processes, and capital planning timelines.

Solution Shaping & Delivery Oversight

  • Identify and shape high-impact AI use cases, including:
    • Predictive maintenance and asset monitoring
    • Computer vision for inspection (drone, aerial, and field imagery)
    • Safety and compliance automation
    • Intelligent document processing from engineering documentation
    • Geospatial, LiDAR, and digital twin data pipelines
  • Translate operational challenges into scalable AI solutions leveraging CloudFactory’s capabilities.
  • Partner closely with technical and delivery teams to ensure high-quality execution and client satisfaction.
  • Oversee delivery to ensure alignment on scope, timelines, and outcomes.

Thought Leadership & Industry Impact

  • Stay at the forefront of AI trends across the energy value chain, including asset digitization, predictive operations, and computer vision at scale.
  • Contribute to CloudFactory’s external presence through industry events, client engagements, and thought leadership.
  • Bring sector insights into product, delivery, and go-to-market strategy.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Lead and inspire cross-functional teams including consultants, data scientists, and engineers.
  • Foster strong collaboration between client stakeholders and internal teams.
  • Promote best practices in AI consulting, delivery excellence, and client engagement.

Requirements

  • Deep industry expertise in energy, oil & gas, or adjacent industrial sectors, with a strong understanding of operations and digital transformation.
  • Established executive network across energy operators or oilfield services companies that you can activate from day one.
  • Strong business acumen, with the ability to translate operational challenges into AI-driven opportunities; P/L management experience.
  • Technical fluency in AI/ML concepts, including predictive analytics and computer vision.
  • Proven consulting and commercial experience, managing enterprise clients and complex engagements.
  • Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders as a trusted peer.
  • Leadership experience, guiding cross-functional teams and delivering high-impact outcomes.
  • Experience: 10+ years of experience in consulting, technology, or digital transformation within energy or industrial sectors.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, statistics, or related field. Advanced degrees in AI, data science, or business are a plus.

Why This Role

This is an opportunity to operate at the intersection of AI, industry transformation, and executive leadership, helping some of the world’s largest energy companies unlock real value from AI. You’ll play a critical role in shaping both client outcomes and CloudFactory’s growth in a strategically important sector.

Benefits

  • Compensation: Highly competitive base salary and an aggressive, performance-aligned incentive compensation structure.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Robust health, dental, vision, and retirement plans.
  • Cutting-Edge Projects: Direct exposure to, and leadership of, advanced AI initiatives with the world's most influential energy corporations.
  • Collaborative Culture: A supportive, high-performance team environment focused on innovation and measurable client success.
  • Professional Growth: Structured access to continuous executive education, mentorship, and accelerated leadership development opportunities.
  • Executive Visibility: Regular interaction with, and direct accountability to, the company’s senior leadership team.

This role represents a unique, high-impact opportunity to define and shape the AI landscape for major global corporations in the energy sector. If you are a highly consultative professional with deep sector knowledge, a passion for AI, and a proven talent for originating and closing complex, strategic enterprise deals, we encourage your application.

Primary Function of Position:

The Software Build team at Intuitive is seeking a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to design, build, and operate the next-generation unified build system across all robotic surgery platforms.

This role is for a senior engineer who writes code, debugs real build failures, prototypes infrastructure, and scales systems through direct technical contribution. You will own core build architecture while remaining deeply involved in implementation—driving measurable improvements in build speed, correctness, and developer productivity across large, safety-critical C/C++ codebases.

You will serve as a technical leader and mentor, but this is not an oversight-only role. Expect to spend significant time designing build rules, implementing tooling, debugging distributed builds, and evolving CI infrastructure in production.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain Bazel-based build systems for large-scale C/C++ embedded software, including custom toolchains and cross-compilation flows.
  • Directly implement and optimize Bazel Remote Caching and Remote Execution (RBE) to enable fast, deterministic builds across local, CI, and cloud environments.
  • Write production code in Rust, C/C++, and Python to support build tooling, infrastructure services, and developer workflows.
  • Own and evolve build performance: cache hit rates, execution parallelism, dependency hygiene, hermeticity, and reproducibility.
  • Build and maintain developer-facing tooling that improves local iteration speed and CI reliability.
  • Integrate and operate build infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments, balancing performance, security, and cost.
  • Work directly with firmware, platform, and application teams to debug real-world build issues and eliminate systemic bottlenecks.
  • Improve observability of build systems through metrics, logging, and analytics.
  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, architectural discussions, and hands-on problem solving.
  • Act as a technical advocate for modern build practices and scalable development workflows.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

  • Deep technical ownership with a bias toward implementation and measurable outcomes.
  • Ability to balance architectural rigor with pragmatic delivery.
  • Builds trust through technical credibility and consistent execution.
  • Drives alignment by connecting build system improvements to developer productivity and product velocity.
  • Acts as a hands-on technical leader shaping the long-term evolution of Intuitive’s development platforms.
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong record of hands-on technical ownership.
  • Deep, practical expertise with Bazel in complex C/C++ and embedded environments.
  • Proven experience implementing and operating Bazel Remote Caching and Remote Execution at scale.
  • Strong programming experience in Rust, C/C++, and Python.
  • Experience debugging and optimizing distributed build systems, CI pipelines, and build infrastructure under real production constraints.
  • Solid understanding of compiler toolchains, linkers, and build graph behavior.
  • Ability to communicate technical tradeoffs clearly and influence teams through technical leadership.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

  • Experience with Nix and Nix-based packaging for reproducible builds and developer environments.
  • Familiarity with BuildBuddy (or similar Bazel observability / remote execution platforms).
  • Experience with Yocto-based toolchains and embedded Linux build workflows.
  • Exposure to REAPI-compatible execution backends and remote build infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting safety-critical or regulated software systems (medical, automotive, aerospace).
  • Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) in Computer Science or related field.
  • 12–15 years of relevant industry experience.

What you’ll be obsessed about

Making every scene work.

You care about timing, acting, expressions, movement and all the small details that make 2D animation feel alive.

You don’t just make characters move from A to B. You think about what the character is doing, why they’re doing it and how the animation supports the joke, explanation or story.

You should be the kind of person who watches a scene and thinks:

HRFS Analyst | Virtual - Canada


The HRFS Analyst provides payroll accounting, funding, and financial analysis support to Strada clients across Canada and the United States. Based in Canada, this position supports Canadian clients with both Canadian and U.S. payroll populations and is responsible for ensuring accurate payroll accounting, reconciliations, funding, and financial reporting across both countries. The role works closely with clients, payroll processing teams, vendors, and internal stakeholders to resolve financial and operational issues, support audits, and maintain appropriate financial controls.


Key Responsibilities


  • Perform payroll-to-General Ledger (GL) reconciliations for both Canadian and U.S. payroll populations, including payroll activity, GL postings, balance sheet accounts, and interface error reports.
  • Prepare bank and funding reconciliations by comparing payroll, banking, and third-party payment data and taking appropriate action to clear reconciling items.
  • Analyze payroll variances, accounting discrepancies, and compliance issues; perform root cause analysis and recommend appropriate resolutions.
  • Prepare or support journal vouchers, reclassifications, and other accounting adjustments and understand their impact on the General Ledger.
  • Analyze financial, operational, and compliance risks associated with escalated issues and provide recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Provide functional support for payroll accounting and funding issues, including researching system defects, documenting issues and evidence, and coordinating resolution with appropriate internal teams.
  • Support implementations, go-lives, year-end activities, and the accurate and timely delivery of payroll accounting and GL files and documents.
  • Respond to client, vendor, and internal inquiries related to payroll accounting, funding, treasury, and financial processes across Canadian and U.S. operations.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing accurate and timely information and helping ensure appropriate controls are established and followed.

Workday Integration Developer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Job Title: Workday Integration Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
