Salary Range: $100,000–$180,000 Annually
Experience Required: 12+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are looking for a Workday Integration Developer to design, develop, and maintain integrations between Workday and the broader enterprise application landscape. The role focuses on hands-on integration delivery using EIB, Studio, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, and Workday APIs, with strong attention to reliability, security, and data quality. The ideal candidate has shipped meaningful Workday integrations in production, navigates Workday’s tenant model and security framework with confidence, and writes well-structured Studio integrations that are easy to maintain. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop Workday integrations using EIB, Workday Studio, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, and PECI.
  • Build inbound and outbound integrations connecting Workday with payroll, benefits, IT provisioning, finance, and analytics systems.
  • Develop XSLT transformations within Workday Studio integrations, applying disciplined templating practices, reusable helper libraries, and careful test coverage to keep complex mappings maintainable.
  • Implement integrations using Workday REST and SOAP web services where appropriate.
  • Design error handling, retry, and notification strategies that ensure reliable integration operations.
  • Develop and maintain integration system users, ISSGs, security configurations, and tenant-level setup for integrations.
  • Build and maintain calculated fields, custom reports, and report-as-a-service integrations.
  • Implement Workday business processes and condition rules that support integration logic, ensuring the upstream and downstream sides of each integration agree on routing, approvals, and state transitions.
  • Participate actively in Workday tenant refresh planning and integration regression testing, ensuring critical integration paths are exercised in lower environments before each tenant move and any drift is caught early.
  • Collaborate with HR, payroll, IT, and finance stakeholders to translate business needs into integration designs.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Support production incidents related to integrations and drive durable fixes.
  • Participate in Workday release planning and regression testing, reviewing upcoming feature changes for impact, scheduling validation cycles, and coordinating with stakeholders so adoption proceeds smoothly.
  • Stay current with Workday product releases and integration platform evolution.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 12 or more years of Workday integration development experience.
  • Deep expertise in EIB, Workday Studio, and Core Connectors.
  • Strong XSLT skills and experience with Workday Studio orchestrations.
  • Hands-on experience with Workday REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Strong understanding of the Workday data model and tenant configuration.
  • Experience with Workday security model including ISU/ISSG patterns.
  • Familiarity with calculated fields and custom report design.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Workday Pro Integrations certification.
  • Experience with PICOF, PECI, or Cloud Connect for Payroll.
  • Familiarity with Workday Extend.
  • Exposure to multi-tenant or multi-region Workday deployments.
  • Experience integrating Workday with major SaaS platforms (ServiceNow, Salesforce).

jobs.description:
Estamos em busca de pessoas fascinadas por criar um futuro melhor, que sejam inquietas, tenham coragem para desafiar o comum, que valorizem a diversidade de ideias e acreditem no potencial transformador da colaboração verdadeira.

Sabemos que muitas pessoas — especialmente mulheres — só se candidatam a uma vaga se sentem que cumprem 100% dos requisitos. Se esse for o seu caso, queremos te encorajar a se inscrever mesmo assim. Aqui, valorizamos trajetórias diversas e aprendizados ao longo da jornada.

Junte-se a nós na busca por um mundo com novas inteligências.

Este papel tem como objetivo desenhar, liderar e garantir a escalabilidade e governança das rotinas financeiras da empresa. A posição exige perfil altamente analítico, visão sistêmica e capacidade de liderança técnica para estruturar operações complexas, garantir compliance de alto rigor e atuar como parceiro estratégico da gestão e diretoria financeira.

Esse propósito se traduz, na prática, nos seguintes Jobs to Be Done:

  • Liderar e desenvolver o time financeiro: Atuar como referência técnica e mentor para analistas e assistentes, coordenando a distribuição de demandas, orientando as entregas diárias e promovendo o desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe para garantir um alto padrão de qualidade na operação.
  • Liderar e otimizar rotinas de Tesouraria e Controladoria: Gerenciar o ciclo de ponta a ponta (contas a pagar, faturamento e fluxo de caixa), desenhando processos escaláveis e garantindo a mitigação de riscos operacionais e o cumprimento impecável das obrigações.
  • Liderar análises financeiras e estratégia orçamentária: Desenvolver relatórios de alta complexidade e influenciar ativamente o planejamento orçamentário, conectando resultados financeiros à estratégia macro do negócio.
  • Desenhar a arquitetura de centros de custo e projetos: Estruturar as políticas e a matriz de alocação de despesas e receitas, garantindo uma governança robusta para viabilizar o acompanhamento preciso da rentabilidade por projetos.
  • Gerir estrategicamente contratos e prestações de contas complexas: Liderar o ciclo financeiro de contratos de grande porte, mitigar riscos em negociações e coordenar auditorias e prestações de contas rigorosas.
  • Garantir a governança sistêmica via OMIE: Atuar como key user do sistema ERP OMIE, liderando parametrizações, integrações sistêmicas e garantindo a integridade e escalabilidade da base de dados financeira.
  • Liderar processos de auditoria e compliance: Ser o ponto focal técnico na estruturação de controles internos e no atendimento a auditorias externas e internas, garantindo total conformidade legal e de processos.
  • Liderar a transformação e automação de processos: Desenhar e encabeçar projetos de melhoria contínua, utilizando tecnologia e reengenharia de processos para escalar a operação com eficiência.
  • Coordenação de contabilidade e DP externos: Supervisionar as rotinas executadas pelos parceiros terceirizados, assegurando a qualidade, conformidade e pontualidade no processamento da folha de pagamento e nas entregas contábeis

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS

  • Experiência consolidada (nível sênior/especialista) na área financeira, com forte vivência em estruturação de processos operacionais.
  • Excel avançado e domínio na implantação/parametrização de ERPs.
  • Excelente capacidade analítica, visão sistêmica e habilidade para liderar projetos complexos.
  • Sólida experiência com controle financeiro avançado, gestão de contratos e análise de riscos.
  • Ampla experiência com processos rigorosos de prestação de contas (forte diferencial se for com universidades ou editais de fomento).
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (capacidade de conduzir reuniões e negociar).

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

  • Experiência liderando tecnicamente áreas financeiras em empresas de base tecnológica ou contextos de alto crescimento.
  • Capacidade de influenciar stakeholders e promover melhorias contínuas com grande autonomia.
  • Forte interesse por inovação, tecnologia e impacto social.

SOBRE A KUNUMI

Na Kunumi, a curiosidade é nossa força motriz na busca incansável por conhecimento e pela coragem de desafiar o convencional. Acreditamos que a diversidade de pensamentos e perspectivas é fundamental para criar soluções únicas e impactantes.

Nossa cultura é pautada pela valorização das pessoas, do cuidado com o legado que deixamos e pela constante busca por resultados elegantes em meio a desafios complexos. Aqui, cada voz é ouvida, cada ideia é valorizada e cada conquista é celebrada em conjunto.

Somos agentes de mudança que almejam promover uma transformação positiva na sociedade por meio da Inteligência Artificial. Acreditamos no potencial humano e na capacidade de atuar como catalisadores para um futuro mais equilibrado.

BENEFÍCIOS

  • Suporte home-office (ajuda de custo, cadeira, headphones, laptop, entre outros);

  • Assistência a Filhos;
  • Auxílio para Filhos(as) com Deficiência;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Programas de promoção à Saúde - mental, física e emocional
  • Parceria Wellhub - Plano Gold gratuito
  • Recesso remunerado de final de ano
  • Kunumi Day mensal - Toda segunda sexta-feira do mês ficamos off

SOBRE O PROCESSO

Depois de enviar sua inscrição, você receberá um email de confirmação.

**PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH **

About the Company

Our client is a profitable, fast-growing U.S.-based digital marketing and eCommerce agency that helps consumer brands scale through performance media, creative strategy, advanced measurement, and AI-powered solutions.

The agency combines human expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver measurable business results, focusing on profitability, efficiency, and sustainable growth rather than vanity metrics.

With strategic partnerships across leading advertising and social commerce platforms, including Google, Meta, TikTok, Snap, and Pinterest, the company operates at the forefront of digital marketing innovation.

The team embraces an AI-first mindset, entrepreneurial thinking, operational excellence, and a culture of ownership, where individuals are encouraged to take initiative, make decisions, and contribute directly to business growth.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly proactive and business-minded Executive Assistant / Chief of Staff to work directly with the founders and leadership team of a fast-moving digital marketing agency.

This is not a traditional administrative or scheduling position. It is a hands-on role that combines executive support, operational management, vendor oversight, process improvement, and business development.

The ideal candidate is a resourceful professional who takes ownership of responsibilities, exercises independent judgment, anticipates business needs, and makes decisions with minimal supervision.

You will oversee executive priorities, manage vendor relationships, optimize operational systems, and develop processes that improve efficiency across the organization. You will also contribute directly to revenue-generating initiatives by supporting prospect research, outbound outreach, pipeline development, and marketing activities.

We are looking for someone who thinks like an operator, executes like an executive assistant, and brings the commercial mindset needed to help a growing business scale.

Key Responsibilities

Executive & Founder Support

  • Manage executive calendars, inboxes, meetings, and communications, independently handling routine scheduling and prioritization decisions.

  • Act as a trusted point of contact between leadership, internal teams, vendors, and clients.

  • Anticipate executive needs, prioritize competing demands, and ensure timely follow-through on commitments.

  • Prepare meeting agendas, executive briefings, status reports, and other materials, synthesizing information to support effective decision-making.

  • Coordinate founders' personal appointments, scheduling, and occasional personal administrative needs with professionalism and discretion.

Vendor Relationship Management

  • Take ownership of day-to-day vendor relationships, including communications, issue resolution, service quality, and performance expectations.

  • Evaluate vendor proposals, negotiate routine pricing and contract terms, and approve purchases within established authority limits.

  • Monitor vendor performance against agreed service standards and recommend improvements or alternative providers when necessary.

  • Maintain accurate vendor documentation, contracts, and compliance records.

  • Identify potential vendor-related risks and escalate significant contractual or financial matters to leadership.

Operational Systems & Technology

  • Own the administration, organization, and continuous improvement of the company's operational tools and technology platforms.

  • Evaluate new software and AI-powered solutions, recommend improvements, and manage implementation and onboarding.

  • Troubleshoot operational system issues and coordinate with vendors when additional technical support is required.

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve productivity through technology.

  • Ensure operational systems support business objectives and remain organized, efficient, and scalable.

Process Design & Operational Improvement

  • Analyze existing workflows, identify operational inefficiencies, and independently develop improved processes.

  • Create, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), operational playbooks, and training documentation.

  • Establish clear workflows, quality control checkpoints, and accountability standards.

  • Identify operational risks and proactively implement corrective actions within the scope of the role.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, reduce manual work, and support business growth.

Financial & Administrative Management

  • Monitor operational budgets, track expenditures, and flag potential variances.

  • Manage routine procurement decisions for software, supplies, and services within approved spending limits.

  • Maintain organized financial and administrative records.

  • Support leadership with operational reporting, expense tracking, and administrative planning.

Business Development & Revenue Support

  • Proactively contribute to revenue-generating activities when operational priorities are under control.

  • Research and qualify prospective clients, develop targeted prospect lists, and identify potential business opportunities.

  • Support outbound prospecting through personalized email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach, follow-ups, and lead nurturing.

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, track pipeline activity, and coordinate next steps with the business development team.

  • Prepare sales presentations, proposals, pitch decks, case studies, and other business development materials.

  • Coordinate go-to-market initiatives, including sales meetings, webinars, industry events, and strategic partnerships.

  • Support the agency's own marketing initiatives, including newsletters, social media, and content coordination.

  • Collaborate with leadership to identify opportunities to improve prospect engagement and accelerate the sales process.

Qualifications

Required

  • 3+ years of experience in executive support, business operations, administrative management, or a similar role involving significant independent responsibility.

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in sales, business development, or marketing, including prospecting, pipeline development, outbound outreach, or campaign support.

  • Advanced English proficiency (C1 or higher), with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting senior executives or managing operational functions with minimal supervision.

  • Proven ability to independently manage vendor relationships, including negotiations, performance monitoring, and contract coordination.

  • Experience designing, documenting, implementing, and improving operational processes.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Sound business judgment, with the ability to make independent decisions and recognize when leadership involvement is necessary.

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and experience administering business software and operational platforms.

  • Practical experience using AI tools, such as ChatGPT or Claude, to improve research, communication, sales, and operational efficiency.

  • A proactive, commercially minded approach, with the ability to identify opportunities to contribute to business growth.

  • Ability to work independently and maintain accountability in a fully remote environment.

  • Reliable high-speed internet and a professional remote workspace.

  • Full availability to work U.S. Pacific Time business hours.

Preferred

  • Previous experience working in a digital marketing agency, performance marketing company, eCommerce business, or B2B services environment.

  • Experience supporting founders, CEOs, or other C-suite executives with delegated decision-making responsibilities.

  • Hands-on experience with CRM and project management platforms such as HubSpot, Asana, Monday.com, or Notion.

  • Familiarity with TikTok Shop, Meta Ads, Google Ads, or social commerce operations.

  • Experience creating SOPs, operational playbooks, and process documentation from scratch.

  • Experience with sales prospecting tools, marketing automation, or AI-powered workflow automation.

  • Background in business development, lead generation, or outbound sales for agencies or professional services companies.

What Success Looks Like

  • Leadership can confidently delegate operational responsibilities, knowing that priorities are managed and commitments are consistently fulfilled.

  • Executive calendars, communications, and administrative responsibilities run smoothly with minimal supervision.

  • Vendor relationships are professionally managed, cost-effective, and aligned with business needs.

  • Operational systems and workflows become increasingly efficient through automation, documentation, and continuous improvement.

  • The business development team receives meaningful support through prospect research, outreach, pipeline management, and sales preparation.

  • You consistently identify opportunities to solve problems, improve processes, and contribute to the company's growth without waiting for instructions.

Who We're Looking For

You are an organized, resourceful, and entrepreneurial professional who enjoys operating at the intersection of executive support, business operations, and growth.

You are comfortable working directly with founders, taking responsibility for important business functions, and making thoughtful decisions independently.

You don't simply complete assigned tasks. You anticipate what needs to happen next, identify opportunities for improvement, and take action.

Most importantly, you understand that supporting leadership means creating capacity for the business to grow, whether through operational efficiency, better systems, stronger vendor relationships, or direct contributions to revenue-generating activities.

Work Arrangement & Compensation

  • Location: Remote – Latin America

  • Employment Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor

  • Monthly Compensation: $1,500–$2,600 USD, depending on experience and qualifications

  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, approximately 8:30 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Pacific Time

This is a remote/telecommute position.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.excerpt: American farmers have made tremendous technology advancements through hardware improvements and investments in precision agriculture.
jobs.description:
American farmers have made tremendous technology advancements through hardware improvements and investments in precision agriculture. However, when it comes to the back-office, most farms are decades behind, relying on spreadsheets, filing cabinets, and decades-old on-prem software to recruit, manage, and pay their workforce. Seso is addressing this problem by modernizing the back-office for the farm.

Our mission is to build the premier platform for agribusiness to hire and manage their workforce and improve the lives of agricultural workers. We are addressing American farmers’ biggest pain point - access to qualified labor - through a software-enabled labor solution that automates the H-2A visa. Our comprehensive HR platform streamlines and automates the hiring process for farms and seamlessly integrates their efforts across recruitment, onboarding, payroll, and insurance while providing workers access to financial services for the first time.

Seso has raised over $60M from Tier I investors including Index, Founders Fund, and Mary Meeker at Bond, and has been recognized with awards including Forbes Rising Stars and Andreessen Horowitz's American Dynamism 50.

About the Role

Seso’s modern platform provides employers with orders of magnitude increases in efficiency, while helping them stay compliant and communicate with their workforce. We’re looking for a senior Product Manager to own new initiatives for Seso’s HR Platform which serves as employer’s employee system of record and streamlines numerous workflows across collecting employee information, onboarding employees, and managing the employee lifecycle.

The role has both a high level of autonomy and ownership. You will be responsible for facilitating business outcomes related to our HR platform. (Think working at high abstraction levels to solve key company business goals vs. solve a specific problem). Your team will be regularly shipping software which meaningfully improves the lives of our customers and farmworkers, and regularly interacting with customers across the country.

Responsibilities

  • Owning and delivering on company-level business objectives
  • Working closely with design, engineering, and revenue stakeholders to define a cohesive product strategy and roadmap
  • Translating ambiguous or complex ideas into clear, executable projects
  • Spending time to deeply understand and elevate the voices of our users
  • Combining qualitative research with quantitative analysis to inform product decisions
  • Owning and driving the product lifecycle from ideation through implementation and launch

Skillset

You may be a good fit for this role if:

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a product manager
  • You’re a structured problem-solver with an interest in improving the lives of agricultural farmworkers and the viability of the agriculture industry
  • You are interested in autonomously owning a roadmap
  • You like talking to customers and can quickly build credibility and trust
  • You have a strong track record of delivering key business results
  • Can travel 25% of the time

Benefits

  • Talented and fun teammates who don't take themselves too seriously
  • Competitive Salary and meaningful equity
  • Excellent medical and dental insurance plans
  • Flexible work schedule and PTO
  • Budget and support for personal development
  • Last week of the year off for company wide winter break
  • Company sponsored team events

Comp range: up to $230,000 annually

We carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors to determine your personal top of market. We rely on market indicators to determine compensation and consider your specific job related skills and experience for accuracy. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary and will also be dependent on your location.

Diversity is more than a commitment at Seso, it is the foundation of what we do. We pride ourselves on building the premier platform that serves agribusiness and improves the lives of agricultural workers. We believe in diversity of race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ethnicity, national origin and all the other fascinating characteristics that make us all feel welcome.

jobs.excerpt: Gjør livet tilgjengeligBli en del av vår suksesshistorie!
jobs.description:
Gjør livet tilgjengelig

Bli en del av vår suksesshistorie! iLOQ er et internasjonalt teknologiselskap som tilbyr selvforsynte digitale låse- og mobile tilgangsstyringsløsninger som har revolusjonert låsebransjen ved å muliggjøre batterifri og kabelfri digital låsing. Vår teknologi gir høy datasikkerhet, uovertruffen tilgangskontroll og kostnadseffektiv livssyklusadministrasjon, noe som gir betydelige besparelser for kunder innen flerboligsektoren, kritisk infrastruktur, helsevesenet, utdanningssektoren, næringslivet og universitetssektoren.

iLOQ ble grunnlagt i Finland i 2003 og har etablert en sterk tilstedeværelse i mer enn 13 land. Selskapet er anerkjent som markedsleder innen bærekraftige digitale låse- og tilgangsdelingsløsninger.

Er du en dyktig, motivert og flittig teknisk sjef med en lidenskap for banebrytende mobilteknologi og digitalisering, og som alltid er på jakt etter bedre og mer effektive måter å gjøre ting på?

I så fall søker iLOQ nå etter en digitalt orientert teknisk sjef som kan bli en del av teamet vårt.

Hva du skal gjøre

Som teknisk sjef vil du spille en nøkkelrolle i iLOQ Norge. Vår banebrytende teknologi skaper stor etterspørsel, og du vil ha ansvaret for å støtte våre kunder og salgsapparatet på tvers av flere bransjer, samt forvalte hele vårt sortiment av bærekraftige låse- og adgangsstyringssystemer, elektromekaniske låser, sylindere og digitale låseløsninger.

Du vil også fungere som prosjektleder og ha ansvar for integrasjonen av iLOQ-applikasjonen med ulike programvareplattformer for å sikre en markedsklar implementering samtidig som prosjektfrister overholdes.

Dette er en stilling som kan utføres på fjernbasis, med forventede reiser til partner- og kundelokaler: stillingen rapporterer til landssjefen

Hovedansvarsområder:

  • Gjennomføre produkt- og programvareopplæring for ILOQ Norges salgsteam, nye kanalpartnere og sluttbrukere/kunder.
  • Kontinuerlig utvikle og oppdatere opplæringsmateriell (innhold, dokumentasjon, prosesser osv.) og sikre vellykket implementering gjennom regelmessig oppfølging med interne og eksterne interessenter.
  • Administrere og koordinere informasjonsutveksling med iLOQs tekniske ledere i andre regioner.
  • Støtte produktintegrasjon med sluttbrukerdatabaser ved hjelp av API-er.
  • Gjennomføre markedsundersøkelser for å prioritere nødvendige programvareintegrasjoner innen flerfamilieboliger, boligsektoren og næringssektoren for å sikre en smidig markedsintroduksjon.
  • Fungere som hovedkontaktpunkt for IT-relaterte saker, både internt og eksternt.
  • Gi teknisk salgsstøtte, inkludert tilbud, kontrakt- og anbudshåndtering, samt håndtering av komplekse tekniske henvendelser.
  • Samarbeide på tvers av funksjoner med team innen FoU, produktledelse, forsyningskjede, salg, markedsføring og tjenester.
  • Støtte kanalpartnere, fremme kundetilfredshet og bidra til å forbedre Net Promoter Score (NPS).
  • Holde seg oppdatert på bransjetrender, konkurrenters produkter, nye teknologier og produktutvikling.
  • Opprettholde iLOQs kjerneverdier og forpliktelse til innovasjon

Hva du bør ha med deg

  • Minimum 5 års relevant yrkeserfaring, hvorav minst 3 år i en teknisk opplæringsrolle innenfor en lignende produktsektor (EAC, AI, døråpningssystemer, låser, adgangskontroll, smarte låser osv.).
  • Teknisk utdanning er ønskelig, men ikke et krav.
  • Sterke prosjektledelsesferdigheter med erfaring fra tverrfaglig og internasjonalt samarbeid, herunder med eksterne integrasjonsingeniørfirmaer.
  • God forståelse av moderne mobilteknologier, digitaliseringstrender og elektromekaniske digitale løsninger.
  • Omfattende IT-kompetanse, spesielt innen API-er.
  • Erfaring fra produktledelse, FoU eller salg er en fordel.
  • Erfaring med flerkanalsalg til ulike kundetyper og bransjer er en fordel.
  • God kjennskap til MS Office, spesielt PowerPoint.
  • Eksepsjonelle ferdigheter innen kundeservice og kommunikasjon (både muntlig og skriftlig).
  • En strukturert tankegang med stor oppmerksomhet på detaljer.
  • En positiv holdning med evne til å jobbe effektivt på tvers av flere avdelinger og globale kontorer.
  • Analytiske evner med sans for kompleks problemløsning og tidsstyring.
  • Selvstendig, organisert og pragmatisk – du tar initiativ og får ting gjort

Hva du får

Vi tilbyr deg en arbeidsplass i en samarbeidsorientert og fremtidsrettet bedriftskultur. Du vil jobbe i et dynamisk miljø der du får utfordrende oppgaver og ansvar, samt mangfoldige muligheter til å utvikle deg selv og dine faglige ferdigheter.

Du vil få en reell mulighet til å gjøre en virkelig forskjell i et raskt voksende internasjonalt selskap og påvirke arbeidsmiljøet i hele selskapet. Vi vil ta vare på deg ved å tilby en utmerket innkjøring med vennlige, hjelpsomme og engasjerte kolleger, muligheten til å jobbe med toppmoderne teknologi og bærekraftige produkter, samt muligheter for personlig og faglig utvikling i et internasjonalt selskap med dype skandinaviske røtter og verdier.

Vi er opptatt av å fremme en inkluderende arbeidsplass der mangfold verdsettes og alle ansatte blir behandlet med respekt. Vi oppfordrer søkere med alle typer bakgrunn til å søke og bli med oss i arbeidet med å fremme en inkluderende og mangfoldig arbeidsplass.

Er du interessert:

Vennligst send søknad så snart som mulig, senest 15.10.2026.

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve.
You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated.

  • Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points.

  • Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira.
  • Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint.
  • Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts.
  • Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made.
  • Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage.
  • Support sprint demos and coordinate user acceptance testing with clients.

  • Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts.
  • Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions.
  • Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction.
  • Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs.

  • Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS.
  • Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects.

Company Benefits

  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

The strategist does not handle direct web design, but must have strong CRO experience to boost campaign effectiveness.

The national offices of the Presbyterian Church (U.S.A.), A Corporation (“A Corp”) “PC(USA)”, based in Louisville Kentucky, serve with mid-councils, congregations, worshipping communities, and partner organizations to carry forth the mission of Jesus Christ. Approximately 400 individuals, diverse in race, age, gender, sexual orientation, faith, skills, and more, come together as colleagues to work for a world where justice reigns, peace prevails, and God’s love extends to all people. This community comprises the staff of national entities: the Presbyterian Life & Witness, the Presbyterian Publishing Corporation, Presbyterian Women, Investment and Loan Program, and the Administrative Services Group.

Basic Commitment: This position calls for a commitment to the mission of the Presbyterian Church (U.S.A.) as noted in its theological confessions, the Book of Order, and the actions of the General Assembly.

Position Summary

The Grant Management Office (GMO) Strategist/Analyst serves as the agency’s lead for grant reporting, impact analysis, and grant Review (selection) design and management within the AkoyaGo Grant Management System (GMS). This role ensures that grant decisions and outcomes are transparent, equitable, data‑informed, and aligned with Presbyterian Life & Witness (PL&W) values and priorities.

By combining reporting and impact analysis with stewardship of the Review process, this position strengthens faithful use of restricted funds, supports consistent grantmaking practices across ministries, and equips leadership with actionable insights to guide mission‑driven decisions.

Primary Responsibilities

1. Grant Review (Selection) Strategy & Management

Using AkoyaGo’s Review framework, the Strategist/Analyst will:

  • Partner with grant sponsors and program staff to:
    • Define review goals and selection methods aligned with program purpose and PL&W priorities
    • Determine appropriate review models (e.g., staff, peer, hybrid, panel)
  • Configure Review processes in AkoyaGo, including:
    • Reviewer assignments and access
    • Scoring criteria and weights
    • Review forms and interfaces used to record scores, recommendations, and observations
  • Recruit, onboard, and manage review teams, including:
    • Developing reviewer guidance and expectations
    • Coordinating timelines and communication
    • Monitoring progress and addressing bottlenecks or concerns
  • Evaluate Review outcomes and methodologies to:
    • Assess equity, consistency, and effectiveness
    • Identify bias, misalignment, or unintended barriers
    • Recommend improvements to strengthen future grant cycles

2. Grant Reporting & Impact Analysis

The Strategist/Analyst will lead enterprise‑level reporting by:

  • Designing and maintaining standardized grant reports that support:
    • Leadership decision‑making
    • Program evaluation and learning
    • Accountability and stewardship of restricted funds
  • Analyzing grant data across programs to:
    • Identify trends, outcomes, gaps, and emerging needs
    • Support assessment of alignment with PL&W mission priorities
  • Ensuring reporting standards and definitions are applied consistently across programs
  • Partnering with Communications, Development, and program staff to translate data into meaningful narratives about grant impact

This role supports sustainable use of the GMS by:

  • Maintaining consistent configuration standards for Review and reporting
  • Supporting data quality, validation, and documentation practices
  • Identifying system improvements and workflow refinements
  • Partnering with IT, Finance, and Legal as needed to support integrations and compliance

The Strategist/Analyst will:

  • Develop and deliver training for:
    • Grant administrators
    • Reviewers
    • Program and mission staff
  • Provide ongoing consultation and troubleshooting support
  • Create user‑friendly documentation and guidance materials

Scope & Impact

This role influences how millions of dollars in mission‑critical grants are selected, evaluated, and reported. By shaping Review processes and impact reporting, the Strategist/Analyst directly supports equity, transparency, and faithful stewardship—core commitments of Presbyterian Life & Witness.

We have just brought the platform fully in-house, and you will be the person who makes it boringly reliable: deployed safely, monitored properly, backed up provably, and secure enough to hold student visa and identity documents.

What you’ll do


  • Assess and harden our estate across Linode and DigitalOcean, fronted by Cloudflare — topology, regions, MongoDB, storage — and own the resilience plan from day one, against defined targets: 99.9% uptime, 4-hour recovery from total provider failure (RTO), no more than 1 hour of data loss (RPO).

  • Build the 3-2-1 backup regime: hourly encrypted MongoDB dumps to a second region, automatic off-provider replication, a local encrypted archive — proven by monthly restore drills, not assumed to work.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD for our MEAN-stack application so releases ship with zero downtime — rolling restarts behind a load balancer, then blue-green — with the QA team’s automated suite wired in as a release gate.

  • Manage cloud costs across providers, report spend monthly, and evaluate consolidation or AWS-based recovery on evidence — our current position is hardened-in-place with off-provider backup.

  • Document everything as runbooks usable by our two engineers without you on the call — a small team means no tribal knowledge.

What we’re looking for


  • 4+ years running production infrastructure for a live web application, including at least one platform you were personally accountable for.

  • Hands-on with the pieces we run: Linux servers on Linode/DigitalOcean (or similar VPS providers), Cloudflare (DNS, caching, WAF), Docker, and CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or similar); infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or Ansible) strongly preferred.

  • MongoDB operations in production: replica sets, backups, restores and migrations under load.

  • Deploying and operating Node.js applications — our stack is MEAN (MongoDB, Express, Angular, Node).

  • Evidence of security thinking: hardening, secrets management, access reviews; experience preparing for or remediating a security audit is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable being the only infrastructure person: pragmatic, communicative, biased to documentation and automation over heroics.

Nice to have

Experience in edtech, CRM-style platforms or other systems holding sensitive personal data; UK GDPR / Cyber Essentials familiarity; experience taking over a platform from a departing team.

Remote from India, employed through an employer-of-record or as a direct contractor (agreed at offer). Company laptop provided.

Responsibilities

Technical Debt Reduction & Legacy Modernization

  • Systematically identifies, prioritizes, and remediates technical debt across existing codebases, partnering with Engineering Leads to build and execute a structured modernization backlog.
  • Refactors and re-platforms legacy .NET and C# applications onto modern, cloud-native architectures - improving maintainability, performance, and scalability without disrupting active product delivery.
  • Decomposes monolithic systems into clean, loosely-coupled microservices and APIs, establishing clear domain boundaries and reducing interdependencies that slow delivery velocity.

  • Uses AI-assisted tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to analyze legacy code at scale - accelerating impact analysis, generating refactoring candidates, and producing documentation for undocumented systems.

Cloud-Native Re-platforming

  • Migrates workloads from legacy infrastructure to cloud-native patterns on AWS, leveraging Lambda, containers (ECS/EKS), Step Functions, Temporal, and managed services to reduce operational overhead and improve scalability.
  • Applies modern software design patterns - including event-driven architecture, CQRS, and domain-driven design - to re-architected systems, positioning them to support future innovation and client scale.
  • Implements database migration and schema modernization using Flyway, ensuring safe, versioned transitions away from legacy data models.
  • Builds containerized services using Docker, establishing consistent deployment and runtime environments across development, staging, and production.
  • Authors infrastructure-as-code using Terraform or AWS CDK to replace manual, brittle environment configurations with repeatable, auditable provisioning.

Standards, Simplicity & Scalability

  • Champions engineering simplicity as a first-class design principle - pushing back on unnecessary complexity and advocating for solutions that are easy for the next Engineer to understand and change.
  • Establishes and documents patterns for modernized systems, creating reusable blueprints that accelerate future re-platforming efforts and provide a consistent architecture baseline across the Engineering organization.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Canada Scaled Customer Success team advises and guides our Scaled customer base, ensuring they implement and adopt Samsara, and continuously gain business value from our products using digital communications and self-serve resources. As the manager of the Scaled Customer Success team, you will improve our Scaled Customer Success motion, provide focused coaching for each team member, and be an inspiring leader who establishes an energizing team culture for the team.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Canada.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Hire, onboard, and develop a high-performing team of ICs and CSMs covering the Canada (Mid-Market) segment.
  • Manage individual performance
  • Deliver results across team KPIs and org level OKRs
  • Identify and implement process-improvement opportunities; such as systems efficiency gains and leaning into data resulting in increased automation
  • Lead from the front with a willingness to get hands dirty

Team Leadership & Performance

  • Hire, onboard, and develop a high-performing team of CSMs covering the Canada (Commercial & Mid-Market) segment.
  • Set clear expectations, goals, and KPIs (e.g., net revenue retention, adoption rates, health scores, business review and implementation completion, risk management).
  • Run structured 1:1s, pipeline reviews, and risk reviews; deliver consistent coaching and developmental feedback.
  • Recognize and grow top talent; address underperformance quickly and fairly.
  • Manage capacity and account assignment across a high-volume book to balance IC and CSM workload and customer coverage.

Digital Scale Program Ownership

  • Own and continuously improve the Digital Scale journey for Canada.
  • Define and execute digital plays (onboarding sequences, adoption campaigns, renewal outreach, health score triggers) in partnership with Marketing and CS Operations.

Customer Outcomes & Execution

  • Ensure the team drives measurable value for Commercial and Mid-Market customers through structured onboarding, adoption, expansion, and renewal motions.
  • Review and elevate the quality of Customer Success Plans, Business Reviews, and executive-ready materials across the portfolio.
  • Oversee book-of-business risk management, ensure early identification, clear ownership, and documented action plans for at-risk accounts.
  • Support ICs and CSMs in high-stakes customer moments (Implementation kickoffs, QBRs, escalation calls, executive check-ins) as needed.

Strategy, Process & Enablement

  • Translate company and CS strategy into a clear operating model for the Commercial and Mid-Market segment, defining cadence, plays, and standards for both low-touch and digital motions.
  • Standardize and improve core processes across Canada (onboarding-to-steady-state handoff, BR cadence, risk playbooks, escalation paths).
  • Use data and tooling (CS platform, CRM, product analytics, digital engagement tools) to monitor performance, surface insights, and guide team decisions.
  • Partner with Enablement to ensure the team has the skills, playbooks, and resources to succeed across a distributed, high-volume territory.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary CS point of contact for Sales, Renewals, Services, and Support leaders for the segment.
  • Partner with Sales on account planning, expansion strategy, and commercial alignment across Mid-Market accounts.
  • Provide structured feedback to Product and Operations on recurring customer themes, friction points, and feature gaps specific to the Commercial and Mid-Market segments.
  • Represent the Scale customer voice in internal forums and influence roadmap and policy decisions.

Culture & Leadership

  • Model and reinforce the company's cultural principles: customer focus, growth mindset, inclusion, and teamwork.
  • Foster an environment of psychological safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Communicate clearly and regularly with senior leadership on progress, risks, headcount, and territory health.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 2+ years of experience managing a team
  • Experience implementing a scaled (low touch) onboarding or account management program. SaaS experience preferred.
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility that requires strong work ethic, prioritization, and high emotional intelligence
  • Experience with a customer success CRM such as Gainsight or Totango
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem solving skills
  • Comfort in a fast-paced, performance-based, and change-heavy environment
  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$134,172.50—$173,635 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

About the Company:

The Client is a New Zealand-based B2B wholesaler supplying an extensive range of adult lifestyle products, lingerie, personal wellness products and related accessories. The client also supports retail and online partners through a broad product range, recognised brands, reliable stock availability and responsive customer service.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a creative and commercially focused Content Designer / Video Editor who is genuinely AI-native and passionate about the future of content creation.

The successful candidate will use AI tools to generate, edit and enhance engaging video and visual content, primarily for Facebook advertising and organic social media.

This is not a traditional graphic design or basic video-editing position. The role requires someone who actively follows developments in generative AI, experiments with new creative technologies and can turn ideas, products and proven content trends into polished, sales-focused creative assets.

The key objective is to produce a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that captures attention, creates engagement and supports product sales.

Key Responsibilities:

AI Content Creation

  • Generate original video concepts and creative assets using leading AI video, image, voice and editing tools.
  • Use generative AI to create scenes, backgrounds, product environments, animations, voiceovers and visual effects.
  • Transform product information, images and campaign ideas into engaging short-form video content.
  • Combine AI-generated assets with traditional editing techniques to produce polished, brand-appropriate content.
  • Experiment with new workflows and emerging AI capabilities to improve creative quality, production speed and output.
  • Maintain consistency in visual quality, tone and brand presentation across all content.

Video Editing & Production

  • Edit short-form videos for Facebook advertisements and organic social media channels.
  • Produce strong opening hooks, clear product messaging and effective calls to action.
  • Add captions, transitions, music, voiceovers, motion graphics and visual effects where appropriate.
  • Reformat and adapt content for different placements, dimensions and audience segments.
  • Create multiple creative variations for testing, including alternative hooks, visuals, scripts and calls to action.
  • Ensure all final content is technically accurate, polished and ready for publication.

Content Research & Creative Strategy

  • Monitor current AI-content developments, social media formats, advertising trends and creative techniques.
  • Research successful content within relevant retail, ecommerce, personal wellness and lifestyle categories.
  • Identify high-performing creative approaches that can be ethically adapted to the client’ products and audiences.
  • Build and maintain a library of creative references, hooks, concepts and emerging content formats.
  • Contribute fresh campaign and content ideas designed to increase engagement and generate sales.
  • Recommend practical opportunities to use AI to improve creative output and production efficiency.

Advertising & Social Media Content

  • Prioritise creative production for Facebook advertising and social media rather than general website design.
  • Develop content that captures attention quickly and communicates a clear product benefit or campaign message.
  • Work with the business to understand priority products, promotions, customer segments and sales objectives.
  • Review available performance feedback and use it to improve future creative assets.
  • Refresh and iterate advertisements to reduce creative fatigue.
  • Ensure content is suitable for the intended audience, platform and placement.

Brand, Platform & Content Compliance

  • Produce professional content appropriate for an adult lifestyle and personal wellness brand.
  • Develop creative ways to promote products without relying on unnecessarily explicit imagery or language.
  • Apply sound judgement when presenting sensitive or mature products.
  • Understand and follow Meta and other social media platforms’ advertising and community requirements.
  • Adapt concepts and visuals to reduce the risk of advertisement rejection or account restrictions.
  • Check product claims, pricing and promotional information carefully before content is published.
  • Maintain confidentiality when handling campaign plans, customer information and unreleased products.

Tools & Systems

The successful candidate should be confident using a combination of AI and traditional creative tools, which may include:

  • AI video-generation platforms such as Runway, Kling, Veo, Sora or comparable tools
  • AI image-generation and enhancement platforms
  • Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut or DaVinci Resolve
  • Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or Canva
  • AI voiceover, audio-generation and captioning tools
  • Meta advertising and social media content platforms
  • Cloud-based file-management and collaboration systems

Candidates are not expected to have used every listed platform. However, they must demonstrate strong capability across relevant tools and the ability to learn emerging platforms quickly.

Requirements

  • At least two years of professional content creation, video editing or digital design experience, supported by strong hands-on capability with current AI creative tools.
  • Demonstrated experience generating video or visual content using AI-powered platforms.
  • A strong portfolio containing relevant video, advertising and AI-generated creative work.
  • Strong understanding of short-form video structure, opening hooks, pacing, storytelling and calls to action.
  • Ability to turn a basic brief or product idea into a complete creative concept.
  • Strong video-editing skills and a high standard of visual presentation.
  • Good written English and the ability to develop concise, engaging on-screen copy.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding that content must support engagement and sales outcomes.
  • Strong research skills and an active interest in new AI tools, creative techniques and social media trends.
  • Ability to manage multiple creative requests, meet deadlines and respond constructively to feedback.
  • Mature and professional attitude toward working with adult lifestyle and personal wellness products.
  • Reliable internet connection and a professional home-office environment.
  • Ability to work with the New Zealand team during agreed business hours.

Highly Desirable

  • Previous experience creating content for ecommerce, consumer product or retail brands.
  • Experience producing and iterating creative assets for Meta advertising campaigns.
  • Knowledge of advertising-platform requirements relating to adult, wellness or other sensitive product categories.
  • Experience with product animation, AI avatars, synthetic voiceovers or advanced motion graphics.
  • Understanding of creative testing, advertising performance and conversion-focused design.
  • Experience developing repeatable AI workflows, prompt libraries or content-production systems.

  • Industry Experience: Proven background in estimating, desktop surveying, or system design within Fire & Security.

  • Compliance Awareness: Working knowledge of relevant British Standards for fire and security installations.
  • Commercial Skills: Ability to calculate margins, estimate labor, and build accurate project costs.

jobs.title: Network Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: About Us: Effortless Office partners with our customers to make IT effortless so they can focus on their business.
jobs.description:
About Us:
Effortless Office partners with our customers to make IT effortless so they can focus on their business. As a Hybrid Managed Services Provider (MSP) with a focus on providing world-class customer experience, we deliver and fully support secure cloud solutions as well as comprehensive managed IT and network services.

About the Role:

Effortless is looking for a Network Operations Manager who is an excellent leader and engineer. This is a player-coach role: you will lead our network engineering team while remaining one of the company's top escalation and design resources for enterprise, high-availability, multi-platform networks.

You will own the health, security, and continuous improvement of the networks we manage for our customers and within our own Switch data center infrastructure. We expect you to be proactive: you will not wait for tickets. You and your team will regularly review client environments, find risk, capacity, and performance gaps before they become outages, and bring clear, cost-effective recommendations to our customers and Service Delivery Teams.

The ideal candidate has served as a Senior Network Engineer, has the technical depth to earn the respect of senior engineers, and has the leadership skills to develop them. You set a high standard, communicate clearly, take ownership, and care about the customer experience.

Position Details:

Reports to: President

Direct reports: Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers

Location: Remote with a preference for someone in/near Las Vegas, NV.

Travel: Some travel required for data center work, client site visits, and special projects.

Schedule: Monday - Friday 8:00-5:00 PST, with 24/7 escalation availability for major incidents and management of the team's on-call rotation.

Benefits:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401K + employer match
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Opportunities for career growth and development
  • Training and certification support

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Engineering Excellence

  • Serves as the company's senior network engineering authority and final escalation point in core routing and switching, network security, and network diagnostics.
  • Designs, reviews, and approves complex network configurations and architecture, including hardware and software technology, site locations, business continuity, disaster recovery, and integration of technologies.
  • Personally assesses and resolves the most complex data network problems and incidents, and leads major incident response through to resolution and root cause analysis.
  • Owns the design, standards, and lifecycle of Effortless's own network infrastructure at our Switch data centers, including Cisco Nexus, Firepower, and SDWAN (Meraki and Cisco Viptela) environments.
  • Sets and maintains network engineering standards, configuration baselines, and documentation requirements in IT Glue, and reviews the team's work for quality and consistency.
  • Reviews analyses and technical feasibility to develop data network deployment strategies, resource requirements, and cost estimates.

Proactive Client Improvement

  • Leads a regular program of proactive network reviews across client environments to find security, reliability, capacity, and performance gaps before they cause issues.
  • Uses Auvik monitoring, ticket trends in Autotask, and assessment data to identify recurring problems and drive permanent fixes rather than repeated reactive work.
  • Assesses data network growth forecasts and ensures business needs are translated into network capacity requirements.
  • Partners with Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, and ESAs to turn findings into clear, cost-effective recommendations for each client's technology roadmap.
  • Tracks hardware and firmware end-of-life, vulnerabilities, and configuration drift across managed networks and plans remediation.
  • Brings the customer's perspective to every recommendation: leads with business outcomes, not technology features.

Leadership

  • Hires, onboards, coaches, and develops Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers, including technical mentoring and certification planning.
  • Sets clear expectations, holds regular 1-on-1s, conducts performance reviews, and holds the team accountable using EOS tools (Rocks, Scorecards, Issues, To-Dos) in Strety.
  • Manages team workload, project priorities, and resource availability, and plans and coordinates cross-functional or cross-company work.
  • Owns network change management: reviews and approves changes, maintenance windows, and rollback plans.
  • Manages the team's 24/7 on-call rotation and escalation process, and ensures after-hours coverage meets Effortless's service standards.
  • Communicates status, risk, and outcomes clearly to leadership, Service Delivery Teams, and customers, following our CWC (Communicate, Work, Communicate) value.

Operations and Compliance

  • Defines, tracks, and reports on network operations KPIs (see Success Measures below).
  • Manages relationships with network vendors and carriers, including escalations, and supports procurement and licensing decisions.
  • Ensures all compliance aspects of the position and team are known and followed; understands and complies with all policies, codes, and regulations applicable to the position and company, including client HIPAA, PCI, and NIST requirements.
  • Maintains sensitive and confidential information regarding company and customer information.
  • Performs related duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

Education and Work Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, or a related technical field
  • 10+ years of experience with Service Provider, MSP, or enterprise networking or general telecommunications
  • 3+ years in a Senior Network Engineer (or equivalent) role, serving as the top escalation and design resource for complex networks (required)
  • 2+ years leading engineers as a manager, team lead, or technical lead, with direct responsibility for work assignment and mentoring
  • MSP or multi-client environment experience strongly preferred

Specialized Knowledge and Skills

  • Expert enterprise networking fundamentals, including complex switching and routing, high availability system design, advanced network security design, Internet services and protocols, and advanced network diagnostics.
  • Demonstrated expert proficiency in at least three of the following, with advanced skills in the balance: core routing, core switching, network security, network diagnostics, and application load balancing.
  • Top expert level analysis and design skills: gathering data on systems issues, defining alternative approaches, assessing business impact, and recommending, developing, and implementing cost-effective solutions.
  • A track record of proactively finding and fixing problems in environments you support, with examples you can walk us through.
  • Proven ability to lead, coach, and hold engineers accountable while staying hands-on.
  • Excellent oral and written communication, including explaining technical risk and recommendations to non-technical customers and executives.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, incidents, and people concurrently.
  • Advanced knowledge of current technologies, tools, applications, and vendors.

Certifications (preferred)

  • CCNP Enterprise or Security, or equivalent experience; CCIE a strong plus
  • Fortinet NSE, Meraki (CMNA/ECMS), or other vendor certifications
  • ITIL Foundation or similar service management certification

Equipment and Applications

  • Cisco Routers (ISR/ASR), Catalyst/Nexus Switches, Firepower and ASA Firewalls
  • Cisco Viptela and Meraki SDWAN; Meraki Firewalls, Switches, and Wireless
  • Fortinet Firewalls, FortiCloud, FortiClient
  • Sophos Firewalls and Wireless
  • SonicWALL Firewalls
  • Unifi LAN Devices
  • Ability to learn additional network platforms as needed
  • VMware virtualization platforms (Platform9 a plus)
  • Windows Servers and Services (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP)
  • Auvik Monitoring
  • Autotask PSA and IT Glue (or similar PSA and documentation platforms)
  • MS Office, Visio, and collaboration tools

Why Join EO?
At EO, our employees are what makes us special. We are a highly collaborative company with a very involved senior leadership team that invests in their staff. We strive to be a company where every employee has a voice, everyone takes pride in their work and gets satisfaction from helping people, and where every employee is constantly learning and driving improvements.  

 

We are aligned through our core values and seek employees that embody these: 

  • Service – we are dedicated to providing EFFORTLESS support and solutions. We ensure client and end user satisfaction in every interaction.  
  • CWC – this stands for Communicate, Work, Communicate, because communication is twice as important as the work we do.  
  • Perspective – we embrace the customer’s viewpoint to inspire confidence and meet expectations. 
  • Efficiency – we maximize output and minimize wasted time, effort, and resources. 
  • Passion – we bring energy and enthusiasm to everything we do and are driven by a commitment to excellence.  
  • Reliability – we consistency delivery on promises, follow through on commitments, and are dependable in all situations.  
  • Merit – we recognize and reward talent, hard work, and the pursuit of excellence.  

Inclusion & Equal Opportunity Employment 
Effortless Office is an equal opportunity employer committed to Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

You'll own growth strategy across customer acquisition, activation, monetisation, retention, reactivation and community, with a key focus on restoring sustainable recurring subscription growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines commercial thinking with strong analytical skills. You’ll be expected to test ideas, use data to identify what works, and build a scalable marketing function and team.

While there is no dedicated marketing team to inherit, you won't be working in isolation. You'll have direct access to existing business resources including fractional CTO/development, CFO and operational support, as well as an established educational content team. Growth & Revenue

Growth Channels & Experimentation

  • Own paid acquisition strategy and performance.

Lifecycle, Retention & Reactivation

  • Own lifecycle marketing across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention and reactivation.
  • Develop and optimise segmentation, campaigns and automations to improve conversion, customer value and retention.
  • Identify and test opportunities to reactivate former customers and convert existing free audiences.
  • Continuously analyse lifecycle performance and improve the customer journey.

Analytics & Reporting

  • Establish reporting for key growth and marketing metrics.
  • Analyse acquisition, conversion, subscription revenue, and retention data.
  • Turn data into clear insights and growth recommendations.
  • Work directly with the CTO/development team to improve tracking and measurement while continuing to test and execute growth initiatives.

Team Leadership

  • Build and structure the marketing function from the ground up.
  • Build and lead a growth/marketing team as the function develops.
  • Set priorities, processes, and performance expectations.

Community & Advocacy

  • Develop and test strategies to strengthen customer connection, advocacy, referrals, retention and organic growth.
  • Build community as a commercial growth asset rather than focusing solely on follower counts or surface-level engagement.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of progressive growth/marketing experience, ideally including senior ownership of commercial or revenue growth within a digital subscription or recurring-revenue business.
  • ActiveCampaign experience is highly desirable, along with strong experience using an equivalent lifecycle marketing or CRM platform.

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

What We’re Looking For

  • Someone who has owned commercial growth, not just individual marketing channels.
  • Someone who retains ownership of getting it done and keeps momentum.
  • A leader who can build and develop a team, not just work as an individual contributor.
  • Someone analytical and commercially minded who enjoys testing and learning.
  • Someone who takes ownership and accountability for measurable outcomes while continuously improving measurement, testing new approaches, and executing initiatives.

Job Title: Director, AI Automation Engineer

Location: Remote US

Reports to: SVP, Product | AI

Exemption Status: Full-time, exempt

Who We Are

Impiricus is the Agentic Commercialization Platform for Healthcare. We help life sciences teams understand physician intent, coordinate the right clinical and commercial resources, and enable real-time action when HCPs need support. Our AI-powered platform acts as a field force multiplier: extending reach between rep visits, prioritizing the highest-impact path for each physician, and connecting HCPs to coverage, evidence, medical information, patient support, MSLs, field teams, samples, and approved content in the moments that matter.

Founded by a practicing physician and a senior pharmaceutical executive, Impiricus was built to accelerate patient access to life-saving treatments through ethical, physician-first engagement. More than one million opted-in HCPs trust Impiricus as a preferred channel, including many who are underserved or hard to reach through traditional outreach. Products such as the Intelligently Optimized Network (ION), Pulse, Spark, and Ascend work together so every interaction can move from information to action. Guided by our Physician Advisory Board, we keep engagement clinically meaningful, compliant, and grounded in better patient care.

Job Summary The Director, AI Automation Engineer is a player-coach role: own the quality and reliability layer for everything the AI Organization ships, and stay hands-on building the harnesses, eval frameworks, and release gates that make that real.

That means automated testing infrastructure, evaluation frameworks, and CI/CD guardrails that let us stage, test, and manage AI agents and tools at scale. Coverage spans internal AI platform work (Sage and the tools built on it) and customer-facing AI across Ascend and DocUpdate.

This is the first dedicated hire into a function we expect to grow. The Director sets the bar, does the hardest technical work early, and grows into leading a small automation team as coverage expands. The goal is to keep AI Engineers and builders shipping without loading QA burden onto the core build team.

Partnership is daily with AI Engineers, AI Solutions Architects, and product teams shipping AI features: establish baseline quality metrics, automate validation, and make standards usable for engineers and non-engineers building in Sage.

Key Responsibilities

Testing Harness and Infrastructure

  • Own the infrastructure that continuously verifies whether autonomous agents are taking the actions we intend, before and after they reach production.
  • Stage, test, and lifecycle-manage bots and agent workflows before they reach production.
  • Establish baseline quality metrics and coverage standards for AI initiatives.
  • Build the infrastructure to run automated research chains and agent evals at scale.

Evaluation Frameworks

  • Create automated evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs: accuracy, safety, bias, and regression.
  • Implement RAG evaluation, prompt regression testing, and golden-set benchmarking.
  • Define and enforce quality thresholds that AI Engineers and builders must meet before ship.
  • Partner with AI Researchers and Engineers on eval design for new model and agent patterns.

CI/CD and Release Quality

  • Build the release-gating infrastructure that governs when an agent is trusted to act in production, including staged rollouts and rollback authority.
  • Develop AI automation solutions to ensure that agentic coding delivers highly functioning software while maintaining quality across the product portfolio
  • Integrate testing into GitHub Actions (or equivalent) for AI model and agent releases.
  • Maintain existing test suites and keep them current as models, prompts, and tools change.

Cross-Team Quality Partnership

  • Work with AI Solutions Architects on eval criteria for workflow automations they build in the field.
  • Partner with Principal AI Product on launch-readiness and QA for AI projects across the org.
  • Support product teams (Ascend, DocUpdate, Platform) on AI feature validation without owning their roadmaps.
  • Document standards, runbooks, and patterns so non-engineers building in Sage can self-serve basic testing.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 5+ years building, evaluating, or governing production AI/ML systems, with direct experience in agentic AI, LLM-based automation, or autonomous system safety
  • Direct experience evaluating LLM outputs: RAG eval, prompt regression, safety and accuracy benchmarking.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines with integrated test gates (GitHub Actions or similar).
  • Comfortable working across AI platform infrastructure and product-facing AI features.
  • Operates independently as a senior IC and communicates quality standards to engineers and non-engineers.
  • Experience with agent testing, bot lifecycle management, or AI agent orchestration platforms is a strong plus.
  • Familiarity with LLM observability and eval tooling (LangSmith, Braintrust, custom harnesses, etc.) is a strong plus.
  • Background in healthcare, pharma, or regulated environments where quality gates matter is a strong plus.
  • Prior experience standing up a QA or automation function from scratch, with appetite to grow into leading a team.
  • Proficiency in Python and standard testing frameworks (pytest or equivalent).

Compensation and Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $185,000 - $210,000

Where you land within the range will reflect your skills, experience, and location, while keeping team parity in mind and leaving room for future growth.

Important Notice

To protect candidates, please note that all communication from our team will come directly from an @impiricus.com email address. We do not engage third party recruiters to schedule interviews for this role. If you receive outreach from anyone outside of our domain claiming to represent Impiricus, please disregard and let us know by forwarding the message to
