LTS is seeking an experienced high-caliber TechnicalProject Manager to lead day to day execution of a major AI-powered modernization initiative within the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) health portfolio. This role will oversee the planning, coordination, execution, and delivery of complex AI-powered modernization efforts supporting mission-critical healthcare systems and enterprise transformation initiatives across the VA environment. This role will serve as the operational lead that will oversees AI/ML engineers, legacy healthcare systems specialist, DevSecOps practitioners, agile delivery teams, and cybersecurity professionals operating inside a federal governance environment.

The ideal candidate bridges deep AI and modern engineering fluency with the discipline required to operate in a FedRAMP/ATO environment under VA’s established IT governance and approval frameworks. Additionally, the ideal candidate will possess strong (VA) VistA knowledge, leadership, stakeholder management, and program delivery experience within large-scale federal healthcare or enterprise IT programs. This individual will work closely with internal leadership, government leadership, technical teams, architects, product owners, and operational stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of modernization initiatives involving legacy healthcare systems, enterprise integrations, infrastructure transformation, and Agile delivery environments.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and manage AI IT modernization projects supporting VA healthcare and enterprise transformation initiatives, ensuring delivery teams leverage AI platform outputs to accelerate analysis, documentation, and development.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams including AI/ML engineers, prompt engineers, legacy system specialists, development, infrastructure, cybersecurity, integration, and operations personnel across concurrent workstreams.
  • Develop and manage integrated program plans, schedules, resource allocations, risks, and deliverables across both an AI platform team and a modernization delivery team operating on overlapping timelines.
  • Facilitate Agile sprint execution across multiple concurrent scrum teams, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, ensuring AI-generated analysis is embedded in backlog development and acceptance criteria.
  • Track project progress, milestones, dependencies, sprint velocity, and budget considerations to ensure successful execution and on-time delivery of program proof points.
  • Support modernization efforts involving legacy VistA/MUMPS-based systems and enterprise healthcare applications.
  • Provide informed oversight of AI platform activities including legacy code ingestion, dependency mapping, workflow generation, and business rules extraction, ensuring platform outputs directly accelerate modernization delivery.
  • Operate within VA’s Veterans-focused Integration Process (VIP) framework, aligning sprint delivery, artifact production, and approval sequencing to VIP phase gates throughout the program lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with government leadership and program stakeholders to align project execution with mission objectives and strategic priorities.
  • Identify, manage, and mitigate project risks including those specific to AI-assisted delivery such as model output reliability, dependency mapping gaps, and data lineage requirements in federal environments.
  • Ensure compliance with VA, federal, and organizational governance, reporting, and documentation requirements, including DevSecOps standards, CI/CD pipeline governance, and VA development approval processes.
  • Facilitate status meetings, executive briefings, sprint reviews, and stakeholder communications, translating complex technical and AI delivery progress into mission-impact language for VA leadership.
  • Support change management, process improvement, and operational transition activities, ensuring modernization outcomes are positioned for sustained VA adoption beyond the pilot period.
  • Develop and maintain project documentation including program plans, schedules, risk registers, meeting minutes, action trackers, executive reports, and VA governance artifacts required at each phase gate.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on delivery excellence, AI output quality, team collaboration, and establishing reusable modernization patterns for future program application.
  • Coordinate ATO and FedRAMP planning activities from program inception, tracking SSP progress, ISSO engagement, security control mapping, and evidence collection so that accreditation is not a late-stage blocker.
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for day-to-day VA program office interactions, coordinating upward with executive leadership for strategic and client relationship matters.
  • Serve as the senior VistA technical authority, providing strategic direction and governance across solution design, implementation, and product development.
  • Lead SMEs, validate technical approaches and deliverables, and ensure the integrity, quality, and alignment of all outputs with customer objectives.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Information Technology, Healthcare Administration, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 10+ years of technical project or program management experience supporting enterprise IT or healthcare modernization initiatives, with at least 3 years leading AI, ML, or intelligent automation delivery programs.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex federal government IT programs, preferably within the VA or a major federal health agency with direct exposure to federal IT governance frameworks. Consideration will be given to experience within healthcare environments.
  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, Scrum practices, and hybrid project delivery models.
  • Fluency with AI/ML project lifecycles, model development, model development, prompt engineering pipelines, LLM-based applications, and AI platform integration into agile delivery workflows.
  • Fluency with VA VistA architecture, clinical and administrative workflows, MUMPS/FileMan-based development, system integration patterns, and VistA modernization efforts within agile delivery environments.
  • Experience supporting VA healthcare systems, VistA, CPRS, or VA Electronic Health Record modernization initiatives.
  • Familiarity with MUMPS-based healthcare systems and legacy modernization programs.
  • Experience managing technical teams supporting software development, infrastructure, integration, or cloud modernization initiatives.
  • Strong Agile/Scrum delivery background with experience managing concurrent scrum teams in federal environments. Coupled with Experience with DevSecOps in federal environments: CI/CD pipeline governance, branching strategies, automated security scanning, and alignment to VA or DoD DevSecOps standards.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience managing project schedules, risks, dependencies, and reporting activities.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and executive-level stakeholders.
  • Experience using project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a VA Public Trust clearance.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience supporting large-scale digital transformation or enterprise modernization efforts.
  • Knowledge of federal healthcare interoperability standards including HL7 and FHIR.
  • Experience working within DevSecOps and cloud modernization environments.
  • Working knowledge of VA’s VIP (Veterans-focused Integration Process) framework and ability to align sprint delivery, artifact production, and approval sequencing to VIP phase gates.
  • Direct experience navigating VA or federal ATO processes including FedRAMP, NIST 800-53 control frameworks, SSP development, and ISSO coordination. Or familiarity with federal cybersecurity and compliance frameworks including NIST and FedRamp.
  • PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, or other project management certifications preferred.
  • Prior experience supporting healthcare IT operations or clinical systems environments preferred.

Why Join LTS?

At LTS, we support impactful programs that directly improve healthcare services for Veterans nationwide. Our teams work on innovative modernization initiatives that help transform legacy systems into secure, scalable, and mission-focused digital solutions. This role is a rare opportunity to lead genuinely novel work at the intersection of AI platform engineering, legacy system modernization, and federal program delivery on one of the most complex and mission-critical healthcare IT estates in the U.S. government, with a lasting impact on the systems that serve those who served."

We value collaboration, integrity, and professional growth while empowering our people to contribute to meaningful federal missions. If you are ready to lead from the front on a program where AI meets federal delivery discipline, we want to talk.

Versant is seeking a SQL Database Administrator II to help ensure the reliability, performance, security, and ongoing improvement of our database environment across cloud and on-premises infrastructure.

In this Level 2 role, you’ll administer and troubleshoot SQL Server environments while also supporting relational database platforms such as MySQL and PostgreSQL. You’ll partner closely with Software Development, Data Engineering, QA, Infrastructure, and other technology teams to strengthen database operations through proactive monitoring, performance optimization, automation, observability, and resilient backup and disaster-recovery practices.

Success in this role means maintaining highly available database platforms, identifying and mitigating operational risks, resolving complex production issues, and continuously improving the tools and practices that support reliable database engineering.

Why This Role Matters: Our database platforms support critical applications and workflows across Versant. Your work will directly contribute to the stability, scalability, security, and recoverability of the systems our teams rely on to operate effectively.

This is a remote role based in Florida. While the position is primarily remote, employees should expect opportunities for in-person collaboration, team meetings, or company events approximately 10% of the time.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the health and reliability of SQL Server environments across Production, Staging, and Development, including SQL Server hosted on AWS RDS, maintaining availability in accordance with established SLAs, SLOs, RTOs, and RPOs.
  • Support and administer additional relational database platforms, including MySQL and PostgreSQL, as needed across cloud and on-premises environments, applying consistent standards for reliability, security, performance, backup, and recovery.
  • Monitor and optimize database performance and capacity using execution plans, Query Store, wait statistics, Extended Events, indexing analysis, observability platforms, and other diagnostic tools to proactively identify and resolve issues.
  • Strengthen database security and resilience by administering access and permissions using least-privilege practices and designing, implementing, testing, and validating backup, restore, high-availability, and disaster-recovery strategies.
  • Partner with engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle to improve T-SQL, query and schema design, indexing, CI/CD workflows, automated deployments, data migrations, integrations, and post-deployment validation.
  • Automate repeatable database operations and improve production support using infrastructure-as-code, PowerShell, and other scripting technologies while enhancing monitoring, alerting, dashboards, incident response, root-cause analysis, and technical documentation.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of hands-on SQL Server transactional database administration experience, including production database environments.
  • Strong SQL Server administration expertise across configuration, security, permissions, maintenance, backups, restores, troubleshooting, and operational support.
  • Strong experience with AWS database and infrastructure services, particularly RDS, Secrets Manager, S3, CloudWatch, and related technologies.
  • Advanced SQL Server performance analysis and optimization capabilities, including execution plans, Query Store, index design, wait statistics, blocking analysis, query tuning, Extended Events, and related diagnostic technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL Server concurrency and transaction behavior, including isolation levels, locking, blocking, and deadlocks.
  • Experience designing and supporting high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions, including Always On Availability Groups, backup and restore strategies, and RTO/RPO planning.
  • Strong proficiency in T-SQL and PowerShell, with experience using automation to improve database administration and operational workflows.
  • Working knowledge of MySQL and PostgreSQL administration, including configuration, monitoring, security, backup and restore, and troubleshooting in production environments.
  • Experience with source control and database CI/CD practices using Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Datadog, Prometheus, CloudWatch, or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot complex production database issues, perform root-cause analysis, manage assigned work, communicate risks and blockers, and escalate appropriately.
  • An associate’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Trust: Exercise sound judgment when managing production data, access, credentials, and critical database infrastructure.
  • Teamwork: Partner effectively with Software Development, Data Engineering, QA, Infrastructure, and other teams to solve problems and improve shared systems.
  • Transparency: Communicate database health, risks, incidents, blockers, and technical recommendations clearly and proactively.
  • Agility: Adapt to changing operational priorities, respond effectively to production incidents, and continuously improve database environments as business and technology needs evolve.
  • Entrepreneurial Spirit: Look for opportunities to automate manual work, improve database engineering practices, and build scalable solutions rather than relying on one-time fixes.

  • Experience with Python or Bash.

  • Experience supporting data integration, migration, or replication across systems and environments.

Why You’ll Love It Here

You’ll have the opportunity to work on database platforms that support Versant’s portfolio of media and entertainment businesses while collaborating with experienced technology teams across multiple disciplines.

Are you detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working across billing, accounts receivable, and client relationships? HWL is looking for a Financial Operations Specialist to join our team and help ensure our billing and collections processes run accurately, efficiently, and on time.


In this role, you’ll manage key aspects of the full-cycle billing and collections process, including billing through Vendor Management Systems (VMS), manual invoicing, timecard reconciliation, accounts receivable follow-up, and issue resolution. You’ll work closely with clients, staffing suppliers, account management, sales, and internal teams to keep accounts accurate and resolve billing and payment issues.

Billing & Accounts Receivable

  • Research and resolve missing timesheets, billing discrepancies, unapplied cash balances, and payment issues.
  • Respond to supplier and client billing inquiries and work toward timely resolution.
  • Contact new customers to confirm successful invoice delivery and help prevent payment delays.
  • Prepare billing, usage, discrepancy, reconciliation, and other financial reports as needed.
  • Maintain accurate, current, and complete billing and account records.

Collections

  • Contact clients and suppliers, as appropriate, regarding outstanding accounts receivable balances.
  • Research client billing questions and provide documentation needed to facilitate payment.
  • Partner with account management and sales teams to address outstanding balances.
  • Assist with payment arrangements for past-due accounts when appropriate.
  • Maintain detailed documentation of collection activities, communications, and payment arrangements.
  • Identify late, potentially late, and delinquent accounts and ensure appropriate follow-up.
  • Assist with complex or sensitive collection matters and preparation of accounts for further collection or legal action when necessary.
  • Perform collection activities in accordance with company policies, procedures, and applicable requirements.

Reporting & Collaboration

  • Develop and maintain reports that provide visibility into billing, collections, outstanding balances, and accounts requiring follow-up.
  • Partner with Sales, Account Management, Supplier Management, Finance, and other HWL teams to resolve account issues.
  • Keep the Controller and management informed of significant billing, reconciliation, or collection matters.
  • Participate in virtual and in-person meetings, client meetings, conferences, events, and other business activities as required.
  • Support special projects and additional billing, AR, and collections initiatives as needed.

What We’re Looking For

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; additional coursework in accounting, finance, or a related area is a plus.
  • 1–2 years of experience in billing, accounts receivable, accounting, payroll, collections, or a related function preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and timely follow-through.
  • Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable communicating professionally with clients, suppliers, and internal teams by phone and email.
  • Ability to research discrepancies and follow issues through to resolution.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and comfort learning and working within multiple computer systems.
  • Experience with Vendor Management Systems (VMS) or MSP environments is a plus.
  • Collaborative mindset and willingness to support teammates when needed.
  • Ability to meet E-Verify eligibility requirements.

What Success Looks Like

You’ll be successful in this role when billing is completed accurately and on time, discrepancies are identified and resolved quickly, accounts receivable receives consistent follow-up, and internal and external partners have clear communication around account status and next steps.


Our Values

At HWL, how we work matters just as much as the work we do. Our team is guided by three core values:

Others First — Put others before self.

Wisdom — Do the wise thing.

Growth — Keep getting better.

jobs.description:
Overview

We are looking for a VP of Product Strategy & Program Management to build and lead the operational and strategic backbone of our Product organization. This leader will own the connective tissue between product strategy and product execution - ensuring our roadmap is grounded in rigorous market intelligence, our launches land with commercial and customer impact, our cross-functional programs run predictably, and our product documentation is accurate, discoverable, and enterprise-grade.

This is a builder role. You'll stand up and mature four disciplines - Market Analysis, Launch Excellence, Program Management, and Product Documentation - inside a product organization that is scaling its maturity and rigor. You'll partner directly with the CPO, product line leaders, engineering, marketing, sales, and customer success to make sure great products actually reach the market and the market actually understands them.

Responsibilities

What You'll Own

Market Strategy & Analysis

  • Lead competitive intelligence, market sizing, and segmentation analysis that directly informs roadmap prioritization and portfolio strategy
  • Build repeatable frameworks for tracking market dynamics, buyer needs, and competitive positioning
  • Translate market insight into inputs product leaders and executives can act on - not just reports that sit on a shelf

Launch Excellence

  • Own the end-to-end launch framework: readiness criteria, cross-functional launch plans, tiering models, and post-launch retrospectives
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, and Customer Success to ensure every release has a commercial and adoption plan, not just a ship date
  • Establish the metrics that define launch success and hold the org accountable to them

Program Management

  • Build and lead a program management function that drives predictability across complex, cross-functional product initiatives
  • Own portfolio-level visibility: roadmap execution tracking, dependency management, risk escalation, and executive reporting
  • Instill lightweight but durable operating rhythms (planning cycles, status reporting, escalation paths) appropriate for a scaling PM organization

Product Documentation

  • Lead the team responsible for product documentation, release notes, and internal/external knowledge resources
  • Ensure documentation quality keeps pace with product complexity, particularly for enterprise and technical buyers
  • Build scalable documentation processes that reduce support burden and improve customer self-sufficiency

Team & Organizational Leadership

  • Hire, develop, and lead a team of market analysis, launch, program management, and documentation specialists
  • Define career pathing and craft standards for a discipline that is often under-resourced and under-defined - you'll be building the operating model, not inheriting one
  • Act as a force multiplier for the CPO, translating strategic priorities into operational execution across the product org

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • 10+ years in product strategy, product operations, program management, or a related discipline, with at least 3–5 years leading teams
  • Track record of building or significantly maturing a product operations, strategy, or program management function inside a scaling or transforming organization
  • Strong command of market analysis and competitive intelligence methods, and comfort turning ambiguous market signals into clear strategic recommendations
  • Demonstrated success running high-stakes product launches with measurable commercial outcomes
  • Program management rigor - you can run a portfolio, not just a project - with fluency in tools and frameworks for tracking cross-functional execution
  • Experience overseeing or partnering closely with technical documentation functions; you understand what “good” looks like for enterprise/technical audiences
  • Excellent executive communication skills; you can operate comfortably in front of the C-suite and PE/board audiences
  • Comfortable operating in an organization where product management maturity is still being built - you thrive on creating structure, not just working within it
  • Experience in enterprise software, legal technology, eDiscovery, or another complex B2B/enterprise domain is a plus

Why This Role Matters

Product strategy without execution rigor is just a slide deck. This role exists to make sure that doesn't happen - that every roadmap decision is grounded in real market understanding, every launch has a plan behind it, every cross-functional initiative has an owner and a rhythm, and every customer-facing document reflects the quality of the product itself. You'll report directly to the CPO and have a direct hand in shaping how the product organization operates as it scales.

Consilio’s True North Values

  • Client Experience | Listen for the “why”. Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
  • Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect. Welcome diverse views. Partner across geography, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
  • Innovation | Always be curious (ABC). Challenge the status quo. Experiment and fail forward. Build for the future.
  • Grit | Focus on what matters. Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner. Deliver results you’re proud of.

Presales and solutioning

Governance, operations, and adoption

jobs.description:
Sales Account Executive (B2B Sales & Full-Cycle Closing) – Remote | EST Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Eastern Time (EST)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Sales Account Executive to drive new business, manage the full B2B sales cycle, and build strong client relationships.

This is a hands-on, full-cycle sales role for someone who can take an opportunity from initial outreach through signed agreement.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Prospecting and generating new business
  • Running discovery calls and sales presentations
  • Managing opportunities through the pipeline
  • Negotiating and closing deals
  • Building long-term client relationships
  • Consistently achieving revenue targets

If you have a proven sales track record, communicate confidently with decision-makers, and enjoy owning revenue outcomes, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Full-Cycle B2B Sales

Own the complete sales process from prospecting through close:

  • Prospecting
  • Outreach
  • Qualification
  • Discovery calls
  • Sales presentations
  • Follow-up
  • Negotiation
  • Closing

Identify new business opportunities and maintain consistent activity across every stage of the sales funnel.

Pipeline Generation & Management

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities.
  • Generate new business through proactive prospecting and follow-up.
  • Prioritize opportunities based on fit, intent, and revenue potential.
  • Maintain strong follow-up discipline to keep deals moving.
  • Track pipeline activity, next steps, and expected close dates.

Discovery & Consultative Selling

  • Conduct structured discovery calls with prospective clients.
  • Understand business needs, pain points, priorities, and buying motivations.
  • Ask thoughtful questions to identify the right solution.
  • Tailor sales conversations and presentations to each prospect.
  • Communicate business value clearly rather than relying on feature-based selling.

Sales Presentations & Closing

  • Deliver professional sales presentations and solution recommendations.
  • Build credibility with business owners and decision-makers.
  • Handle objections confidently and professionally.
  • Negotiate pricing and commercial terms within approved guidelines.
  • Drive qualified opportunities toward clear decisions and successful closes.

Client Relationship Management

  • Build strong relationships with prospects and clients.
  • Maintain professional communication throughout the sales process.
  • Understand client goals and recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Support smooth transitions after the sale.
  • Identify opportunities for repeat business, referrals, or account growth where applicable.

CRM & Sales Reporting

Maintain accurate CRM records covering:

  • Prospect interactions
  • Sales activities
  • Pipeline stages
  • Follow-ups
  • Deal values
  • Next steps
  • Expected close dates

Provide leadership with clear visibility into pipeline health, sales activity, and revenue opportunities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with internal teams to:

  • Ensure smooth client handoffs after closing.
  • Communicate customer expectations accurately.
  • Share prospect and market feedback.
  • Support broader sales and revenue goals.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the sales process.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • 3+ years of experience in Sales, Account Management, Business Development, or a related revenue-generating role.
  • Proven ability to close deals and achieve revenue targets.
  • Experience managing the full sales cycle.
  • Strong pipeline management and follow-up discipline.
  • Experience using CRM systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • Strong negotiation and objection-handling skills.
  • Ability to build relationships with business owners and decision-makers.
  • Self-motivated, competitive, and results-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Availability to work EST hours.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • B2B sales experience.
  • Service-based sales experience.
  • Experience selling to business owners or senior decision-makers.
  • Remote sales experience.
  • Experience generating your own pipeline.
  • Consultative or solution-selling experience.
  • Strong forecasting and reporting skills.
  • Stable employment history with demonstrated career progression.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Enjoy both prospecting and closing.
  • Are confident leading sales conversations.
  • Know how to uncover a prospect’s actual business needs.
  • Build relationships without losing focus on revenue outcomes.
  • Follow up consistently and keep opportunities moving.
  • Are comfortable handling objections and negotiating.
  • Think in terms of pipeline, conversion, and revenue.
  • Take ownership of your targets rather than waiting for opportunities to come to you.
  • Thrive in fast-paced, performance-driven environments.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

A Sales Account Executive’s day may include:

  • Prospecting for new business opportunities.
  • Following up with active leads.
  • Running discovery calls.
  • Delivering sales presentations.
  • Speaking with business owners and decision-makers.
  • Handling objections and negotiating deals.
  • Moving opportunities through pipeline stages.
  • Updating CRM records and next steps.
  • Reviewing pipeline health and sales performance.
  • Coordinating internally on newly closed clients.

In short: you build pipeline, develop relationships, close deals, and directly drive revenue growth.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Monthly and quarterly revenue generated
  • Sales quota attainment
  • Qualified pipeline generated
  • Lead-to-opportunity conversion rate
  • Opportunity-to-close conversion rate
  • Number and value of deals closed
  • Pipeline health and deal velocity
  • CRM accuracy and reporting discipline
  • Client relationship quality and retention

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Fully remote opportunity.
  • Full ownership of the sales cycle.
  • Direct impact on company revenue.
  • Opportunity to work closely with leadership.
  • Performance-driven environment with strong earning potential.
  • High autonomy and ownership.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Account Executive
    • Enterprise Account Executive
    • Sales Manager
    • Business Development Manager
    • Sales Leadership

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening Call
  • Recruiter Interview
  • Final Client Interview
  • Background Verification
  • Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Intro Video

As part of the application process, you’ll be asked to complete a short Spark Hire intro video.

We’re particularly interested in hearing about:

  • Your B2B sales experience.
  • The products or services you’ve sold.
  • Your experience owning the full sales cycle.
  • How you generate and manage pipeline.
  • Your approach to discovery, objection handling, and closing.
  • Your track record against sales or revenue targets.
  • An example of a deal you successfully moved from initial conversation through close.

Keep your responses clear, concise, and conversational. We want to understand how you communicate with prospects, build relationships, and approach sales opportunities.

Completion of the Spark Hire intro video is required for your application to be considered.

Apply Now

If you:

  • Have 3+ years of sales experience.
  • Have a proven ability to close deals and hit targets.
  • Enjoy full-cycle B2B sales.
  • Are confident communicating with decision-makers.
  • Take ownership of pipeline and revenue.
  • Thrive in target-driven environments.

We’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and complete the required Spark Hire intro video to move forward in the hiring process.

jobs.description:
Founded in 1994, OBR is a provider of mission-critical cooling technology services, including repair and rebuild, inspection, maintenance, and related field services across the United States. Headquartered in Northwood, Ohio, with more than 450 employees, OBR serves a number of end markets through 12 offices, including semiconductor, water and wastewater, food and agriculture, power generation, commercial, healthcare, petrochemical, refinery, and data centers, among others. Backed by an experienced engineering team and deep expertise in the cooling technology space, OBR helps customers improve reliability, performance, and long-term system life.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Regional Health, Safety & Quality Manager (HSEQ) oversees, coaches, and enforces HSEQ measures during project planning and execution, including preparing safe work documentation.

This position supports the entire OBR Eastern US Region and plays a key role in integrating a recently acquired company, AMC, into OBR’s health, safety, environmental, and quality framework.

This is a remote position supporting the Eastern US Region. Ideal candidates should reside within the Greater New York City area or be in close proximity to NYC to effectively support regional operations and customer sites.

Travel is required and is expected to represent approximately 50% of the role. Frequent day and overnight travel throughout the Eastern Region will be necessary to conduct field audits, support project teams, perform site inspections, and ensure compliance with HSEQ standards.

ROLES/TASKS OF THE POSITION

  • Champion OBR safety and quality programs in the East Region.
  • Provide support outside of region as needed.
  • Lead and enforce OBR safety & quality policies, procedures, and risk strategies.
  • Perform regular field audits for OBR projects in the region.
  • Provide weekly activity reports for findings and deficiencies to identify reoccurring issues.
  • Train OBR Companies’ personnel on various HSEQ requirements.
  • Provide safety expertise across employees, clients, and facility operations, including OSHA compliance and incident investigations.
  • Strong knowledge of OSHA guidelines and workplace tools/equipment.
  • Identify hazards, implement corrective actions, and ensure job sites are planned and executed safely.
  • Collaborate with corporate safety, leadership, project management, and customer EH&S teams to develop and support safe work plans to meet expectations.
  • Conduct safety orientations, audits, inspections, and maintain required documentation (training records, hazard analyses, reports).
  • Develop site safety plans, JSAs, THAs, and safe work procedures for projects.
  • Investigate incidents, report findings, and verify corrective actions in a timely manner.
  • Manage safety equipment, onboarding of new crew members, and support regional safety performance.
  • Supervise and mentor field personnel; perform Site Safety Coordinator duties as needed.
  • Develop strong understanding of OBR quality policies and procedures.
  • Create project Inspection Test Plans (ITPs) to ensure OBR & customer quality requirements are met.
  • Support office and field personnel with Non-Conformance Report development, dispositioning, and tracking metrics.
  • Other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in occupational health and safety, management, or equivalent.
  • At least 5 years of experience in industrial health and safety role.
  • Certifications such as CSHO, CHST, ASP, or CSP preferred.
  • Skilled in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and Project.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing.
  • 1-2 years of quality control experience preferred.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSCIAL DEMANDS

Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of this role, with reasonable accommodation provided as needed. Requirements include:

  • Work outdoors or in plant environments with exposure to weather, heat, noise, and nearby hazardous chemicals.
  • Regular physical activities include standing, walking, sitting, climbing (stairs or structures).
  • Standing for extended periods or sitting for prolonged computer-based training.
  • Passing a pulmonary fit-test.
  • Perform keyboarding/typing and reading from screens or paper.
  • Work long shifts (10–12 hours, up to 13 consecutive days) in a fast-paced environment
  • Frequent travel, including overnight stays, and extended period spent visiting active construction and industrial job sites throughout the Eastern US Region.

.

PREREQUISITES & REQUIREMENTS

  • Negative 10 panel urinalysis and breath alcohol test.
  • Valid Driver's License and proof of U.S. Citizenship.
  • Satisfactory background check
  • Ability to maintain active status in DISA with a score of 2 or less
  • OSHA 30 Certification
  • Valid TWIC card preferred
  • Certification in CPR, First Aid and Blood Borne Pathogens
  • Silica Competent Person Training preferred

As an OBR Cooling Towers team member, you will enjoy:

  • Competitive Salary: A salary commensurate with experience and performance, with potential for bonuses and raises.
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Including medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees and eligible dependents.
  • Retirement Plan: A 401(k) plan with employer matching.
  • Health Savings Account: OBR providers employer contributions to your HSA.
  • Professional Development: Opportunities for training and workshops.
  • Tuition Reimbursement: up to$5,000 annuallyfor approved, job-related education and professional development opportunities for full-time salaried employees.
  • Life Insurance: OBR provides company-paid coverage, with voluntary options available for employees and their families.
  • Short Term Disability, Critical Illness, and Accidental Injury: Voluntary insurances options available.
  • Per Diem and Gas: OBR provides per diem and fuel reimbursement for business travel under company guidelines.

Our mission is to expand equitable access to mental health services through high-quality virtual care — and to support the clinicians and professionals who make that care possible.

We’re building a culture that is mission-driven, accountable, supportive, and built for sustainable remote work.

At VPM, you’ll be part of a team transforming access to youth mental health through virtual care — with a remote model designed to support excellent work and real life.

VPM is seeking Licensed Therapists to provide short-term, school-based tele-therapy to K–12 students across Virginia through a state-funded initiative in partnership with the Virginia Department of Education (VDOE).

This position focuses on delivering culturally responsive, evidence-based therapeutic services through a secure, HIPAA- and FERPA-compliant virtual platform. About Rocket Clicks

At Rocket Clicks, we help Family Law Firms grow through focused, performance-driven digital marketing.

We are not a generalist agency. We are building the definitive growth partner for family law firms by combining deep marketing expertise, real law firm operating experience, and a disciplined approach to execution.

Our team thrives on solving hard problems, improving client performance, and building trusted long-term relationships. We care about results, and we also care about how the work gets done.

Our culture is rooted in six core values:

  • Proactive – We anticipate opportunities and act before problems arise.
  • Disciplined – We remain focused and committed to excellence.
  • Candid – We communicate clearly and directly.
  • Empathetic – We understand and respect the perspectives of others.
  • Accountable – We take ownership of results, good or bad.
  • Results-Oriented – We focus on outcomes, not busyness.

If these values resonate with you, you’ll feel right at home at Rocket Clicks!

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Account Manager at Rocket Clicks, you will own the relationship with a portfolio of family law firms at the owner and managing partner level. You will lead the strategic conversation, build and maintain the plan each firm is working from, and connect their business objectives to the work our marketing team delivers. Project managers handle delivery and specialists execute the channels, which leaves you free to stay in the conversation that matters most to the client.

We are looking for an experienced account leader with genuine commercial instincts. Someone comfortable discussing revenue, pricing, and capacity with a business owner, and confident enough to challenge a plan that does not hold up under scrutiny. Providing that perspective is the substance of this role.

The position is scoped to a single practice area for a reason. Working across a dozen family law firms at once, you will begin to recognize the same intake breakdowns, the same gaps between consultation and signed fee, and the same capacity ceilings surfacing again and again. That accumulated pattern recognition is what gives your recommendations weight in the room.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own the relationship with a portfolio of family law firms, serving as the primary strategic contact for owners and managing partners.
  • Lead alignment calls and quarterly business reviews with decision makers, establishing clear agreement on goals, roles, timeline, and budget for the quarter ahead.
  • Build and maintain a strategic roadmap for each client, revisiting it quarterly so the plan reflects where the firm is now rather than where it was when the engagement began.
  • Track performance across the full client acquisition path, from initial lead through qualified lead, consultation, signed client, and funded agreement.
  • Extend the conversation beyond marketing into pricing, intake, operations, capacity, and hiring, where the real constraints on a firm's growth usually sit.
  • Identify growth opportunities and early signals of churn, raising both internally well before they surface with the client.
  • Review and approve every client-facing deliverable, making sure the work reflects the firm's goals and the context you hold on the relationship.
  • Maintain a consistent communication rhythm of a weekly written update, a monthly pacing call, and a quarterly business review with firm leadership.
  • Partner with project managers and channel specialists, giving them the business context they need to do their work well
  • Manage your portfolio as a whole, making deliberate decisions about where your time produces the most value across the book.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • 5+ years in account leadership, consulting, or professional services, preferably in an agency or advisory environment.
  • Significant experience owning senior client relationships, with a track record of working directly with business owners and executive decision makers.
  • Commercial fluency across revenue, pricing, margin, and expansion, and the comfort to discuss all of it candidly with a client.
  • Demonstrated ability to build plans that connect agency work to business outcomes, with defined timelines and milestones attached.
  • Strong facilitation skills and the judgment to guide a client toward a decision rather than waiting to be handed one
  • The ability to raise a difficult subject, whether an unrealistic goal or a number the client cannot produce, without damaging the relationship.
  • Experience recognizing early signals of client dissatisfaction and acting on them before they escalate.
  • Business experience outside of marketing, whether client-side, in a general management or P&L role, or as an owner.
  • Genuine curiosity about how professional services firms operate: how they price, staff, sell, and scale.
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing and developing people.
  • A background in or adjacent to the legal industry.
  • Familiarity with CRM data and intake operations.

BENEFITS:

  • Unlimited PTO & Sick Leave
  • Medical Insurance (including FSA & HSA Options)
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) (with a company match)
  • Life Insurance
  • Long-term Disability
  • Short-term Disability

You'll thrive here if...

  • You don't wait to be told what to do. You see the gap and you move.

  • You're an AI power user, not someone who's "open to learning it someday."

  • You communicate clearly, especially when things are unclear.

  • You can laugh at a chaotic week on Friday and mean it.

What we're looking for

  • Strong Python 3, Django REST Framework, and Celery

  • Strong React, Next.js, and TypeScript

You'll sit in a pod: one PM, one designer, two or three engineers. One senior engineer with Claude Code and parallel Git worktrees is expected to deliver what used to take a whole team. That's not a figure of speech.

We'll probably give you more to own than you expected. That's on purpose.

We use AI every day, across every function. That's just how we work.

What we stand for

  • We are obsessed with our customers, and making them obsessed with us

  • We figure it the f**k out

  • We go to war on our problems quickly

  • We are strategic. We work smart, not just hard.

  • We're fun AF

Search Atlas helps marketing teams move faster, make smarter decisions, and do more with less. We're a $30M+ ARR company, 215 people, bootstrapped, and building the infrastructure for the next era of marketing. No outside funding. No fluff. Just product.

PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.

PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. Overview

Divisional Head of Procurement & Procurement Business Partner

Location: United States, RemoteSalary: $143,901 – $197,864, depending on experience and qualifications. There may be flexibility for an exceptional candidate Preference for candidates based in or near the Northeast, with travel to company sites as required We’re looking for a senior procurement leader to take ownership of direct-material procurement across one of our divisions, while also connecting the business effectively with our Group Procurement team for indirect spend. This is a broad, hands-on leadership role. You’ll shape the divisional procurement strategy, strengthen how we manage suppliers and risk, and make sure group-led sourcing initiatives deliver results in practice, not just on a spreadsheet. The role is remote and can be based anywhere in the US. However, as many of our sites are in the Northeast, being based within reasonable reach of that region would be useful. You’ll need to travel to sites and suppliers when the work calls for it.

The role

You’ll lead and professionalise direct-material procurement across a complex, multi-site operation. That includes setting the strategy, building a clear pipeline of sourcing and cost-improvement activity, leading important supplier negotiations, and improving supply resilience.You’ll also act as the division’s main procurement business partner for indirect spend. You’ll make sure the division’s requirements are properly understood by Group Procurement and lead the local implementation of group agreements and category strategies. In short, you’ll help turn procurement plans into measurable business results.

Responsibilities

What you’ll do

  • Develop and run a divisional procurement strategy that supports commercial, operational and growth priorities.
  • Lead direct-material procurement across multiple sites, setting clear priorities, measures and ways of working.
  • Build and deliver category, commodity and supplier strategies covering cost, quality, delivery, service and resilience.
  • Create a prioritised pipeline of sourcing, negotiation, value-engineering and cost-improvement initiatives.
  • Lead strategic supplier negotiations, selection and contracting.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, quality, R&D and supply chain on specifications, standardisation, substitution, new-product introduction and make-or-buy decisions.
  • Improve supplier performance through effective segmentation, relationship management and structured reviews.
  • Identify and manage supply risks such as single-source dependency, capacity constraints, supplier financial weakness and geographic concentration.
  • Put in place practical mitigation and continuity plans for critical materials and suppliers.
  • Represent the division with Group Procurement, making sure business needs, forecasts, specifications and operational constraints are clearly understood.
  • Coordinate divisional involvement in group sourcing projects, supplier evaluations and implementation plans.
  • Lead the adoption of group agreements, approved suppliers and purchasing channels across the division.
  • Track savings, cost avoidance, working-capital improvements and other benefits through to financial realisation, not just theoretical claims.
  • Strengthen procurement processes, systems, data, governance and commercial capability across the division.
  • Lead and develop procurement colleagues, creating clear accountability without adding bureaucracy for the sake of it

Qualifications

What you’ll bring

  • Significant procurement experience gained in a complex, multi-site or international organisation.
  • Strong direct-material procurement experience within manufacturing, engineering or a similar industrial environment.
  • A track record of developing and delivering category, commodity and supplier strategies.
  • Evidence that you’ve delivered procurement savings and successfully converted them into financially recognised business benefits.
  • Strong sourcing, negotiation, contracting and supplier-management experience.
  • Practical experience of managing supplier performance, continuity and supply-chain risk.
  • Experience working within a matrix or centre-led procurement model.
  • The confidence to influence senior stakeholders and challenge constructively, even when you don’t have direct authority.
  • Experience leading, developing and improving procurement teams.
  • Strong commercial, analytical and financial judgement.
  • A relevant degree, equivalent professional experience or both.
  • A recognised procurement qualification, such as CIPS, would be useful but isn’t essential.
You’ll be comfortable moving between strategy and delivery. One day you may be advising divisional leadership; the next, you may be working through a supplier risk or removing a barrier that’s stopping a new agreement from being adopted.You’ll also know that good procurement isn’t simply about pushing for the lowest price. It’s about balancing cost, quality, technical capability, delivery, innovation, resilience and sustainability, then making a decision the business can actually live with.

What you’ll get

  • A senior, high-visibility staff role with ownership across divisional direct and indirect procurement.
  • The opportunity to shape procurement strategy, capability and ways of working across a multi-site business.
  • A US-based remote working arrangement.
  • Travel to company sites and suppliers as required, with much of the site footprint located in the Northeast.
  • The chance to influence both divisional priorities and the wider global procurement agenda.

Interested in learning more?

If this sounds like the right next step, apply now.Don’t have an up-to-date CV? No problem. Apply with what you have, or reach out to our Talent team via LinkedIn for an initial conversation

  • Participate in client calls and presentations; translate complex actuarial concepts for clinical and operational audiences without dumbing them down
  • Support scoping and methodology design for new engagements, including SOW input and assumptions documentation

What We're Looking For

Credentials & Experience

  • Bachelor’s (or higher) degree in relevant field (e.g., actuarial science or statistics)
  • ASA designation required; FSA a plus
  • 3+ years of actuarial experience in health (5+ preferred); consulting or payer background both welcome
  • Meaningful exposure to value-based care, population health analytics, or Medicare Advantage

Technical Skills

  • Excel modeling: fluency with complex workbooks, not just pivot tables
  • SQL / BigQuery: able to write and debug queries independently against large claims datasets
  • AI tool proficiency: you actively use AI tools to accelerate your work, not as a novelty
  • Familiarity with common claims data sources (MarketScan, Komodo, CMS-RIF, or similar) is a plus

Working Style

  • Clear communicator — written and verbal — with non-actuarial audiences
  • Comfortable owning a deliverable under time pressure without a playbook to follow
  • Organized enough to manage multiple concurrent client workstreams without dropping threads
  • Curious, not just compliant — you want to understand why the model says what it says

What to Expect (Read This Carefully)

We believe in honest recruiting. Here is what working at Accorded actually looks like:

  • Ambiguity is the default. Methodologies evolve, client needs shift, and the right answer is often something we're building for the first time. If you need a fully documented process before you can start, this role will frustrate you.
  • You will wear multiple hats. In the same week, you might QA a regression model, present findings to a CFO, and draft SOW language for a new engagement. Scope fluidity is a feature, not a bug.
  • The team is lean. There is no large actuarial department to absorb your questions or review your work six times before it goes to a client. Judgment and ownership matter from day one.
  • Remote means async-first. We are fully distributed. Strong written communication and self-direction are non-negotiable — not just nice to have.
  • The work is genuinely interesting. Our clients are building new care models. The actuarial questions they bring us have not all been answered before. That's the upside of the ambiguity.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary
  • Equity participation — we want teammates who are invested in what we're building
  • Fully remote, reasonably flexible working hours
  • Health, dental, and vision coverage offered
  • Support for continuing actuarial education and exam fees

Contracts Administrator (Legal Operations, CLM & Contract Lifecycle Management) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Contracts Administrator to manage the complete contract lifecycle—from intake and drafting through execution, renewals, compliance tracking, and reporting.

This is a highly detail-oriented, process-driven role responsible for ensuring contracts move efficiently, accurately, and compliantly across Legal, Sales, Procurement, Finance, Security, and Executive teams. You’ll oversee contract workflows, coordinate approvals, maintain CLM systems, track renewals, and support audit readiness while helping build scalable legal operations.

If you thrive in structured, high-volume environments and enjoy creating organized, efficient systems, this role offers excellent ownership and long-term growth.

Responsibilities

Contract Lifecycle Management

  • Manage contracts from intake through drafting, review, approval, execution, storage, renewals, and reporting.
  • Ensure agreements are accurate, compliant, fully executed, searchable, and audit-ready.
  • Maintain contract repositories and ensure complete documentation throughout the contract lifecycle.

Contract Drafting, Review & Redlining

  • Draft, review, and manage agreements including:
    • NDAs
    • DPAs
    • Statements of Work (SOWs)
    • Master Service Agreements (MSAs)
    • Vendor Agreements
    • Order Forms
    • Partner and Reseller Agreements
  • Redline contracts using Microsoft Word Track Changes.
  • Escalate non-standard legal terms involving indemnification, limitation of liability, intellectual property, data privacy, termination clauses, and service level agreements.
  • Maintain deviation logs, approval records, and contract history.

Approvals & Governance

  • Coordinate contract approvals across Legal, Finance, Procurement, Security, Information Security, Sales, and Executive teams.
  • Verify commercial terms align with pricing and business requirements.
  • Ensure vendor onboarding documentation is complete, including:
    • W-9 forms
    • Certificates of Insurance (COIs)
    • Banking information
    • Compliance documentation

Contract Execution & Repository Management

  • Manage electronic signature workflows using DocuSign or Adobe Sign.
  • Verify signer authority, signature blocks, and execution completeness.
  • Maintain agreements within CLM platforms such as Ironclad, Icertis, Agiloft, ContractWorks, Conga, SharePoint, or similar systems.
  • Ensure metadata remains accurate, including contract value, effective dates, renewal terms, jurisdiction, and privacy addenda.

Renewals, Compliance & Risk Management

  • Track contract renewals, notice periods, pricing changes, deliverables, and contractual obligations.
  • Send proactive renewal reminders to internal stakeholders.
  • Support compliance with GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOX, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain organized, audit-ready documentation and approval records.

Reporting & Process Improvement

  • Prepare reports covering:
    • Contract cycle times
    • SLA performance
    • Renewal pipeline
    • Contract deviations
    • Standard versus non-standard agreements
  • Improve contract templates, clause libraries, approval workflows, and CLM processes.
  • Help scale legal operations through workflow automation and documentation improvements.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Process-driven and comfortable managing high-volume contract workflows.
  • Strong communicator who collaborates effectively across multiple departments.
  • Able to identify contractual risks, inconsistencies, and missing information quickly.
  • Passionate about building efficient, scalable operational systems.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in Contracts Administration, Legal Operations, or Contract Coordination.
  • Hands-on experience with CLM platforms such as Ironclad, Icertis, Agiloft, ContractWorks, Conga, SharePoint, or similar systems.
  • Strong proficiency with:
    • Microsoft Word Track Changes
    • Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets
    • PDF editing software
  • Working knowledge of:
    • NDAs
    • DPAs
    • MSAs
    • Confidentiality agreements
    • Indemnification
    • Intellectual property clauses
    • Limitation of liability
    • Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOX, or other regulated environments.
  • Experience with both buy-side and sell-side contracts.
  • Exposure to procurement, vendor onboarding, vendor risk management, or security questionnaires.
  • Experience developing clause libraries, contract templates, and legal playbooks.

What Success Looks Like

  • Contract cycle times consistently meet SLA targets.
  • Zero missed renewals, notice periods, or contractual obligations.
  • Accurate and complete contract repository with 100% metadata accuracy.
  • High percentage of agreements executed using approved standard language.
  • Audit-ready documentation maintained at all times.
  • Continuous improvements in legal operations through process optimization.

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Practical Assessment (NDA Redlining & Contract Tracking Exercise)
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This allows hiring managers to assess your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Operational Excellence and Governance

  • Identify operational risks, process gaps, and execution barriers; lead timely resolution and implement scalable improvements that strengthen performance.

  • Monitor and communicate operational performance indicators to improve transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement related to publication management and budget management.

  • Own end-to-end operational oversight of assigned Medical Team budgets, scopes of work, purchase-order workflows, forecasts, phasing, and utilization – including US associate based required oversight.

Publication Compliance and Quality

  • Lead as a US medical affairs single point of accountability for final quality control across US publication governance activities such as business needs assessment, transfer of value reporting, US author travel, ensuring adherence to internal processes, documentation requirements, US governance standards, and audit-readiness expectations.

About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer with 12+ years of experience to serve as a technical anchor, system architect, and engineering catalyst for our core platform. In this high-impact role, you will define macro-architectural strategy, author and pitch technical visions to cross-functional leaders, and anchor engineering teams in executing scalable, highly secure microservices. You will blend deep hands-on expertise in .NET, Go, and PAM solutions with strategic leadership in AI-driven development and modern release engineering.

Architectural Leadership & Executive Pitching:

  • Architectural Ownership: Own the end-to-end technical vision and architectural decisions for high-throughput, highly available microservices and multi-platform solutions.

  • Technical Anchoring: Serve as the primary technical anchor across multiple engineering squads—establishing engineering standards, resolving complex system trade-offs, and mentoring senior engineers.

  • Technical Pitches & RFCs: Craft and deliver compelling technical pitches, Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), and RFCs to convince executive leadership, Product, and Infrastructure partners on strategic platform investments.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Translate complex business objectives into clear, scalable technical roadmaps while balancing velocity, technical debt, and system stability.

Core Systems & Security Engineering

  • Platform Development: Architect and write high-performance production code using C#, .NET (ASP.NET Core / ABP Framework), Go, TypeScript, and gRPC.

  • Privileged Access Management (PAM): Design and deploy enterprise PAM/IDAM architectures (CyberArk, BeyondTrust, HashiCorp Vault) and SCIM protocol integrations enforcing Zero Trust and Least Privilege principles.

  • Multi-Platform Strategy: Collaborate with the cross-functional teams (e.g., data engineering team) to define data architecture strategy across relational (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (DocumentDB) platforms; across environments and similarly collaborative with the infrastructure teams to have better infrastructure strategy in place that targets towards cost-saving on a long-term basis.

  • Problem solving & Troubleshooting: Active participation in the incident management process and contributing PIRs, taking ownership/accountability for a quick turn-around to resolve the incident.

Delivery Automation & AI Strategy:

  • CI/CD & Quality Rigor: Champion deployment automation across Origin CI, Kargo, and WoK, ensuring comprehensive unit, functional, Playwright E2E, and Performance, Scalability, and Reliability (PSR) testing.

  • AI Framework Governance: Pioneer spec-driven AI development by championing the BMAD framework to standardize, govern, and scale AI-assisted coding (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot) and reusable skill libraries.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience: 12+ years of progressive software development experience, with a proven track record operating as a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, or Lead Architect in enterprise product environments.

  • Architectural Mastery: Demonstrated history of making company-level architectural decisions, pitching complex technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders, and anchoring multi-team initiatives.

  • Core Tech Stack: Advanced proficiency in C#, .NET (ABP framework), Go, gRPC, TypeScript, and database engineering (PostgreSQL / DocumentDB).

  • Security & Infrastructure: Hands-on expertise in Privileged Access Management (PAM), SCIM, AWS/GCP cloud platforms, and Kubernetes.

  • Testing & Release: Expertise in continuous delivery pipelines, PSR non-functional testing, and automated E2E testing frameworks (Playwright).

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.
Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

Language:

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.
One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Every year, businesses lose billions to fraud, errors, and mistakes. Traild exists to solve this at scale, helping finance teams move faster, stay in control, and operate with confidence.

This is an opportunity to help shape the next category leader in finance automation, control and security, building technology that transforms how businesses manage, move, and protect money. At the core of this is a powerful AI-driven platform, enabling finance teams to deploy intelligent agents that do the work, surface risk in real time, and continuously improve how financial operations run.

Traild is building the infrastructure behind modern finance, protecting and powering meaningful volumes of the world’s B2B transactions.

If you’re excited by high growth, real ownership, and building something that matters, Traild is the place to do the most impactful work of your career.

Hear how Traild customers speak about us here.

The Role

    As Traild accelerates its expansion across North America, we are looking for an Enterprise Customer Onboarding Manager to own the full implementation journey for our most complex, high-stakes enterprise clients. This is a newly dedicated enterprise-focused role, created because enterprise implementations demand a different level of rigor, stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination than mid-market work. You will sit within the Customer Success team and collaborate daily with Solutions Engineering, Tech and Product to get clients live and, more importantly, to ensure they adopt Traild in a way that delivers lasting value. This is a senior individual contributor role where you will come in as the first Enterprise Customer Onboarding Manager in the region, with real ownership from day one.

Key Responsibilities

    • Drive enterprise implementations ($100K+ ACV) from scoping through to go-live and beyond, maintaining momentum across long and complex project timelines with multiple concurrent accounts
    • Own the end-to-end client journey from onboarding through to successful adoption, ensuring customers achieve measurable value
    • Provide user training, technical support and troubleshooting throughout implementation and beyond
    • Partner closely with Solutions Engineering, Tech and Product daily to work through client-specific issues, surface product feedback and keep implementations moving without unnecessary delays
    • Build trusted relationships with enterprise stakeholders and decision-makers, managing expectations clearly and maintaining CSAT above 90% across your portfolio
    • Own your personal KPIs including go-live targets, adoption outcomes and client health metrics, and contribute actively to internal documentation and process improvement
    • Drive momentum in complex or ambiguous customer environments, keeping implementations on track without needing to escalate

Who You Are

    You are an experienced implementation professional who has worked directly with enterprise clients in a B2B SaaS environment and knows what it takes to get complex projects across the line without losing sight of the longer-term adoption outcome. You bring a confident, consultative approach and thrive in fast-moving environments where you need to problem-solve, prioritise and own your outcomes with limited hand-holding.

    Must have

    • Strong project management skills — owning scoping, timelines, risk management and driving outcomes independently
    • Solid technical aptitude, comfortable working across integrations, workflows, and partnering directly with Engineering and Product teams
    • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, especially with senior and executive-level stakeholders
    • Comfortable operating in a startup or scale-up environment where processes are still being built and the pace of change is high
    • Strong collaborator with an attitude embracing growth, hands-on execution, adaptability, and the scale-up spirit

      • Nice to have

      • 5–7 years of direct enterprise-level implementation experience in a B2B SaaS environment, with a strong preference for AP, accounting or fintech software
      • Familiarity with ERP or payment related platforms, particularly IFS, Acumatica, NetSuite, SAP B1 or SYSPRO
        • We know great implementation people come from all sorts of backgrounds. If you have transferable skills from other project management, onboarding, consulting or delivery roles, we'd still like to hear from you, please apply and use the relevant/transferable skills question in the application to tell us how your experience maps to this role.

Salary Range

    The base salary range for this position is:

  • U.S. Candidates: $90,000 - $120,000 USD per year
  • Canadian Candidates: $90,000 - $120,000 CAD per year

    • Compensation is determined based on experience, education, and geographic location. The final offer may vary within the stated range to reflect the candidate’s qualifications and market conditions in their area.

The Perks of Working at Traild  

  • Flexibility: we offer a range of remote, hybrid and flexible working options. 

  • Global team: we are growing across APAC, NA and EMEA and have team all across the world. 

  • We are growing at an exponential rate, this is an opportunity to get involved with a true rocketship with all the excitement and opportunities that comes with it

Summary

The Enterprise Architect (EA) partners with business and technology leaders to translate business strategy into actionable architectures, standards, and roadmaps. This role focuses on business capability alignment, application and technology portfolio management, reference architecture development, and lifecycle governance, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, cost-effective, and aligned to enterprise objectives. The EA operates across domains, providing guidance rather than owning delivery, and supports architecture and security governance processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business & Strategy Alignment

    • Partner with business stakeholders to understand business objectives, processes, and value streams, and translate them into architectural implications.

    • Develop and maintain business capability models and map capabilities to applications, data, and technologies.

    • Support technology strategy and road-mapping, aligning initiatives to business priorities and outcomes.

    • Contribute architectural insight to investment planning and prioritization discussions.

  • Application & Technology Portfolio Management

    • Maintain visibility into the application and technology portfolio, including lifecycle status

    • Identify redundancy, technical debt, and modernization opportunities across the portfolio.

    • Support rationalization efforts, including cloud migration, platform consolidation, and vendor optimization.

    • Collaborate with product, platform, and delivery teams to guide lifecycle decisions.

  • Architecture & Design

    • Develop and maintain enterprise and domain reference architectures, standards, and reusable patterns.

    • Review solution designs for alignment with enterprise architecture principles and security requirements.

    • Provide architectural guidance for integrations, data flows, cloud adoption, and modernization initiatives.

    • Ensure architectural decisions consider scalability, resilience, security, and operational supportability.

  • Governance & Standards

    • Participate in or support Architecture and Security Review Boards, providing risk-based guidance and recommendations.

    • Define and evolve architectural principles, guardrails, and design standards.

    • Balance governance with delivery velocity by promoting approved patterns and self-service guidance.

    • Document architectural decisions and rationale for reuse and transparency.

  • Collaboration & Influence

    • Work closely with solution architects, security architects, product owners, and engineering teams.

    • Communicate architectural concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

    • Act as a trusted advisor, influencing outcomes through credibility and collaboration, not authority.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Who is American College of Education

Founded in 2005, American College of Education continues to be a leader in professional development through our online programs. The mission of ACE is to deliver high-quality, affordable, and accessible online programs grounded in evidence-based content, real-world experience and relevant application that places our students’ needs first.

ACE is a mission-driven institution continually recognized for its commitment to social responsibility and positive impact. As an Impact Institution, we believe we have a responsibility to our students, alumni, employees, communities, and society as a whole. Guided by our core values, we strive to create meaningful impact that extends well beyond our bottom line.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please note that all official communication will only come from our verified company email domain @Rippling.com

Who You Are

You are passionate about helping students achieve their educational goals. You thrive in a competitive and collaborative team environment. You are comfortable working remotely and have experience collaborating with others in a virtual environment. You possess a strong attention to detail.

As an Adjunct Faculty for American College of Education, you maintain a strong academic presence and growth in professional development for teaching, scholarly or creative works, and service to the profession and to the college. You report and work directly under the leadership of the department chair who provides guidance regarding 1) academic and teaching responsibilities, 2) service to students, department, college, and community, and 3) professional development.

﻿

Compensation

ACE is committed to paying a competitive wage while staying true to our mission of maintaining high-quality, affordable programs for our students. Adjuncts are paid per student per course here at ACE, and in general, the pay is $50/student at the bachelor and master levels and $126/student at the doctorate level. There are also opportunities to serve on paid committees, as well as receive payment for writing and developing courses.

﻿

What We Look for in the Ideal Candidate

  • Demonstrates positive attitude and motivation, concern for students, teamwork, and excellent time management skills.
  • Follows established processes as outlined by the organization and leadership.
