jobs.description:
Note: APA operates on a 37.5-hour work week with one-hour lunch breaks each day. APA sets salaries based on several considerations, including years of relevant experience, level of education, and previous staff and/or governance experience at APA.

The Center for Behavioral Science and AI (CBSAI) is a new APA entity built to shape how AI systems affect the people who use them, starting with its first priority area, Youth Safety & Wellbeing. The Scientific Director is the person who carries scientific authority for this priority area, chairs and manages the Youth Safety & Wellbeing Scientific Advisory Group, and ensures the Center's Specifications and Public Guidance workstreams are grounded in rigorous, defensible science.

The Scientific Director must have demonstrated experience guiding and organizing groups composed of senior academic and clinical experts and engaging them in substantive scientific discussion. The Director must also be able to provide independent scientific leadership in conversations with AI industry partners, funders, and other stakeholders. The role requires deep subject-matter expertise, an appreciation for the breadth of psychological science relevant to youth safety and well-being, and the judgment to make sound, timely decisions in a rapidly changing technological environment whose implications for young people continue to evolve.

About the Center

Technology companies have long recognized the importance of understanding how human behavior intersects with AI systems, platforms, and applications. With AI rapidly penetrating all aspects of individuals' lives and society as a whole, the technology presents both extraordinary promise and significant risks.

The CBSAI seeks to fundamentally broaden the role of psychological science in AI's layered ecosystem — spanning software, hardware, language models, data tools, and the interfaces used to build, train, deploy, and manage AI applications. The Center is how APA's institutional capacity becomes operational for the AI industry: a permanent infrastructure for translating the broad body of behavioral science into the products that now mediate how billions of people think, feel, learn, work, and relate to one another.

APA believes AI's scaffolding should enable humans to thrive, adapt, and grow across all dimensions of life. The Center will sit at the nexus of human behavior, technology, and well-being — bridging academic research and real-world impact by bringing sound science to AI and technology companies through research, advocacy, education, and national and international collaboration.

The Center is in its start-up phase and is building its founding team, beginning with the scientific leadership for its first priority area, Youth Safety & Wellbeing.

Education and Experience Required:

  • Ph.D. in a relevant field (e.g., developmental or clinical psychology, public health, human-computer interaction, cognitive/behavioral science, or a related discipline), with an active or recent research record in youth development, media/technology effects, or a closely related area.
  • Working knowledge of, and demonstrated engagement with, AI systems — sufficient to inform the translation of scientific findings into technical specifications and to engage credibly with engineering and product teams.
  • Established, recognized standing in the youth safety/wellbeing research field, evidenced by publications, leadership roles, and/or peer recognition at a level that supports serving as a facilitator to senior Scientific Advisory members.
  • Prior experience chairing, serving on, or otherwise running a scientific advisory board, review panel, or similarly convened expert body preferred.
  • Scientific rigor paired with pragmatism: able to set a defensible evidentiary bar and act on it without requiring full field consensus.
  • Strong ability to build relationships: can represent CBSAI credibly with senior academics, AI-company leadership, funders, and policymakers alike.
  • Demonstrated moral and scientific integrity: a track record of holding independent positions under commercial or institutional pressure.
  • Serves as a connector: Strong network across academic, clinical, industry, and policy communities working on youth safety and technology — knows who is doing credible work and who else to bring in.
  • Comfortable operating at start-up speed in a newly formed, pilot-phase organization with evolving processes and limited infrastructure.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate scientific nuance for engineering, policy, and public audiences.

Responsibilities:

Scientific Leadership & Advisory Management

  • Chair and manage the Youth Safety & Wellbeing Scientific Advisory: set agendas, recruit and steward members, and run the body as a genuine peer-level scientific forum rather than an advisory formality.
  • Serve as CBSAI's credible scientific face for this priority area — recognized by, and able to recruit from, the researchers the field already looks to.
  • Maintain a broad, current personal network across academia, clinical practice, and industry research on youth development, media, and technology — know who is doing rigorous work and who else to call.

Specifications Workstream (Owner)

  • Own the Specifications workstream for Youth Safety & Wellbeing: translating behavioral science into useable specifications for engineering and product teams.
  • Translate scientific evidence into specific, engineer-ready product and design requirements, in partnership with Center staff.
  • Set the scientific bar for when available evidence supports action, balancing rigor with the need to respond to emerging challenges in a rapidly evolving field. Comfortable making evidence-informed recommendations without waiting for definitive academic consensus, while maintaining a transparent and defensible scientific rationale.

Public Guidance Workstream (Scientific Review)

  • Serve as scientific reviewer and sign-off authority for Public Guidance deliverables (practitioner guides, public education materials, policy recommendations) prior to release, ensuring accuracy and rigor.
  • Partner with Center staff on cross-workstream questions where a Topic produces deliverables in both workstreams.

Independence & Scientific Integrity

  • Hold the line on scientific conclusions and methodology against commercial, reputational, and/or funder pressure, consistent with CBSAI's firewall commitments (AI-company partners may weigh in on relevance and factual accuracy — never on findings or conclusions).
  • Flag independence or firewall concerns to the Executive Director

External Representation & Field Engagement

  • Represent CBSAI's science externally at major convenings, funder and industry conversations, and public forums (e.g., high-profile global and industry gatherings).
  • Build and sustain the relationships that keep CBSAI credible with the scientific field, AI companies, and funders simultaneously.

Team Building & Supervision

  • Directly supervise the Product Lead and help define how the Specifications workstream team grows.
  • Serve as the working model for how future priority-area Scientific Leads are hired and structured as CBSAI adds priority areas.

Travel

  • Some domestic and international travel to represent CBSAI at major scientific, policy, and industry convenings, Scientific Advisory meetings, and academic conferences.

Other Duties as Assigned

About APA:

The American Psychological Association (APA) represents 146,000 psychologists, students, and affiliates, primarily in the U.S. and Canada but also in other countries around the world. APA is a scientific and professional organization with about 500 employees and is categorized as a 501(c)(3) along with its 501(c)(6) companion organization, APA Services, Inc.

APA offers a generous employee benefits program, including Remote Work/Flexible Scheduling; a 401(k) option with employer match of up to 4%; medical, dental, and vision insurance options and an outpatient mental health benefit; paid personal/vacation time plus 12 paid holidays; Family/Medical Leave; tuition assistance; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); short- and long-term disability insurance; and more.

Secretariat is a consulting firm that helps companies, law firms, and organizations solve complex business problems—often when there is a dispute, investigation, major project challenge, or high-stakes decision involved. At Secretariat, you’ll work on some of the most important legal, risk, and regulatory challenges facing businesses around the world.

From your first day, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team of smart, curious, and driven people who enjoy solving complex problems. You’ll learn by working alongside experienced professionals and contributing to projects for leading law firms, global companies, and major institutions.

Our teams collaborate across offices and disciplines, bringing energy, fresh thinking, and commitment to every client challenge. We invest in your growth through hands-on experience, mentorship, professional development, recognition, and a culture that values diverse perspectives.

Start your career where your work matters. Make your impact at Secretariat.

ABOUT OUR FORENSIC INVESTIGATIONS TEAM

As part of our growing Forensic Investigations team, you’ll help uncover facts, analyze complex financial information, and support high-impact matters involving fraud, disputes, investigations, and business challenges. This is a great opportunity for students who are curious, analytical, detail-oriented, and excited to learn how accounting, finance, economics, and law come together in real-world situations.

You’ll learn from and work alongside experienced accountants, economists, PhDs, certified business valuators, investment analysts, and industry specialists who collaborate across offices and industries. Our work is recognized globally: Secretariat ranked #4 in Global Arbitration Review’s Expert Witness Firm Power Index in 2023, and more than 90% of our testifying experts are recognized as leading experts by Who’s Who Legal.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct economic, valuation, financial, accounting, and industry research as needed.

  • Analyze financial and non-financial information, and report findings to other team members from public sources. Experience with S&P’s CapIQ is a plus.

  • Attention to detail is a must and significant experience with the preparation of damages models, forensic accounting investigative, and expert reports are a must.

  • Must be able to work independently in managing staff and communicating with experts, clients and counsel.

  • Prepare for and attend hearings, trials and mediations, so as needed travel from time to time is required.

  • Manage the day-to-day requirements of multiple engagements and associated duties.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Requisite professional designations and work experience:

    • A minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or similar, from an accredited university or college or MBA.

    • 4+ to 10 years of prior experience in economic damages and/or forensic accounting

    • Prior experience at one of the ‘Big Four’ accounting firms is a plus but will consider other commensurate experience in banking, mid-tier accounting firms or litigation support firms as well.

    • Holder of or pursuing CPA, CFF, CFA, CFE, ASA or ABV credentials is must.

  • Strong expert report writing skills to complement strong analytics and quantitative skills.

  • Able to quickly assimilate relevant information in unfamiliar situations and develop creative approaches and solutions necessary to resolve complex problems

  • Excellent analytical and problem resolution abilities

  • Excellent listening, verbal, written, technical, and presentation skills

  • Highly proficient with Microsoft Office products, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint are a must. Expertise is SQl, R, and other database or statistical programs are a plus.

  • The ability to travel as needed but likely less than 10% of the time or less.

  • In addition to working in English, which is a requirement, working proficiency in a second non-English language is a plus and encouraged.

This is a Remote Opportunity, however, the candidate must reside in the Las Vegas Metropolitan Area.

A rewarding career above all

There are a lot of fine consulting firms out there. But when everything is on the line, it takes a unique combination of skill and savvy to succeed under pressure.

Our culture and people are driven by passion, pride, and performance. Passion for the clients we serve, the work we deliver, and the communities we live in. Pride in our cohesive team recognized for excellence and trusted to perform in the most challenging situations. Our people are motivated to be the best in everything they do – from our approach to making the complex simple to the way we mentor our up-and-coming talent to become trusted experts early in their careers.

About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

You'll report to Heather Craig, Head of Risk & Compliance, and lead a team of two Complaints Handlers spanning both our US and UK operations. Complaints sits inside Quality, Risk & Compliance — for now, that means one function covering both regions under one roof, with a plan to split into dedicated US and UK complaints teams as volume grows.

This is a working people-leader role, not a pure oversight seat. You'll set the day-to-day standard for how your team triages and resolves complaints, while also carrying your own caseload of the most complex and escalated cases — motor and property disputes, regulatory escalations, and the investigations that need a steady, experienced hand. As the team grows and eventually splits by region, expect this role to shift more toward pure people leadership.

You'll be a good fit if you're comfortable moving between the granular (one escalated complaint, one claim file) and the systemic (the pattern behind nine of them) — and if you'd rather build the process that prevents the next complaint than just close out the one in front of you.

Duties & Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development: Lead a team of two Complaints Handlers spanning US and UK — set the day-to-day standard for how complaints get triaged, worked, and closed, and coach your team on investigation technique and regulatory requirements. As volumes grow and the team splits into dedicated US and UK functions, you'll help build the leadership bench for what comes next.

Complaint Investigation & Resolution: Own the most complex and escalated complaints yourself — motor and property claims disputes, coverage and liability questions, and the handling/timing issues that make up the bulk of what we see. Dig into claim files, policy documents, and correspondence to figure out what actually happened, then deliver a clear, professional resolution to the customer.

Regulatory & Escalation Management: Be the primary point of contact when a complaint escalates to the Financial Ombudsman Service in the UK or a state Department of Insurance in the US. Every escalation carries both enforcement risk and carrier/MGA relationship risk — you're the one making sure it's handled by the book and doesn't become a bigger problem than it needs to be.

Root Cause Analysis & Reporting: Look past the individual complaint to the pattern underneath it — repeat filers, timing gaps between settlement and payment, systems issues that miscategorize claims — and turn what you find into findings claims leaders and the Risk Council can actually act on.

Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Claims, Product/Engineering, QA, and Compliance to close the loop on what complaints are telling us. When the fix is a process or a system — not a person — you're the one who flags it and pushes it through.

Program & Quality Standards: Build and maintain the complaint-handling standards, records, and processes that keep us audit-ready — from FCA reporting fields to the documentation an external auditor will ask you to defend. Champion a culture where complaints are caught early and closed fairly.

Requirements

  • 5+ years handling complex or escalated complaints, ideally within insurance claims — motor and property experience is directly relevant here
  • Direct experience with regulatory complaint frameworks — FOS, FCA, state DOI processes, or some combination
  • 2+ years of people-leadership experience
  • Proven track record building and delivering executive-level communications
  • Strong investigative instincts — comfortable digging into claim files, policy documents, and correspondence to find the real story, not just the surface issue
  • Ability to manage a live portfolio of complex complaints under deadline pressure
  • An adjuster license is not required — this is about complaint resolution and regulatory judgment, not claims adjusting
  • Bachelor's degree (lack of one shouldn't stop you from applying if you have all the other qualifications)

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!

Mission Summary:

The Data Platform team is the vital link between our company's expansive data and the engineering teams that rely on it. We architect and operate the core services and infrastructure necessary to transform petabytes of raw data each month into actionable insights for our Machine Learning and Autonomy engineers. This role is a key contributor across our core initiatives:

  • Data Processing: We are building state-of-the-art infrastructure to meet the demands of our rapidly scaling fleet and sophisticated ML engineering requirements. You will be responsible for ensuring that our core data pipelines are robustly engineered—meaning they are performant, user-friendly, and highly fault-tolerant.
  • Data Discovery: we are building a platform that combines cataloging data for search needs across our metadata stores, vector datastores, and various data warehouses to super charge our ML pipelines. You would be coming in and working with ML and autonomy stakeholders to build out this new discovery platform.
  • Data Lineage: we are getting started with building our data lineage system that will track the usage of all data at Motional. You would work with our stakeholders to ensure our system is widely adopted and address customer pain points.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Play a key role in designing and building the next generation of data infrastructure.
  • Build scalable backend services for data discovery and data lineage systems.
  • Write high quality, maintainable code to process petabytes of data
  • Lead and champion high-level system design and quality code reviews/technical contributions.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data processing and access with cloud ETL technology.

What We're Looking For:

  • 3+ years of professional experience as a data engineer or data pipeline engineer
  • BS or MS in Computer Science or related field
  • Strong development experience with Python and SQL.
  • Expertise with AWS services and solutions (EKS, Lambda, ETL)
  • Experience with distributed system design and development
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, continuous delivery environment

Bonus Points (not required):

  • Experience with Infrastructure Monitoring
  • Experience working in cross-functional development teams
  • Prior experience with agentic workflows is a plus.
  • Prior experience in autonomous vehicles (AV) is a plus.

We encourage a hybrid schedule with in-office time at one of our locations in Boston, Pittsburgh, or Las Vegas to support collaboration, or this role can be fully remote.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors including but not limited to specific skills, experience and expertise, role location, certifications, licenses, and business needs. The estimated compensation range listed in this job posting reflects base salary only. This role may include additional forms of compensation such as a bonus or company equity. The recruiter assigned to this role can share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process.

Candidates for certain positions are eligible to participate in Motional’s benefits program. Motional’s benefits include but are not limited to medical, dental, vision, 401k with a company match, health saving accounts, life insurance, pet insurance, and more.

Salary Range
$149,000—$198,500 USD

Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We’re driven by something more.

Our journey is always people first.

We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.

Higher purpose, greater impact.

We’re creating first-of-its-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it’s not only good for our business, it’s the right thing to do.

Scale up, not starting up.

Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully-autonomous cross-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest-standing public robotaxi fleet. We’re driven to scale; we’re moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges.

Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.

Motional AD Inc. is an EOE. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To comply with Federal Law, we participate in E-Verify. What do you get when you bring together a team of bright individuals and place them into an environment where “work” means making a difference in the lives of people across the globe?

You get Sciolex Corporation, a fast-growing defense contractor focused on providing the U.S. Government a level of service that surpasses the epitome of excellence. Desired Focus Areas:

  • Generative AI and internal business applications

Qualifications & Physical Requirements

  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Demonstrated interest in AI, automation, or intelligent systems

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience experimenting with or building solutions using generative AI or LLMs

  • Experience building internal tools or automating business processes
  • Familiarity working with unstructured information (documents, file systems, SharePoint content)

Why This Role:

Who we are?

HarfangLab is a French cybersecurity scale-up developing a unified platform powered by a single lightweight agent and AI built for cybersecurity. Continuously enhanced through R&D, our portfolio includes EDR (Endpoint Detection and Response), EPP (Endpoint Protection Platform), ASM (Attack Surface Management), ITDR (Identity Threat Detection and Response), and Email Security, with the latter two joining the platform in 2026. Together, these solutions detect and neutralize threats across endpoints, servers, identities, and email environments. Our engines, models, and algorithms identify abnormal behaviour, generate security alerts, and block malicious activity.

Founded in 2018, HarfangLab has earned strong industry recognition: its EDR was the first to be certified by ANSSI in 2020, the first to obtain ANSSI qualification in 2025, and the first EDR to receive BSI certification in Germany. We also joined the French Tech 2030 programme, alongside 80 innovative French companies, as cyber resilience becomes a strategic priority for Europe.

Backed by €30 million in funding, we have grown from 40 employees in 2023 to 140 today and expanded internationally across Europe.

HarfangLab now protects the endpoints of more than 1,000 clients across all sectors, including CAC 40 industrial companies, government entities, SMEs, hospitals, and local authorities. Driven by a strong collective spirit and international ambitions, we remain committed to our original mission: protecting organizations against increasingly complex cyber threats while enabling them to retain full control over their data.

Italy is a key market in HarfangLab’s European growth strategy, and we are investing to accelerate our development in the region.

Overview

JOB TITLE: Senior Data Specialist

AGENCY SUPPORTED: U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) – MEGA 6 Automated Litigation Support

POSITION TYPE: Full-Time, Contingent Upon Award

LOCATION: Remote

CLEARANCE: Public Trust – Candidates do not need to be cleared at the time of application but must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance prior to starting.

BENEFITS: Health, Dental and Vision, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Spending Account (FSA), 11 Paid Federal Holidays, 3 weeks’ Paid Time Off

ITC Federal, LLC (ITC) connects technology advancements in automation and AI, customer experience, and financial services to solve government mission challenges, enabling smoother operational efficiency and bolstering national security. We leverage the latest technology innovations and proven approaches to better serve the mission and support the DHS, DOJ, and DoW workforce, customers, and programs, regardless of scale or complexity. ITC is located in Fairfax, VA and offers an outstanding compensation and benefits plan and a challenging and rewarding professional work environment.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Specialist to support ITC Federal’s work for the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) under the anticipated MEGA 6 automated litigation support (ALS) program. This is a fully remote position supporting DOJ’s complex litigation mission.

Important: This opening is being established in connection with the MEGA 6 contract vehicle award itself. ITC Federal must still be awarded individual task orders under the vehicle before employees can be onboarded. Accordingly, this position is full-time and contingent upon both contract award and the award of the applicable task order.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

This is a senior level position operating under the direction of more senior Contractor IT staff.

PROGRAM CONTEXT:

This position supports the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) under the anticipated MEGA 6 procurement. MEGA 6 is expected to continue DOJ’s multiple-award contract vehicle for automated litigation support (ALS) services, following the structure of the MEGA 5 contract. These contracts are designed to provide DOJ offices, boards, divisions, and other federal agencies with information technology, professional services, and litigation support tools to manage complex legal proceedings efficiently.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides oversight functions for Data Specialists performing file manipulation, loading, conversion services, exports, and productions and quality checks of loads and exports.
  • Develops, evaluates and modifies methodologies and procedures for manipulating files for use with COTS products and litigation support applications.
  • Performs quality assurance of all EFP services.
  • Responsible for ensuring that incoming productions are made pursuant to the applicable ESI specifications and when deficiencies are found, provides EFP Manager with detailed notice of deficiencies.
  • Recommends process improvement to ensure high quality, timely and cost-effective methods are utilized.

Qualifications

REQUIRED:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Public Trust clearance prior to start (candidates are not required to be cleared at the time of application).
  • Authorized to work in the United States.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fully remote environment.
  • Requires knowledge of litigation discovery process, and the Electronic Discovery Reference Model (EDRM) workflow.
  • Working knowledge of personal computers, including Windows, document review software, and encryption methods.
  • Experience with LAW, IPRO, Relativity or other document processing platform.
  • At least five years’ experience performing eDiscovery roles including but not limited to electronic files processing (EFP), image and data file conversion, data culling using review tools, quality assurance, database loads and retrieval, and data analysis.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Knowledge of Government’s IT environment, including office automation networks, PC and server based applications preferred.
  • Familiarity with ICONECT, Relativity, MS Office Suite, and West LiveNote valued.
  • Undergraduate degree preferred-preferably in computer science or related field.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • This is a fully remote position; work is performed from a home office.
  • Must be located in or near the Washington, DC area and available for short-notice on-site meetings.
  • Work is primarily sedentary, performed while using a computer for extended periods of time.

This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You talk, you get paid.

We're looking for bilingual speakers to record short, casual voice clips where they naturally mix English with Chinese - the way they'd actually talk in real life. No script, no scenarios, just you talking about your day, your opinions, whatever comes naturally.

Do you switch between English and Chinese mid-sentence without even thinking about it? Rant about your day, discuss your favorite show, think out loud with different languages - say it exactly how you'd say it to a friend. What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities:

  • Speak naturally, switching between English and Chinese the way you normally would in everyday conversation

Requirements

  • Language: Fully bilingual - fluent or native in both English and Chinese, and someone who naturally mixes the two when speaking
  • Equipment: Any device works, including your phone - no studio or special equipment needed

  • Get paid to talk - no perfect grammar, no formality: earn up to $30/hour depending on your pace and approval rate

What to Expect from Our Interview Process

Together, we operate as one collaborative ecosystem, combining deep expertise, AI-powered capabilities, and a culture of curiosity to help ambitious brands grow while creating meaningful opportunities for our people.

About the role

You’ll own the day-to-day performance and optimization of paid social campaigns for a portfolio of primarily eCommerce and DTC clients, with occasional lead generation accounts. This role is rooted in strong performance media execution - driving revenue, improving efficiency, and scaling campaigns across platforms like Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit, Snapchat, and LinkedIn.

You’ll translate client business goals into full-funnel paid social strategies, balancing prospecting, retargeting, and creative testing to drive measurable growth. While the core of this role is performance-focused, you’ll also be expected to think holistically about the funnel - understanding how discovery, consideration, and conversion efforts work together and how paid social integrates into a broader digital ecosystem.

You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with Creative, Client Strategy, SEO, and broader Paid Media teams to execute integrated campaigns, while maintaining a strong hands-on understanding of campaign builds, optimizations, testing, and reporting, and collaborating with ad operation support teams to ensure high-quality execution at scale. As a client-facing contributor, you’ll help communicate performance insights, testing learnings, and strategic recommendations that drive smarter investment decisions.

Additionally, you may support paid social efforts tied to Social Commerce initiatives (such as TikTok Shop and GMV Max programs), helping connect paid media activation to conversion pathways and platform-native shopping experiences.

What you’ll do

Campaign Strategy & Execution

  • Building, launching, and managing paid social campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit, Snapchat, and LinkedIn
  • Structuring full-funnel campaign architectures with a strong emphasis on performance and conversion outcomes
  • Managing budgets, pacing, bid strategies, and spend allocation decisions to maximize efficiency and scalable growth
  • Supporting paid social programs tied to Social Commerce initiatives (e.g., TikTok Ads driving to TikTok Shop, GMV Max-style approaches)

Performance Optimization & Testing

  • Monitoring performance daily and proactively optimizing campaigns based on KPIs such as ROAS, CPA, CAC, CVR, and revenue
  • Designing and executing structured A/B tests across creative, audiences, placements, and funnel stages
  • Iterating on campaign structure, creative hooks, and audience strategies based on performance signals
  • Documenting test learnings and scaling high-performing tactics across accounts

Measurement & Analytics

  • Analyzing platform data, GA4, and attribution tools to evaluate performance and inform optimization decisions
  • Supporting measurement best practices including pixel tracking, CAPI where applicable, and clean campaign tagging
  • Translating performance data into actionable insights and clear next-step recommendations
  • Contributing to incrementality thinking, lift studies, attribution models (MTA/MMM exposure), and cross-channel performance interpretation

Creative & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partnering closely with Creative teams to develop and iterate on social-first, performance-driven ad concepts
  • Providing creative feedback rooted in performance data (hooks, formats, messaging, thumbstop rate, etc.)
  • Collaborating with Client Strategy, SEO, and Paid Media teams to ensure paid social aligns with broader marketing goals
  • Supporting integrated campaign planning that connects paid social to lifecycle, retention, and broader funnel initiatives

Client Communication & Account Ownership

  • Owning performance outcomes for assigned accounts, including strategic direction, optimization priorities, and execution quality across internal and support teams
  • Participating in client calls and performance discussions as a trusted executional lead
  • Preparing reporting insights, optimization rationales, and testing updates for internal and client stakeholders
  • Managing multiple client accounts simultaneously with strong organization and prioritization
  • Building trust through proactive communication, accountability, and consistent delivery of high-quality work

What You Bring

Paid Social Execution & Performance Expertise

  • 3–5 years of hands-on paid social experience (agency experience strongly preferred)
  • Proven experience managing performance-focused campaigns for eCommerce, DTC, and/or lead generation brands
  • Strong platform expertise in Meta and TikTok, with working knowledge of Pinterest, Reddit, Snapchat, and LinkedIn
  • A true “hands-on keyboard” mindset with the ability to both strategize and execute at a high level

Funnel & Strategic Thinking

  • Understanding of full-funnel paid social strategy, including prospecting, retargeting, and lifecycle-aligned activations
  • Ability to connect paid social performance to broader business goals such as revenue growth, LTV, and customer acquisition efficiency
  • Comfort balancing immediate performance goals with longer-term testing and funnel development
  • Curiosity around evolving paid social trends, platform updates, and emerging social commerce opportunities

Measurement & Analytical Skills

  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and translate it into actionable optimizations
  • Experience using GA4, platform analytics, and reporting tools to evaluate campaign performance
  • Familiarity with attribution models, lift studies, incrementality concepts, and modern measurement approaches (MTA, MMM exposure is a plus)
  • High attention to detail with strong QA habits and data accuracy standards

Platform & Social Commerce Fluency

  • Experience running campaigns that drive on-platform or social commerce outcomes (e.g., TikTok Shop, catalog sales, conversion-focused flows)
  • Understanding of how paid media supports platform-native shopping experiences and conversion ecosystems
  • Comfort working in fast-evolving ad environments, including beta features and new ad products
  • Familiarity with catalog-driven advertising, feed-based campaigns, and platform-native shopping formats

Communication & Professional Presence

  • Ability to explain performance trends, testing insights, and optimization strategies in a digestible way

Bonus Qualifications

Why Join Us

You'll work alongside talented people who are passionate about solving problems, helping clients grow, and delivering meaningful results. We're a collaborative, fast-moving team where curiosity is encouraged, ideas are welcomed, and great work is recognized.

We believe the best work happens when people are trusted to take ownership, supported in their growth, and empowered to bring their unique perspectives to the table. jobs.description:
Terms of Reference

Consultancy: Development of an Online Training Course on Dialogue under Pressure – Multi-Track Engagement with Armed Actors and Authorities

Position title: Online Curriculum Design Consultant: Dialogue under Pressure (Multi-Track Engagement with Armed Actors and Authorities)

Organisation Nonviolent Peaceforce (NP): Unarmed Civilian Protection (UCP) Academy

Reporting line: UCP Academy Manager

Duty station: Remote (home-based); no travel foreseen

Contract period: November 1 – 31 December 2026

Level of effort: 20 working days within the contract period

Maximum budget: CHF 8,000 (all-inclusive, equivalent to CHF 400 per working day)

Background

Nonviolent Peaceforce (NP) is an international civilian protection organisation that works alongside local communities to prevent violence and build sustainable peace through unarmed civilian protection (UCP). Direct, sustained and principled engagement with armed actors, state authorities and other duty bearers, conducted simultaneously at community, local, national and international levels, is a defining feature of UCP practice and one of the methodologies through which NP teams deter violence, reduce threats to civilians and create space for protection.

NP’s UCP Academy is the organisation’s learning platform, designed to make UCP practice accessible to practitioners, communities, civil society organisations, policymakers and academics. NP is expanding the Academy’s course catalogue and seeks a consultant to design a training course on dialogue under pressure: how unarmed civilian protection actors prepare for, conduct and sustain multi-track engagement with armed actors and authorities in volatile, high-risk and rapidly shifting environments. The course will subsequently be digitalised and hosted as an online course on the UCP Academy website. The consultant is responsible for producing a ‘digitalisation-ready’ curriculum, not for the technical build.

Several Geneva-based and international organisations hold recognised mandates and established methodologies in humanitarian negotiation and engagement with armed actors. NP does not seek to duplicate that offer. The course must be positioned deliberately in the space specific to UCP: protection-driven, community-anchored, multi-track dialogue carried out by unarmed civilian protection teams together with the communities they accompany.

Objective

To develop a complete, practice-based and pedagogically sound training course on multi-track dialogue with armed actors and authorities under conditions of pressure, ready for digitalisation and delivery through the UCP Academy online platform, and clearly positioned as complementary to trainings already offered by organisations mandated in this field.

Scope of work

Under the direct supervision of the UCP Academy Manager, the consultant will:

  • Conduct a short inception review of existing NP internal guidance, engagement protocols, training materials, field tools and relevant external literature on dialogue with armed actors and authorities, multi-track engagement and protection-centred negotiation.
  • Map the existing training and methodological landscape, including CCHN / Frontline Negotiations, Geneva Call, ICRC, Centre for Humanitarian Dialogue and comparable actors, and produce a written complementarity and value-add analysis: what this course will deliberately not cover, where it draws on or cross-references existing frameworks, and what is distinctive to a UCP approach.
  • Consult NP field teams (through remote interviews and/or focus group discussions across a representative sample of country programmes) to capture field-tested practice, engagement protocols, case examples, dilemmas and lessons learned and to validate the draft course content.
  • Design the course architecture: learning pathway, modules and sessions, learning objectives, estimated learning time, sequencing and prerequisites, including explicit signposting to complementary external training where relevant.
  • Develop module content covering, at a minimum: actor analysis and preparation; mandate, red lines and principled positioning; multi-track sequencing and coherence across community, local, national and international levels; managing pressure, coercion, intimidation and duress; team safety, duty of care and psychological load; confidentiality and information handling; gender, inclusion and community-led dialogue; and handover, follow-up and accountability.
  • Design assessment and learner engagement elements: knowledge checks, end-of-module quizzes, a final assessment, and criteria for course completion or certification.

Deliverables

  • Inception note, including methodology, consultation plan, and annotated course outline
  • Complementarity and value-add analysis (CCHN, Geneva Call, and comparable actors), including positioning recommendations
  • Consultation report, including key findings and case material from NP field teams
  • Draft course package with modules, content, scenario exercises, and assessments
  • Validation session, consolidated feedback matrix, and final course package, including a digitalisation guidance note and resource list

All deliverables shall be submitted in English, in editable formats. All materials produced remain the intellectual property of Nonviolent Peaceforce.

Required qualifications and experience

  • Advanced university degree in peace and conflict studies, international relations, international humanitarian law, education or a related field.
  • Demonstrated, substantive experience in unarmed civilian protection, including direct engagement with armed actors and authorities, protective presence and deterrence and community-based protection, is a requirement; prior work with or on NP or comparable UCP actors is a strong asset.
  • Demonstrated familiarity with the methodologies and training offers of organisations mandated in dialogue with armed actors and authorities (for example CCHN / Frontline Negotiations, Geneva Call, the ICRC, the Centre for Humanitarian Dialogue).
  • At least five years’ experience designing adult learning curricula, preferably for online or blended delivery, including scenario- or simulation-based learning on sensitive and high-risk subject matter.
  • Proven ability to translate field practice into accessible learning content; excellent written English; French, Spanish or Arabic an asset.
  • Ability to work independently, remotely and across multiple time zones, and to handle sensitive operational information with discretion.

Reporting and working arrangements

The consultancy is fully remote. The consultant reports directly to the UCP Academy Manager, with a check-in at inception, weekly progress calls and written approval of each deliverable before payment. The consultant uses their own equipment and software. NP facilitates introductions to field teams and, where possible, to external reference organisations. Case material drawn from field operations is handled under NP confidentiality and do-no-harm requirements: sensitive examples must be anonymised or cleared before use.

Budget and payment

The maximum available budget is CHF 8,000, inclusive of all fees, taxes and incidental costs, for a maximum of 20 working days. Payment is made in 2 instalmendts: 25% upon signing of contract and 75% upon completion (with written approval) of assignment. The consultant is responsible for any tax requirements in their country.

How to Apply

  • We strongly encourage applicants to carefully review the job description before submitting their application and ensure they meet the essential requirements.
  • Candidates meeting the above requirements are requested to submit the following, through our website, detailing their experience and how they qualify for the role. Incomplete applications will not be considered:
    • CV.
    • Short technical proposal (maximum three pages) outlining approach and indicative module structure.
    • Relevant work sample and an all-inclusive daily rate.
  • The closing date for applications is Thursday, 8 October, 2026.
  • This is on a rolling basis. Candidates may be selected before the closing date apply early.
  • As part of the recruitment process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a technical assignment before participating in an interview.

SPECIAL NOTICE

Nonviolent Peaceforce is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against based on disability.

Nonviolent Peaceforce acknowledges the duty of care to safeguard and promote the welfare of employees, contractors, volunteers, interns, communities we work with, and other stakeholders and is committed to ensuring safeguarding practice reflects statutory responsibilities and government guidance and complies with best practices in the Humanitarian and Development sector.NP expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment through our code of conduct. We prioritise ensuring that only those who share and demonstrate our values are recruited to work for us.

The post holder will undertake the appropriate level of training and is responsible for ensuring that they understand and work within the safeguarding policies of the organisation.

All offers of employment will be subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks, which can include criminal records and terrorism finance checks. NP also participates in the InterAgency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. In line with this Scheme, we will request information from job applicants’ previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during employment or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms their understanding of these recruitment procedures.

NO FEE

We never ask for payment as part of our selection process, and we always contact candidates via our corporate accounts and platforms. If you are approached for payment, this is likely to be fraudulent. Please check whether the role you are interested in is posted here on our website.

26WD101260, Senior Manager, Product

Position Overview

Autodesk's Technical Advisory organization helps the world's leading architecture, engineering, construction, manufacturing, and media companies get the most from their Autodesk investments. We are transforming this expertise from traditional consulting into a digital-first platform strategy — and the Senior Manager, Product Management will define what that platform becomes.


Reporting to the Director of Platform & Productization within Global Delivery & Solutions, you will lead a product management team responsible for Autodesk's digital consulting platform. Your portfolio spans platform capabilities, industry-specific solutions, consulting tools, and packaged services.


In the first year, you will launch and land our first digital consulting offering, validating our new consulting model with paying customers. You will establish product management discipline for a maturing capability — discovery practices, prioritization frameworks, go-to-market coordination — while simultaneously delivering product that proves the model works. You own the product strategy and roadmap. You will partner with Content & Knowledge on knowledge readiness and publication decisions, with Architecture and Engineering on technical feasibility and delivery sequencing, and with GTM on market positioning and launch execution. The role sits at the center of the organization, and your ability to hold a coherent product vision while navigating these dependencies will define the platform's success.


Responsibilities

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for the digital consulting platform, prioritizing capabilities that deliver measurable customer value while supporting the broader transformation from traditional consulting to scalable digital offerings
  • Translate customer needs, market signals, and field consultant feedback into a coherent product backlog with clear prioritization rationale
  • Partner with the Content & Knowledge team to evaluate which captured implementation knowledge is ready for productization, assessing market value, accuracy, and completeness
  • Define the service catalog product model — how fixed-scope consulting services are packaged, priced, discovered, and delivered through the platform
  • Coordinate with Autodesk product management teams to align platform strategy with product roadmaps, ensuring consulting offerings evolve alongside the products customers are implementing
  • Establish and maintain direct relationships with customers and design partners to validate product direction and gather continuous feedback
  • Partner with GTM and consulting delivery leadership to build systematic feedback loops between field teams and the product team
  • Monitor competitive landscape and industry trends in professional services, consulting technology, and AI-enabled implementation support to inform product differentiation
  • Define success metrics for platform adoption, usage, and customer outcomes, and use data to drive iterative product improvement
  • Lead and grow a team of product managers who own different areas of the portfolio: platform capabilities, industry solutions, tools, and services
  • Establish product management discipline including discovery practices, prioritization frameworks, stakeholder communication, and go-to-market coordination
  • Partner with Architecture and Engineering to ensure product requirements are technically feasible and well-scoped for iterative delivery
  • Provide executive reporting on product performance, adoption trends, and strategic recommendations

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in product management with progressive responsibility, including managing product managers
  • 4+ years leading product teams, with demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain strong product talent
  • Experience building digital and AI enabled products or platforms from early stage — defining strategy, launching to market, and iterating based on customer feedback
  • Experience defining product models where the offering combines digital tools and human-delivered services (service catalog, marketplace, or hybrid models)
  • Strong business acumen with ability to connect product decisions to revenue models, customer value, and organizational strategy
  • Experience working with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams in an integrated product development process
  • Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

The Ideal Candidate

  • Has product management experience in professional services, consulting technology, knowledge platforms, or services-to-product transformations
  • Startup and new value creation experience in both 0 to 1 and 1 to 100 scaling
  • Understands how to productize expert knowledge — turning unstructured human expertise into structured, repeatable, scalable offerings, with attention to quality governance and knowledge lifecycle
  • Is skilled at managing a diverse product portfolio with different maturity levels, from new capabilities to scaling existing features
  • Has familiarity with architecture, engineering, construction, operations (AECO), manufacturing, or media and entertainment industries
  • Has an informed perspective on how AI is changing professional services delivery and what that means for product strategy
  • Is energized by building something new and comfortable making product decisions with incomplete information, then adjusting as the team learns

26WD101260, Responsable senior, Produit


Aperçu du poste

L'organisation de conseil technique d'Autodesk aide les plus grandes entreprises mondiales des secteurs de l'architecture, de l'ingénierie, de la construction, de l'industrie et des médias à tirer le meilleur parti de leurs investissements dans les solutions Autodesk. Nous transformons actuellement cette expertise, qui reposait jusqu'à présent sur un modèle de conseil traditionnel, en une stratégie de plateforme axée sur le numérique — et c'est au responsable senior de la gestion de produits qu'il reviendra de définir la forme que prendra cette plateforme.


Rattaché(e) au directeur de la plateforme et de la productisation au sein de la division Global Delivery & Solutions, vous assumerez la responsabilité d’une équipe de gestion de produits chargée de la plateforme de conseil numérique d’Autodesk. Votre portefeuille couvre les fonctionnalités de la plateforme, les solutions sectorielles, les outils de conseil et les offres de services packagées.


Au cours de la première année, vous lancerez et mettrez en œuvre notre première offre de conseil numérique, validant ainsi notre nouveau modèle de conseil auprès de clients payants. Vous mettrez en place une discipline de gestion de produit pour une capacité en pleine maturation — pratiques de découverte, cadres de hiérarchisation des priorités, coordination de la mise sur le marché — tout en livrant simultanément un produit qui prouve l’efficacité du modèle. Vous êtes responsable de la stratégie produit et de la feuille de route. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec l’équipe Contenu et Connaissances sur la préparation des connaissances et les décisions de publication, avec les équipes Architecture et Ingénierie sur la faisabilité technique et l’enchaînement des livraisons, et avec l’équipe GTM sur le positionnement sur le marché et l’exécution du lancement. Ce poste occupe une place centrale au sein de l’organisation, et votre capacité à maintenir une vision cohérente du produit tout en gérant ces interdépendances déterminera le succès de la plateforme.


Responsabilités

  • Maîtriser la stratégie produit et la feuille de route de la plateforme de conseil numérique, en donnant la priorité aux capacités qui apportent une valeur client mesurable tout en soutenant la transformation globale du conseil traditionnel vers des offres numériques évolutives
  • Traduire les besoins des clients, les signaux du marché et les retours des consultants de terrain en un backlog produit cohérent, avec une justification claire des priorités
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe Contenu et Connaissances pour déterminer quelles connaissances de mise en œuvre capturées sont prêtes à être transformées en produits, en évaluant leur valeur marchande, leur exactitude et leur exhaustivité
  • Définir le modèle de produit du catalogue de services : comment les services de conseil à périmètre fixe sont regroupés, tarifés, présentés et fournis via la plateforme
  • Assurer la coordination avec les équipes de gestion de produits d’Autodesk afin d’aligner la stratégie de la plateforme sur les feuilles de route des produits, en veillant à ce que les offres de conseil évoluent parallèlement aux produits que les clients mettent en œuvre
  • Établir et entretenir des relations directes avec les clients et les partenaires de conception afin de valider l’orientation des produits et de recueillir en continu des retours d’expérience
  • Collaborer avec les responsables de la stratégie de commercialisation (GTM) et de la prestation de services de conseil pour mettre en place des boucles de rétroaction systématiques entre les équipes de terrain et l’équipe produit
  • Surveiller le paysage concurrentiel et les tendances du secteur dans les domaines des services professionnels, des technologies de conseil et de l’assistance à la mise en œuvre basée sur l’IA afin d’orienter la différenciation des produits
  • Définir des indicateurs de réussite pour l’adoption de la plateforme, son utilisation et les résultats clients, et utiliser les données pour piloter l’amélioration itérative des produits
  • Diriger et développer une équipe de chefs de produit responsables de différents domaines du portefeuille : fonctionnalités de la plateforme, solutions sectorielles, outils et services
  • Mettre en place une discipline de gestion de produit comprenant des pratiques de découverte, des cadres de hiérarchisation des priorités, la communication avec les parties prenantes et la coordination de la mise sur le marché
  • Collaborer avec les équipes d’architecture et d’ingénierie pour s’assurer que les exigences produit sont techniquement réalisables et correctement définies pour une livraison itérative
  • Fournir des rapports à la direction sur les performances des produits, les tendances d’adoption et les recommandations stratégiques

Qualifications minimales

  • Plus de 10 ans d’expérience en gestion de produits avec des responsabilités croissantes, y compris la gestion de chefs de produit
  • Plus de 4 ans à la tête d’équipes produit, avec une capacité avérée à recruter, développer et fidéliser des talents de haut niveau dans le domaine des produits
  • Expérience dans la création de produits ou de plateformes numériques et basés sur l’IA dès les premières étapes — définition de la stratégie, lancement sur le marché et itération en fonction des retours clients
  • Expérience dans la définition de modèles de produits où l’offre combine des outils numériques et des services fournis par des personnes (catalogue de services, marketplace ou modèles hybrides)
  • Solide sens des affaires, avec une capacité à relier les décisions produit aux modèles de revenus, à la valeur client et à la stratégie organisationnelle
  • Expérience de collaboration avec des équipes d’ingénierie, de conception et de commercialisation dans le cadre d’un processus intégré de développement de produit
  • Licence en commerce, ingénierie, informatique ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience professionnelle équivalente

Le candidat idéal

  • Possède une expérience en gestion de produit dans les services professionnels, les technologies de conseil, les plateformes de connaissances ou les transformations « de services en produits »
  • Expérience dans les start-ups et la création de nouvelle valeur, tant dans les phases de développement « 0 à 1 » que de croissance « 1 à 100 »
  • Sait comment transformer le savoir-faire d’experts en produit — en convertissant l’expertise humaine non structurée en offres structurées, reproductibles et évolutives, tout en veillant à la gouvernance de la qualité et au cycle de vie des connaissances
  • Maîtrise la gestion d’un portefeuille de produits diversifié présentant différents niveaux de maturité, allant de la création de nouvelles fonctionnalités à l’évolution des fonctionnalités existantes
  • Possède une bonne connaissance des secteurs de l’architecture, de l’ingénierie, de la construction et de l’exploitation (AECO), de l’industrie manufacturière, ou des médias et du divertissement
  • A une vision éclairée de la manière dont l’IA transforme la prestation des services professionnels et de ce que cela implique pour la stratégie produit
  • Trouve sa motivation dans la création de quelque chose de nouveau et est à l’aise pour prendre des décisions relatives au produit avec des informations incomplètes, puis pour les ajuster au fur et à mesure que l’équipe acquiert de nouvelles connaissances

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

This role leads the advisory, architecture, and delivery of enterprise Data Foundation engagements for Salesforce Professional Services customers. Drawing on deep data experience (10+ years for the Senior Technical Architect level; 15+ years for the Director level), you run discovery, set the technical vision, design/approve the target architecture, and drive delivery across a progressive, customer-calibrated maturity journey — advising customer stakeholders (up to CxO level at the Director tier) along the way.

You bring the Data Foundation Delivery to life, including core data capabilities, associated frameworks, and the ability to operate across one or more of the platform stack (Salesforce Data 360, Informatica IDMC, MuleSoft). As a Salesforce practitioner/leader, you help customers bring the Salesforce ecosystem into the broader landscape of technology investments they've already made — balancing platform-agnostic execution (interoperable, open-standards, multi-vendor) and platform-centric execution (Salesforce-native), so the data foundation fits the customer's reality rather than forcing a single stack. Every foundation is built with governance, quality, security, and privacy embedded from day one, and serves both traditional analytics for people and agentic AI for machines.

You are a hands-on practitioner of AI-augmented professional services delivery and an emerging-to-established thought leader on the agentic future of the SaaS industry — applying a forward-looking perspective on enterprise data, AI agents, and the SaaS ecosystem to how you advise and deliver, and contributing that experience back to the practice's point of view. This is a customer-billable delivery role — a hands-on/senior individual contributor accountable for engagement outcomes and technical leadership, not an internal people-management position.

What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities)

Advisory & Strategy

  • Lead discovery: stakeholder interviews, current-state assessment, use-case and KPI definition; at senior levels, serve as trusted advisor to customer CxOs and shape the business case
  • Assess data maturity and build a phased, customer-calibrated roadmap
  • Align customer stakeholders and sponsors; contribute to/own the business case and expected outcomes
  • Frame guidance as adaptable options, meeting customers at their entry point (customer-360, regulatory governance, analytics modernization, unstructured/RAG)
  • Represent the practice in complex, high-stakes engagements

Architecture & Delivery

  • Design/set/approve target-state architecture across one or more of the platform stack (Salesforce Data 360 / Informatica IDMC / MuleSoft)
  • Deliver both platform-agnostic and platform-centric execution — integrate Salesforce cleanly with (or position it as the center of gravity within) the customer's existing multi-vendor technology investments (data platforms, warehouses, lakes, and tools)
  • Validate architecture decisions through scoped POCs before production build
  • Deliver working software/value every phase — no big-bang, governance-first discipline
  • Embed governance, quality, security, and privacy from the start
  • Build for dual consumption: analytics for people and agentic AI for machines


Delivery Oversight & Risk (Director-level emphasis)

  • Provide architectural governance and quality assurance across concurrent engagements
  • Own delivery risk: exec buy-in, business engagement, scope, and dependency management

AI-Augmented Delivery

  • Apply/set the standard for AI-augmented professional services delivery — use AI tools (Claude Code, Gemini, Lucid AI, NotebookLM) across the engagement lifecycle to compress effort and raise quality
  • Build (or define the approach for) reusable, capability-driven (not tool-centric) assets: prompt templates, skills, and agents that deliver a capability regardless of underlying tool
  • Work with human-at-the-helm rigor so AI-accelerated output stays trusted, auditable, and grounded; at senior levels, set measurable AI-acceleration targets and quality guardrails
  • Contribute proven patterns and assets back to the practice's playbook, accelerators, and reference IP


Industry Thought Leadership (Agentic SaaS Future)

  • Bring (or own) a forward-looking perspective on the agentic future of the SaaS industry into engagements — helping customers build AI-ready, agent-native data foundations
  • Contribute to (or shape) the practice's point of view — POVs, reference patterns, and enablement on where enterprise data and AI agents are heading
  • Grow as, or represent the practice as, an internal and customer-facing voice on agentic delivery

Governance & Enablement

  • Establish stewardship, RACI, and sustainable operating models with the customer
  • Produce clear, concise, executive-ready summaries alongside deep technical detail
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance/leadership to Consultants, Architects, and (at Director level) Senior Advisors on the engagement; hand off with runbooks and a sustainable operating model
  • Author and evolve the Data Foundation Delivery Playbook, accelerators, and reference IP (Director level)

What You Bring (Preferred Experience)

  • Unified Identity & Harmonization — identity resolution, match/merge, golden records
  • Master Data Management — domains, survivorship, hierarchies, 360 views
  • Unstructured Data Management — document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, RAG grounding
  • Data Architecture & Semantic Modeling — conceptual/logical/physical models, semantic layer, glossary
  • Data Integration, Orchestration & Activation — API-led connectivity, CDC, real-time events, activation
  • Data Trust, Security & Privacy — classification, access control, masking, Einstein Trust Layer
  • Data Governance & Stewardship — catalog, lineage, data quality, stewardship & policy
  • Industry Data Models & Accelerators — FSC, Health Cloud, Manufacturing Cloud blueprints
  • Data Platform & Infrastructure — lakehouse, compute, catalog, cloud foundation
  • Analytics, BI & Data Observability — dashboards, self-service BI, freshness/quality monitoring

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years (Senior Technical Architect) / 15+ years (Director) of hands-on data experience across data & analytics consulting, engineering, architecture, MDM, integration, and governance
  • Demonstrated delivery/leadership of enterprise data platform, MDM, integration, governance, or AI-readiness programs
  • Hands-on/deep expertise with one or more of Salesforce Data 360, Informatica IDMC, MuleSoft
  • Strong-to-authority-level data modeling (conceptual/logical/physical) and semantic/metadata modeling
  • Working-to-strong command of data governance, quality, security, and privacy (e.g., GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA)
  • Executive-grade communication, up to proven CxO-level advisory at senior levels; ability to guide delivery teams and lead multi-workstream delivery
  • Experience integrating a vendor platform into heterogeneous/complex enterprise landscapes — balancing platform-agnostic and platform-centric approaches
  • Hands-on-to-deep fluency with AI-augmented delivery — using AI tools as a core part of the workflow and building reusable prompt/skill/agent assets
  • A forward-looking, and at senior levels recognized/published, perspective on enterprise data, AI, and the agentic future of SaaS

Certifications

Certifications are preferred, not required — a proven delivery and thought-leadership track record carries the most weight.

Preferred Certifications

  • Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
  • Salesforce Certified Data Architect
  • Salesforce Certified Integration Architect
  • Salesforce Agentforce Specialist (Director)
  • MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect (Sr. Architect level)
  • TOGAF (Director)

Additional Pluses

  • Informatica IDMC / MDM certification
  • Salesforce Agentforce Specialist (Sr. Architect level)
  • MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect (Director level)
  • DAMA CDMP or CDMC

Preferred / Differentiating Strengths

  • Experience/track record delivering agentic AI / RAG on a governed data foundation
  • Industry depth/expertise in Financial Services, Healthcare, or Manufacturing (industry data models)
  • Track record/history building reusable accelerators and prompt/skill/agent libraries
  • Prior Professional Services / customer-facing advisory or leadership experience at enterprise scale


How Success Is Measured (First 12 Months)

  • Certification Attainment: complete required certifications to be compliant and ready for customer engagements
  • Discovery-to-roadmap / Customer impact: consistently produce customer-calibrated maturity assessments and roadmaps that secure signed charters; ramp quickly to be billable on one or more engagements
  • Delivery / Architecture standard: ship working, governed capability increments each phase, with consistent, governed, dual-purpose foundations across the portfolio
  • Advisory impact / Business outcomes: measurable stakeholder alignment and adoption; clear business (not just technical) outcomes realized
  • AI-augmented delivery: apply AI tooling to reduce delivery effort while improving consistency; contribute reusable prompt/skill/agent assets to the practice, adopted team-wide at senior levels
  • Thought leadership: bring a credible agentic-SaaS-future perspective into engagements; at Director level, own a defined, published practice POV shaping customer engagements and market positioning
  • Governance / Enablement: leave every engagement with a sustainable stewardship and operating model; delivery teams ramped and productive through technical leadership

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

jobs.title: Senior Bookkeeper
jobs.excerpt: Position Type: Full-Time | Remote Working Hours: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.
jobs.description:
Position Type: Full-Time | Remote
Working Hours: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday–Friday

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Senior Bookkeeper / Accounting Operations Specialist to manage financial records and support accounting operations. You will be responsible for keeping the books accurate, reconciling 10+ accounts, managing vendor and customer payments, tracking trip profitability, and maintaining accurate financial and booking records. You will also help improve systems, reporting, and automation to reduce manual work. The role requires strong Xero, Excel and Google Sheets experience, along with the ability to work independently and handle confidential financial information.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting & Reconciliation

  • Perform monthly and quarterly reconciliations across 10+ bank, credit card, HubSpot and accounting accounts.
  • Review and categorize expenses in Xero.
  • Identify duplicate payments, missing transactions, unusual charges, and discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation.

Payments & Vendor Management

  • Track vendor and customer payments, outstanding balances, and payment status.
  • Coordinate domestic and international payments, including foreign currency transactions.
  • Manage payments through platforms such as Convera (GlobalPay).
  • Work with vendors, operators, and internal teams to resolve payment issues.

Trip Profitability & Reporting

  • Track gross and net margins by trip or flight.
  • Monitor trip-related costs including aircraft, catering, transportation, and other operational expenses.
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual expense and financial reports.
  • Maintain vendor variance and fixed-cost reports.
  • Provide management with clear reporting on expenses, margins, and payments.

CRM & Systems Management

  • Keep HubSpot deal stages and booking information up to date.
  • Maintain accurate trip details, pricing, invoicing, and payment status.
  • Reconcile HubSpot data with Xero and other financial records.
  • Organize financial documents and shared accounting folders.

Process Improvement

  • Build and maintain Excel and Google Sheets templates, dashboards, and reporting tools.
  • Use formulas, pivot tables, and data validation to improve reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive accounting and reporting tasks.
  • Improve processes to reduce manual work and prevent errors.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in bookkeeping, accounting operations, or financial analysis.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Xero, including reconciliation, expense coding, and reporting.
  • Experience reconciling 10+ accounts on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets skills, including XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, pivot tables, and data validation.
  • Experience handling international payments and foreign currency transactions.
  • Strong understanding of financial reporting and account reconciliation.
  • Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to handle confidential financial information.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Convera GlobalPay and international payment workflows.
  • Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM.
  • Experience in private aviation, charter, luxury travel, or hospitality.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based companies and USD accounting.
  • Experience building automated reports or workflows.
  • Xero Advisor Certification.
  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Remote & Availability Requirements

  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated, secure workspace.
  • Must be available during 9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET, Monday–Friday.
  • Occasional after-hours, weekend, or holiday availability is required for urgent matters such as operator payments, declined cards, or vendor issues affecting active flights.
  • Must be reachable by phone and able to respond promptly during urgent situations.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, you will be expected to learn the company's systems and vendor network, reconcile all 10+ accounts, align HubSpot records with the books, complete a monthly close, and deliver trip-level margin reporting.

Over time, you will help make the accounting and reporting process faster, more accurate, and more automated while providing leadership with reliable financial information for business decisions.

Interview Process

  1. AI Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Offer Stage
