jobs.excerpt: Pulmovant is a Roivant-backed clinical-stage biotechnology company committed to transforming the lives of patients with pulmonary diseases.
jobs.description:
Pulmovant is a Roivant-backed clinical-stage biotechnology company committed to transforming the lives of patients with pulmonary diseases. Pulmovant’s first investigational candidate, mosliciguat, is designed to provide a novel, once-daily, inhaled treatment option for patients with pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD). Mosliciguat is a potential first-in-class soluble guanylate cyclase activator with a differentiated mechanism of action currently being evaluated in the Phase 3 PHrontier global clinical trial in PH-ILD, but with potential broad applicability across the PH and ILD disease landscape.

Pulmovant recently announced positive results from its Phase 2 PHocus study evaluating mosliciguat for the treatment of pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD), a progressive and life-threatening condition with significant unmet medical needs for patients. PHocus met both primary and secondary endpoints including the highest ever reported pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR) reduction in any randomized controlled PH trial. The robust results, in conjunction with mosliciguat’s once-daily, inhaled administration and potential first-in-class sGC activator profile, strongly position it as a potential single agent treatment and combination therapy for patients with PH-ILD. These data represent a significant advancement in a devastating disease that affects ~200,000 patients with no or very limited treatment options. A Phase 3 trial is currently underway. More details can be found in the press release here.

As part of the Roivant family of companies, Pulmovant leverages the power of collaboration and innovation to drive progress.

For more information, please visit .

About Roivant:

Roivant specializes in developing transformative medicines at an accelerated pace through the launch of nimble biopharmaceutical and health technology entities, each meticulously tailored to address a specific medical need. Since its inception in 2014, Roivant has achieved the following critical milestones in support of its vision: built over 20 Vants; 12 consecutive positive Phase 3 trials; 9 FDA approvals; 5 successful IPOs; >$6B in capital raised; >$10B in global pharma partnerships and proceeds; and continued pipeline expansion across various modalities and therapeutic areas through in-licensing and acquisition of novel product candidates and technology platforms. In addition to a robust clinical stage pipeline, Roivant also incubates discovery-stage companies and health technology startups complementary to its biopharmaceutical business.

Position: Associate Director, Drug Substance (Process Chemistry)

Summary:

Pulmovant is seeking a highly strategic Associate Director, Drug Substance (Process Chemistry) to drive the late-stage development, scale-up, and commercial manufacturing of our pipeline. Reporting directly to the Sr. Director of Drug Substance Development, this pivotal role bridges Phase 3 clinical supply with commercial readiness. The successful candidate will lead process design and tech transfer across our external CDMO network, applying rigorous Quality by Design (QbD) principles to ensure robust manufacturing and successful regulatory submissions.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

  • Drug Substance Development:
    • Partner cross-functionally with internal CMC, Regulatory, and Quality teams to design, optimize, and define highly robust, scalable drug substance processes
    • Direct the optimization and scale-up of manufacturing processes at external partners
    • Embed Quality by Design (QbD) principles and systematic Design of Experiments (DoE) methodologies to establish Critical Process Parameters (CPPs) and Critical Quality Attributes (CQAs) in preparation for Phase 3 and commercial filing
  • Technical Transfer and Scale-Up:
    • Spearhead the technical transfer of drug substance processes across global CDMOs, executing seamless, risk-mitigated transitions
    • Lead scale-up activities and process validation campaigns (PPQ) in strict alignment with FDA, EMA, and other major regulatory bodies
    • Oversee the implementation of commercial-scale manufacturing lines, ensuring process consistency, yield optimization, and long-term supply robustness
  • Regulatory and Quality Compliance:
    • Ensure all drug substance development and manufacturing activities strictly comply with global cGMP and regulatory standards
    • Establish comprehensive drug substance control strategies, including rigorous impurity profiling (mutagenic/nitrosamine impurities) and Proven Acceptable Ranges (PARs) per ICH guidelines
    • Support authoring and reviewing of CMC sections for global regulatory submissions (e.g., NDA Module 3) and help responding to agency inquiries

Education and Experience

  • Ph.D. or M.S. in Organic Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a closely related discipline
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in drug substance development and manufacturing within the pharmaceutical industry, focusing on late-stage development and commercialization
  • Strong background in managing CDMO relationships and outsourcing strategies
  • Demonstrated experience in process development, scale-up, and technical transfer
  • Knowledge of global regulatory requirements and cGMP compliance
  • Excellent project management, organizational, and leadership skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and influence internal and external stakeholders
  • In-depth knowledge of material sciences and solid-state characterization, including ssNMR, XRPD, and advanced spectroscopic techniques
  • Experience with inhaled/inhalation products is a plus

EssentialSkills andAbilities

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to present complex technical data clearly and interact effectively with regulatory authorities, global CDMOs, and senior corporate leadership
  • Proven, hands-on experience driving drug substance chemistry, manufacturing, and control (CMC) activities directly supporting a successful NDA submission
  • Prior experience preparing for, hosting, or managing a successful regulatory Pre-Approval Inspection (PAI)
  • Recognized Subject Matter Expert (SME) in late-stage process characterization, including Quality by Design (QbD), PAR/NOR establishment, Fate and Purge of impurities studies, and ICH M7/nitrosamine safety assessments
  • Highly fluent and well-versed in global ICH guidelines for drug substance development and manufacturing

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★
Customer Care Associate – Collections, Retention & Sales
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor
Industry: Retail & E-commerce / Fitness & Wellness
Compensation:$900–$1,300 USD/month
Schedule:Monday–Friday | 9:00 AM–5:30 PM Eastern Time

About the Company
Our client is a growing fitness, wellness, and technology company focused on making engaging workout experiences accessible through connected fitness products and digital memberships.
The business combines fitness equipment with a technology-driven membership experience that includes live and on-demand workouts, instructor-led classes, personalized training features, entertainment, and multiple workout formats.
Operating at the intersection of fitness, e-commerce, technology, and subscription services, the company places a strong emphasis on creating a positive customer experience throughout the entire relationship—from purchase and membership activation through ongoing support and retention.

About the Role
We are looking for confident and customer-focused Customer Care Associates who can successfully handle collections, membership retention, customer support, live chat, and sales within the same role.
This is a dynamic position where every customer interaction may be different. One conversation might involve securing a payment commitment from a past-due customer, another may involve helping a member reconsider a cancellation, and another could turn a customer inquiry into a sales opportunity.
You'll communicate primarily through phone and live chat, handle both inbound and outbound interactions, maintain accurate account records, and adapt your approach to each customer's situation.
This opportunity is ideal for someone who is comfortable on the phone, resilient during challenging conversations, commercially minded, and able to balance excellent customer service with measurable business objectives.

What You'll Do
Collections & Retention
  • Make outbound calls to customers with past-due accounts.
  • Professionally discuss outstanding balances and work to secure clear payment commitments.
  • Navigate potentially difficult financial conversations with confidence and professionalism.
  • Contact customers who have requested to cancel their membership.
  • Understand the reasons behind cancellation requests and use approved retention offers and save strategies when appropriate.
  • Communicate membership value naturally and persuasively while maintaining a positive customer experience.
Sales & Customer Support
  • Monitor live chat and respond to customer questions in real time.
  • Resolve customer issues and provide accurate information.
  • Identify potential sales and upselling opportunities during customer conversations.
  • Conduct proactive outbound calls to customers who have demonstrated interest but have not yet purchased.
  • Transition naturally between customer service and sales conversations based on customer needs.

Customer Records & Multichannel Support
  • Maintain accurate notes for every phone and chat interaction.
  • Ensure customer records provide a clear history for future interactions.
  • Work within CRM and/or ticketing systems to document customer activity.
  • Manage phone conversations, live chat, and account documentation efficiently throughout the day.
  • Type and update customer information accurately while communicating with customers.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • Previous phone-based experience in collections, retention, sales, or customer service.
  • Confidence handling difficult customer conversations professionally.
  • Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.
  • Ability to remain persistent and professional when customers decline an offer or initially say no.
  • Strong multitasking skills, particularly when balancing phone, chat, and account documentation.
  • Comfortable following scripts, retention structures, and approved offers while maintaining a natural conversational style.
  • Basic experience with CRM systems, ticketing platforms, or similar customer management tools.
  • Ability to type and document information accurately while speaking with customers.
  • Availability to work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:30 PM Eastern Time.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience across more than one of the following areas: collections, retention, sales, and customer service.
  • Previous experience with a subscription or membership-based business, such as fitness, SaaS, streaming, or another recurring-revenue environment.
  • Demonstrated success against collections, retention/save-rate, or sales targets.
  • Experience handling both inbound and outbound customer interactions.
  • Previous live-chat customer support experience
How Success Is Measured
  • Past-due customers receive professional follow-up and payment commitments are secured when possible.
  • Membership cancellation conversations are handled effectively using approved retention strategies.
  • Sales and upselling opportunities are identified and pursued during relevant customer interactions.
  • Customers receive responsive and professional support through phone and live chat.
  • Account notes remain accurate, complete, and useful.
  • Collections, retention, customer service, and sales responsibilities are balanced effectively throughout each shift.
  • Customer conversations remain professional and solution-oriented, including during challenging interactions

Why Join Us?
  • 100% remote opportunity from Argentina, Brazil, Costa Rica, or Colombia.
  • Join a growing business operating at the intersection of fitness, technology, e-commerce, and membership services.
  • Build valuable experience across collections, retention, customer care, and sales rather than performing only one type of support.
  • Work with customers across both phone and digital communication channels.
  • Have a direct impact on customer retention and overall business performance.


Important Notes
This is a multi-function customer care role, not a traditional customer-service-only position. Candidates must be comfortable making outbound calls, discussing past-due balances, handling cancellation conversations, identifying sales opportunities, and moving between service and commercially focused interactions throughout the day.
Experience in subscription or membership-based businesses is highly valuable, and candidates with measurable collections, retention, or sales results should be prepared to discuss those results during the selection process.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

As a prescription fulfillment and patient engagement platform, Nimble empowers independent and regional pharmacies to deliver a modern, consumer-friendly healthcare experience while streamlining pharmacy operations.

If you're a driven professional seeking to make a real difference in healthcare marketing at a fast-growing, innovative company, join Swoop and help us revolutionize how brands connect with patients and HCPs.

About the role

At Swoop, client excellence isn’t the responsibility of a single department; it’s a company-wide commitment. Client Strategy is a dedicated resource focused on turning that commitment into action, helping our most important client partnerships reach their fullest potential. 

We are looking for a Director, Client Strategy who brings strategic thinking and data-informed judgment to growth opportunities at the intersection of business strategy, narrative, and solution packaging. This person understands a partner’s business objectives, assesses market and performance signals, and shapes the right recommendation from the full range of Swoop’s capabilities. They can distinguish the real opportunity from the initial request, make thoughtful decisions about where to use existing solutions or configure something new, and connect recommendations to measurable business and health outcomes. They can also translate complex data, capabilities, and market realities into a focused, persuasive point of view, turning strategy into a story a client partner can see themselves in while helping a client understand the value, rationale, and path forward. 

This is a role for someone who brings both the discipline and curiosity of strategy: someone who can diagnose the opportunity, develop a practical recommendation, and help move it toward action. At the same time, they must balance partner needs, end-user value, commercial realities, and long-term scalability while connecting the work to the outcomes it ultimately drives for patients and their health. 

How We See Partnership

The brands we work with are partners, not just clients, and the people at the heart of it all are the consumers and patients navigating their health. That’s what makes this work matter beyond any single pitch: when we help a partner make better decisions and achieve stronger business outcomes, we can also help create more relevant support and better experiences for the people they serve. 

This role will help define how Swoop shows up in some of its most important growth moments, keeping that bigger picture in view while connecting market reality, partner ambition, and internal capability. It’s for someone who loves the art and discipline of strategy, who can hear the brief behind the brief, and who can create work that is sharp, persuasive, and actionable, all while helping build a team known for both creativity and results. 

Success is not simply a compelling presentation. It is a recommendation grounded in the partner’s business, informed by data and context, and designed to create durable value for both the partner and the people at the center of the work.

 

What This Role Owns

Customization here is thoughtful and disciplined. The best solutions sit at the intersection of a partner’s business needs and end-user health outcomes, and they are built to last, designed with scalability and long-term value in mind rather than as one-off fixes. This role brings the judgment to know the difference and to guide partners toward solutions that hold up over time. 

  • Turning approved corporate, product, and sales marketing materials into standout configured or custom pitches across Swoop-wide solutions for our top opportunities 
  • Developing proactive solution ideas and growth angles that support the Sales SVP’s account strategy across all client growth opportunities 
  • Surfacing net-new or newly configured offerings when partner needs and market conditions warrant it 
  • Collaborating cross-functionally to keep our highest-stakes opportunities strategically strong, commercially sound, and aligned 
  • Continuously evolving how the team works, including how we develop and advance AI as part of the team

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Partner directly with Sales client SVPs, SME division leads, and other commercial leaders on top-tier client strategy and high-priority growth opportunities. 
  • Lead the creation of configured and custom materials for innovation days, executive meetings, top client renewals, and other high-value partner conversations. 
  • Represent ideas and recommendations directly in partner-facing settings, in partnership with Sales, who leads the relationship and the pitch. 
  • Listen across the collective client team, synthesize competing viewpoints, and turn them into clear strategic recommendations.
  • Transform performance data and other business intelligence from raw numbers into clear, actionable insight. Determine what to ask next and turn evidence into recommendations and actions that advance a partner’s objectives.  
  • Recommend the right path forward: where to use existing assets, where to configure, where to customize, and where to challenge the brief to set the partner and team up for success. 
  • Push back effectively when needed, with logic, diplomacy, and conviction, when a request would dilute strategy or reduce the likelihood of success.
  • Surface recurring themes, unmet partner needs, and strategic gaps that should inform future offers, templates, and solution development.

The Art of This Role

Some of the most valuable work in this role happens before a single slide is built. Often, a partner or an SVP knows in their gut that something is right, or that something is off, but hasn’t yet been able to put language to it. This role is part strategist and part diagnostician: skilled at asking the right questions, examining the available evidence, and bringing together the business context, client perspective, and internal expertise needed to understand the real opportunity.

The work is to move from instinct to clarity, from clarity to a sound recommendation, and from recommendation to action. Done well, this person becomes a trusted thinking partner, someone people seek out when they need help turning instinct into strategy.

What Makes Someone Great in This Role

This person is: 

  • Highly strategic, but also highly practical 
  • Client-centered, with a strong understanding of partner needs and end-user value 
  • Data-informed and skilled at turning information into judgment and action 
  • Creative, without being attached to their own ideas 
  • Fast-moving, without sacrificing quality or attention to detail 
  • Independent, but deeply collaborative 
  • Confident, but not performative 
  • Comfortable being client-facing and representing ideas with credibility and warmth 
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, complexity, and senior stakeholder visibility 
  • Strong at pattern recognition, synthesis, and recommendation development 
  • Able to make complex strategy clear, concise, and persuasive 
  • Able to move between big-picture thinking and detailed execution without losing momentum 
  • Willing to challenge assumptions, redirect conversations, and push for a stronger path when needed 
  • Energized by growth, innovation, quality, and building something new 
  • Excited by AI as a coworker worth investing in, not just a way to work faster, but a teammate to develop into tools and assistants that make the whole team more effective

Skills and Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in client strategy, integrated marketing, commercial strategy, solutions, sales enablement, account strategy, or related client-facing roles 
  • Significant experience supporting complex, high-value accounts in healthcare, pharma, media, digital marketing, technology, or other solutions-based environments 
  • Strong experience developing strategic recommendations, pitch narratives, and executive-level materials rooted in client objectives, business realities, and available evidence 
  • Excellent communication skills, including strong presentation writing and verbal storytelling ability 
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, move quickly, and manage multiple high-priority workstreams at once 
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams 
  • Strong commercial instincts and comfort linking client needs to revenue opportunities, packaging decisions, and growth strategy 
  • Ability to interpret performance data into clear, actionable insight and recommendations 
  • Confidence and maturity to push back constructively when the better business answer requires it 
  • A genuine curiosity about AI and how it can elevate the way a team works

Preferred Experience

  • A strong background in pharmaceutical or media marketing, and a genuine passion for health and improving patient outcomes 
  • Experience supporting executive-level pitches, innovation meetings, high-priority renewals, or custom business development efforts 
  • Experience translating complex ideas, evidence, and capabilities into monetizable, market-facing recommendations or differentiated solution positioning 
  • Familiarity with go-to-market strategy, field marketing, commercialization, and sales enablement ecosystems 
  • Familiarity with the medical, legal, and regulatory (MLR) process and healthcare advertising considerations 
  • Experience helping teams improve process, create repeatable ways of working, or develop AI-enabled tools and assistants

About Stayntouch
Stayntouch is redefining how hotels operate. Headquartered in Bethesda, MD, we deliver a cloud-native PMS built for modern hospitality - flexible, intuitive, mobile-first, and designed to empower teams from the lobby to the back office. Our platform streamlines operations, unlocks new revenue opportunities, and elevates every step of the guest journey. Hoteliers can run their entire operation from any device, enabling staff to break free from the front desk and guests to personalize their stay from check-in to check-out. Trusted by iconic properties and brands, Stayntouch is the PMS for hotels that demand both simplicity and power.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Event and Field Marketing Manager to lead a diverse portfolio of events that build awareness, strengthen industry relationships, and generate measurable business results.

The Event and Field Marketing Manager will own the strategy and execution of Stayntouch’s event program, which includes several major industry trade shows and conferences each year, along with approximately 40 regional events, field marketing programs, sponsorships, consultant events, partner events, and smaller conferences.

This role requires someone who can think strategically while also managing the details that make an event successful. You will help determine where Stayntouch should invest, define the goals for each event, manage logistics and promotion, prepare our teams, and measure the impact after the event.

This is not a logistics-only role. You will be responsible for ensuring that every event has a clear audience, purpose, activation plan, and path to measurable results.

What You’ll Do

Event Strategy and Planning

  • Develop and manage Stayntouch’s annual event and field marketing strategy.
  • Build and maintain the event calendar across major trade shows, regional conferences, sponsorships, field events, consultant events, partner programs, and customer gatherings.
  • Evaluate event opportunities based on audience fit, market priorities, relationship value, pipeline potential, cost, and expected return.
  • Define the objectives, target audience, success metrics, budget, and activation plan for each event.

  • Identify opportunities to create more targeted field marketing programs around important markets, industry groups, customers, and partners.
  • Manage the annual event budget and make recommendations on where to increase, reduce, or shift investment.

Event Execution

  • Manage the full event lifecycle, including contracts, registration, booth selection, floorplans, shipping, signage, audiovisual needs, catering, travel, staffing, speaking opportunities, and on-site logistics.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for event organizers, venues, exhibit partners, production vendors, sponsors, and other external partners.

  • Attend key events and oversee on-site execution to ensure a professional and engaging Stayntouch presence.
  • Manage multiple events at different stages of planning without losing sight of deadlines or details.

Pre-Event and Post-Event Marketing

  • Develop integrated pre-event marketing plans that drive awareness, registrations, booth traffic, meetings, and attendance.
  • Coordinate email campaigns, landing pages, social content, digital promotion, appointment-setting efforts, invitations, and sales outreach.
  • Partner with Sales to identify target accounts and contacts before each event.
  • Create event toolkits that give attendees the messaging, schedules, account information, and resources they need to be successful.
  • Establish consistent lead capture, qualification, and follow-up processes.
  • Work with Marketing Operations and Sales to ensure event leads are routed, tracked, and followed up with promptly.
  • Develop post-event campaigns that continue the conversation with attendees and prospects.

Measurement and Optimization

  • Establish reporting that measures event performance across attendance, engagement, meetings, leads, opportunities, pipeline, revenue influence, and cost efficiency.
  • Analyze event ROI and provide clear recommendations about future participation.
  • Conduct post-event reviews with key stakeholders to document results, feedback, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop benchmarks that help Stayntouch compare performance across different event types and markets.
  • Continuously improve event playbooks, processes, reporting, and activation strategies.

What You’ll Bring

  • Five or more years of experience in event marketing, field marketing, or a related B2B marketing role.
  • Experience managing a large portfolio of trade shows, conferences, sponsorships, field events, and executive or customer events.
  • The ability to connect event activity to broader marketing, sales, relationship-building, and revenue goals.
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to manage several complex programs at the same time.
  • A hands-on approach and willingness to manage both strategy and detailed execution.
  • Experience managing budgets, negotiating contracts, and working with agencies and vendors.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Experience working with CRM, marketing automation, project management, and event technology platforms. Experience with Salesforce and HubSpot is preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience reporting on event performance and ROI.
  • The ability to travel occassionally and support events that may take place outside standard business hours.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, hospitality technology, travel, or the hotel industry is preferred.

What Success Looks Like

  • Built a clear and prioritized event strategy tied to Stayntouch’s business objectives.
  • Created consistent processes for planning, promoting, executing, and measuring events.
  • Improved visibility into the pipeline, revenue, relationship, and brand impact of event investments.
  • Increased pre-scheduled meetings, target-account engagement, and post-event follow-up.
  • Helped the organization make better decisions about where and how Stayntouch participates in industry events.
  • Delivered organized, professional, and memorable experiences for prospects, customers, partners, and employees.

Comprehensive Benefits That Have You Covered

Virtual Cardiology Program

We are seeking a Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant to join the Heart Center's virtual cardiology program. The APP will provide comprehensive virtual follow-up care, review diagnostic testing, support optimization of medical therapy, coordinate ongoing management, and facilitate appropriate escalation of care when needed. jobs.description:
The Company

Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

Job Summary

Granicus serves more than 7,000 public-sector agencies and powers approximately 30 billion digital interactions annually. Within the Office of the CTO, we operate an AI-native software development lifecycle: a production engineering model in which autonomous agents perform high-confidence implementation work and senior engineers orchestrate, review, and own the outcome. The model is established and operating; we are scaling it across additional delivery teams.

This role joins one of those teams. Our engineering standards are calibrated to the practices used by leading software and AI organizations — generator-verifier architecture, eval-driven development, staged deployment, and high-volume autonomous pull-request pipelines — operated within a FedRAMP-authorized environment. We are hiring practitioners who will set and uphold these standards, not engineers who simply use AI tooling.

Operating constraints (non-negotiable): agents execute only within branches; all agent-generated code passes senior human review before merging to production; autonomous execution is a force multiplier and does not transfer accountability away from the responsible engineer. Compliance obligations — NIST 800-53 Rev 5, WCAG, SOC 2, and applicable FedRAMP authorizations — are treated as engineering requirements and a source of competitive advantage.

Why this role exists

When agents produce the majority of initial implementation, the scarce engineering skill shifts from authoring code to directing it, reviewing it rigorously at volume, and owning whether it is correct. This role is for a senior engineer who has made that transition: decomposing work for the agent array, authoring the evaluation suites that hold agent output to a measurable standard, reviewing agent-generated pull requests with greater rigor than most engineers apply to their own work, and shipping production code within a FedRAMP-authorized environment. The role contributes to defining how engineers operate in an AI-native lifecycle, not merely to adopting AI tooling.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

  • Direct the agent array on production workstreams — decompose problems into tasks suitable for agent execution, dispatch them, and integrate the output into shipped software.
  • Review agent-generated pull requests at volume and at depth — identify correctness, security, and accessibility defects that automated tests do not catch, while maintaining review throughput and a consistent quality bar.
  • Author evaluation suites that make quality measurable — define criteria under which the pipeline validates correctness rather than relying on subjective assessment. Eval-driven development is your standard practice.
  • Own quality end to end — correctness, performance, security posture, and WCAG accessibility of the software your team ships, irrespective of which component or agent produced the initial implementation.
  • Advance workstreams along the autonomy ladder on the basis of evidence — move work from supervised to autonomous execution when measured reliability supports it, and revert promptly when it does not.
  • Strengthen the development lifecycle itself — identify where patterns, prompts, or pipeline components degrade at volume and work with the lead architect to remediate them.
  • Maintain agent operations within the security boundary — branch-only execution, vaulted credentials, sandboxed actions, and in-VPC inference. Throughput does not justify exceptions.
  • OWNERSHIP FROM DAY ONE
    • An active workstream directed through the agent array
    • Agent pull-request review as a core, high-signal responsibility
    • Evaluation suites authored and owned for your team’s deliverables
    • End-to-end quality ownership within the FedRAMP-authorized environment

  • SCOPE YOU WILL GROW INTO

    • Higher autonomy ratios substantiated by reliability data
    • Reusable prompt and evaluation patterns adopted by other engineers
    • Contribution to the lifecycle standards as a co-author, not only a user
    • Mentorship of engineers transitioning to agent-directed delivery

You Will Love This Job If You Have

Required

  • Strong engineering fundamentals. Data structures, systems design, and testing, with the ability to read unfamiliar code quickly and assess it accurately. Agents amplify engineering judgment; they do not substitute for it.
  • A record of shipping production software you owned the quality of, including responsibility for diagnosis and remediation when it failed.
  • Hands-on experience directing coding agents on production work, including their failure modes and the practice of reviewing agent-generated code critically rather than approving it by default.
  • Demonstrated code-review competence. You identify defects that automated tests do not catch, provide actionable feedback, and maintain a high bar without becoming a bottleneck.
  • High autonomy. You advance work without step-by-step direction and escalate issues proactively.

Preferred

  • High-assurance or regulated experience. Shipping within FedRAMP, defense, financial services, healthcare, or another NIST 800-53 / SOC 2 / HIPAA-bound environment.
  • Depth in evaluation authoring or test-first development within a rigorous engineering culture.
  • Full-stack range, sufficient to review front-end and back-end agent output with equal confidence.
  • Public-sector or govtech experience and familiarity with the relevant end users.

Indicators of a strong fit

  • You deliver more effectively by directing multiple agents than by authoring code directly, while retaining a precise understanding of the intended implementation.
  • You regard rigorous code review as a core engineering competency.
  • You prefer to establish quality through evaluation suites rather than through discussion.
  • You treat the agent array as leverage and reliably identify when its output is incorrect.
  • You want to contribute to how engineering is practiced here, not only to apply new tooling.

Indicators this role is not a fit

  • You measure your contribution by lines of code personally authored. That metric does not apply in this model.
  • You approve pull requests without thorough review under time pressure. At agent volume, this is the primary path by which defects reach production.
  • You are uncomfortable owning quality for code you did not author. Ownership here is intentionally decoupled from authorship.
  • You regard evaluation and compliance as impediments to shipping.
  • You prefer narrowly scoped tickets and no involvement in how the system operates.

Pay Range

USD $88,000.00 - USD $180,000.00 /Yr.

About Us

Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!

Security and Privacy Requirements

  • Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program.
  • Responsible for ensuring the data privacy of our employees and customers, their data, as well as taking all required privacy training in a timely manner, in accordance with company policies.

The Team

  • We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed workforce across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, India, Armenia, Australia, and New Zealand.

The Culture

  • At Granicus, we are building a transparent, inclusive, and safe space for everyone who wants to bea part of our journey.

  • Coffee with Mark sessions – Our employees get to interact with our CEO on very important andsometimes difficult issues ranging from mental health to work-life balance and current affairs.
  • Microsoft Teams communities focused on wellness, art, furbabies, family, parenting, and more.
  • We bring in special guests from time to time to discuss issues that impact our employeepopulation

The Impact

  • We are proud to serve dynamic organizations around the globe that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place — quite literally. We have so many powerful success stories that illustrate how our solutions are impacting the world. See more of our impact here.

The Benefits

At Granicus, we offer a comprehensive and flexible benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance—starting from day one. Here’s what you can expect as a U.S.-based team member:

Flexibility & Balance

  • Flexible Time Off – Take the time you need to rest, recharge, and live your life.

Growth & Recognition

jobs.description:
Job Title: Associate Press Secretary

Department: Communications

Location: Remote (Preferred MST or PST locations)

Reports To: Regional Director of Communications

Supervises: None

Context: At the Sierra Club, we believe in the power of interdependence. Together, we remain committed to the fight for a healthy climate built on a foundation of environmental, racial, economic, and gender justice – a future where all people benefit from a healthy, thriving planet and a direct connection to nature. As the climate crisis and deeply entrenched systemic racism all fuel injustice, we will continue to fight for a bold, transformational agenda that recognizes the interconnectedness between our planet, our humanity, and our future. By recognizing that our destinies are tied, we continue to name that all things are fundamentally connected, and the overlap between ecology, race, gender, and representative government will move to either advance our collective humanity or to oppress it. Sierra Club has close to 700 staff across the country and a network of 64 local chapters that are led and fueled by thousands of volunteers. We are also proud to be a unionized employer, with three labor unions representing more than half of our employees.

Scope: The Associate Press Secretary coordinates and executes communications strategies on key priorities determined in collaboration between themselves, their manager, and the Regional Field Director relating to the Sierra Club’s Energy and Conservation work in a set portfolio of states as designated on the Regional Turf Map. Any changes to the Regional Turf Map will be discussed and agreed upon in writing. Working with local staff, volunteers, and intersectional partners, the Associate Press Secretary is responsible for developing and disseminating strategic narratives that advance Sierra Club’s goals while remaining rooted in our organizational values: balance, collaboration, justice, transformation, and anti-racism To support that work, the Associate Press Secretary coordinates the development of creative assets to inform and influence decision makers; project manages the creation and distribution of advertising, videos, and other produced media; drafts and edits written content; and ensures messaging resonates effectively with various audiences.

This position is responsible for an array of media communications, ensuring timely and accurate materials with a consistent tone and message. A key component of the Associate Press Secretary’s role is leading media outreach by organizing press conferences and other media events; coordinating the submissions of op-eds and letters to the editor; pitching stories; tracking and reporting coverage; compiling data; and nurturing relationships to grow a diverse bench of spokespeople.

The ideal candidate should have a solid grasp of Sierra Club’s legacy conservation work, a conversational understanding of climate and environment issues, a personal commitment to and knowledge of social justice, and a passion for advancing progressive social change. They will also have the ability to articulate and reinforce the intersections of Sierra Club’s legacy work and communicate the challenges and opportunities we face, centered on justice and equity.

Job activities include but are not limited to:

  • Plan and implement communications strategy for the Sierra Club in a portfolio of states. Serve as liaison across internal teams and committees, as well as with external partners and stakeholders, to advise on communications strategies and tactics. Track media coverage of relevant issues. Develop and execute long-term and rapid-response media outreach plans to advance narratives and outcomes in a portfolio of states in adherence to the Jemez Principles for Democratic Organizing.
  • Develop messaging, written, and produced assets to advance Sierra Club goals in collaboration with state teams. Develop media messages, op-eds, press releases, video/audio, talking points, and other materials, and coordinate media events as necessary. Work with federal press secretaries to localize federal agency media opportunities.Create strategic media responses to relevant reports, Environmental Law Program work underway, and other external developments.
  • Contributes to staff strategy meetings, and stays current on substantive and political developments in major conservation campaigns by reading latest literature, attending meetings and maintaining contact with relevant sources.

  • Build relationships with local, regional, and trade reporters and influencers. Serve as a point of contact for those reporters in order to advance media coverage. Pitch relevant stories and connect reporters with spokespeople

  • Train and coach state-based staff and volunteers in strategic communications skills. Identify, train, and place compelling spokespeople. Support staff, volunteers, and partners with media training, messaging guidance, and interview preparation.

The successful candidate must have the following skills and experience:

    • Experience with media relations. You have professional experience as a journalist, media liaison, spokesperson, press secretary, or other position involving public relations. You have an understanding of best practices for using media to advance Sierra Club goals.

    • Excellent writing and verbal communications skills. You are a strong writer and communicator who is comfortable interacting with reporters, developing compelling messages, and drafting written materials for various audiences.

    • Ability to interact cooperatively and effectively with internal and external partners. You think collaboratively and can build strong relationships with staff, volunteers, and other stakeholders. You are capable of navigating challenging dynamics to achieve shared goals.

    • Committed to evolution. You are committed to continuously deepening and evolving your own understanding of systems of oppression through study, openness, and humility. And you easily recognize your own relationship to privilege and power, examining and shifting your behaviors as appropriate.

    • Uplifting and additive. You see mistakes as opportunities for growth; problems as catalysts for solutions, and inspire others along the journey. You carry a constructive approach, can-do attitude, a sense of humor, and authentic kindness wherever you go.

The strongest candidates will also demonstrate the following experience, skills, and competencies:

    • Demonstrated knowledge of energy, lands, and/or climate issues and relevant media landscape

    • Experience executing creative tactics including audio/video, podcasts, projections, murals, performance art, and advertising

    • Ability to build alignment between stakeholders while project managing competing priorities

    • Proficiency with Cision and/or other media outreach and tracking tools

    • Spanish language proficiency preferred

To Apply

The Sierra Club provides equal employment and advancement opportunities to all staff members. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, lived experience and skills. The Sierra Club does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, immigration status, socioeconomic status, ancestry, age, size, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, familial status, veteran status, disability, AIDS/HIV status, medical condition, prior conviction, arrest history, traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to, hair texture and protective hairstyles, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The Sierra Club values applicants who are people that identify as Black, Indigenous, and other minoritized groups; women; queer, transgender, gender non-conforming, and gender fluid people.

Explore, enjoy and protect the planet.

Applications will be accepted through Monday, October 12.

Job Description

RCM Coding Supervisor

Job Summary

The Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Coding Supervisor is responsible for overseeing coding operations and ensuring the accuracy, quality, compliance, and efficiency of physician coding activities. This role serves as the primary liaison between VillageMD, outsourced coding vendor(s), providers, and internal stakeholders to support compliant coding and billing practices. The Coding Supervisor provides leadership, guidance, auditing, reporting, and process improvement oversight to optimize coding performance and mitigate organizational risk while ensuring adherence to federal, state, payer, and organizational requirements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Coding Operations & Vendor Oversight

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for outsourced coding vendor(s), providing direction, performance feedback, and ongoing operational support.
  • Monitor vendor productivity, quality, service levels, and turnaround times to ensure contractual and organizational expectations are met.
  • Conduct routine audits and quality reviews to verify accurate assignment of Evaluation and Management (E/M) levels, CPT-4, and ICD-10 diagnosis codes.
  • Collaborate with providers and clinical teams regarding documentation requirements and coding best practices.
  • Identify coding trends, operational risks, and opportunities for process improvement.

Compliance & Quality Assurance

  • Develop, implement, and maintain coding policies, procedures, and documentation standards aligned with organizational strategy and regulatory requirements.
  • Research, interpret, and communicate coding and billing regulations, payer requirements, and compliance guidelines.
  • Investigate coding concerns, denials, and compliance-related inquiries, providing recommendations and resolution strategies.
  • Partner with Compliance, Revenue Cycle, Clinical Leadership, and Operations teams to ensure coding practices meet regulatory and organizational standards.
  • Maintain current knowledge of industry changes, including Medicare regulations, payer policies, National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) edits, and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs).

Reporting & Performance Management

  • Analyze claims, audit, and coding performance data to establish benchmarks and identify coding vulnerabilities.
  • Prepare and present audit results, compliance findings, and operational reports to leadership.
  • Develop corrective action plans and monitor effectiveness through ongoing audits and follow-up reviews.
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to coding quality, accuracy, productivity, and compliance.

Leadership & Team Support

  • Provide day-to-day guidance, coaching, and support to coding staff and vendor partners.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, teamwork, and customer service.
  • Assist with onboarding, training, and education initiatives related to coding and documentation requirements.
  • Promote professional and respectful communication across all levels of the organization.
  • Demonstrate compassion, professionalism, and adherence to company policies and procedures in all interactions.

Qualifications

Education

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent required.
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in a healthcare-related field preferred.

Certifications

  • Current Certified Professional Coder (CPC) or Certified Coding Specialist-Physician Based (CCS-P) certification required.
  • Certified Professional Medical Auditor (CPMA) or additional coding/compliance certifications preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum of 3 to 5 years of physician coding experience required.
  • Previous experience conducting coding audits and supporting compliance initiatives required.
  • Supervisory, team lead, vendor management, or project leadership experience preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Expert knowledge of physician coding principles, including Evaluation and Management (E/M) services.
  • Strong understanding of CPT®, ICD-10-CM, HCPCS, National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI), and Medicare Local Coverage Determination (LCD) guidelines.
  • Knowledge of healthcare compliance, payer regulations, and reimbursement methodologies.
  • Proven analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across departments.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to perform repetitive tasks, including keyboard and computer use.
  • Manual dexterity sufficient to operate standard office equipment.
  • Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods.
  • Occasional standing, walking, and reaching may be required.

Work Environment

  • Primarily office or remote office environment.
  • Frequent use of computer systems, coding software, and reporting tools.
  • May require participation in meetings and training sessions with internal and external stakeholders.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Provides oversight and direction to outsourced coding vendor(s) and may provide functional supervision, training, coaching, and performance feedback to coding team members as assigned.
  • Supports departmental leadership in achieving coding quality, productivity, compliance, and operational objectives.

Salary Range: This is an exempt position with a salary range of $74,000 - $92,000 depending on experience.

Overview

Due to growth, we are adding a Director, Provider Relations to our team.

The Director, Provider Relations is responsible for developing and executing the strategic vision for provider engagement, provider operations, account management, and provider support functions across the Lumicera Direct business. As a key member of the commercial leadership team, this position is accountable for the growth, retention, satisfaction, operational performance, and long-term strategic development of Lumicera Direct provider partnerships. The Director leads through subordinate managers responsible for account management, inside sales, provider support operations, and provider engagement functions, while partnering closely with the Director, Provider Sales and VP, Sales to shape market strategy, establish organizational priorities, drive provider adoption and retention initiatives, and develop scalable processes that support sustainable growth.

Is this you? Find out more below!

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

  • Develop and execute the provider relations strategy for Lumicera Direct, ensuring alignment with enterprise growth objectives, market expansion initiatives, provider engagement priorities, and organizational business goals.
  • Serve as the strategic leader responsible for defining the vision, priorities, and operating model for provider relations, account management, provider support, and provider engagement functions across Lumicera Direct.
  • Partner with the VP, Sales and Director, Provider Sales to develop and implement strategic initiatives that drive provider growth, referral expansion, account retention, and long-term business performance.
  • Serve as Executive Sponsor for key provider organizations, physician-owned clinics, health systems, and strategic provider partnerships to support implementation, growth, and long-term relationship management.
  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships with physician executives, practice owners, health system leadership, and key decision-makers to strengthen strategic partnerships and support organizational objectives.
  • Lead executive business reviews with provider organizations to assess performance, identify opportunities, address challenges, and align future growth initiatives.
  • Develop and oversee provider feedback channels that capture provider insights, operational concerns, market trends, and growth opportunities while ensuring actionable recommendations are communicated to executive leadership.
  • Act as the primary executive liaison between provider organizations and Lumicera leadership, ensuring provider perspectives are incorporated into strategic planning and decision-making processes.
  • Identify, evaluate, and develop growth opportunities that increase provider engagement, referral capture, service adoption, revenue generation, and market share.
  • Analyze provider performance metrics, referral trends, market dynamics, and business intelligence to recommend strategies that improve account growth and organizational performance.
  • Collaborate with pharmacy operations, clinical services, implementation teams, patient support services, and sales leadership to ensure consistent provider experience and effective execution of strategic initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain CRM vendor relations and support vendor selection activities.
  • Own departmental budgeting, workforce planning, resource allocation, and operational investment decisions to ensure organizational objectives are achieved efficiently and effectively.
  • Drive continuous improvement efforts focused on provider satisfaction, operational efficiency, referral conversion, service excellence, and business performance.
  • Provide executive-level reporting, market intelligence, provider insights, growth recommendations, and organizational performance updates to the Vice President, Sales and executive leadership team.
  • Serve as a pharmacist subject matter expert for specialty pharmacy services, provider engagement, referral management, patient access programs, and provider operational workflows.
  • Represent Lumicera Health Services at provider meetings, executive forums, industry conferences, trade associations, and strategic partnership discussions.
  • Travel up to 40% of the time for provider meetings, executive business reviews, leadership meetings, and industry events.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

What our team expects from you?

  • Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy or PharmD degree required. MBA, MHA, or Master's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, or a related field preferred.
  • Current, unrestricted licensure as a Registered Pharmacist in the state of residence, or the ability to gain reciprocity within 4 months, may be required based on state of residence laws or client contracts. Refer to the Licensure and Credentialing Verification P&P for current detail.
  • Advanced training or professional development in healthcare leadership, provider relations, or business strategy preferred.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in specialty pharmacy, healthcare services, provider relations, account management, provider engagement, pharmaceutical sales, healthcare business development, or related healthcare leadership roles required.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing leaders of others, multiple business functions, and provider-facing teams in a healthcare environment required.
  • 3+ years of sales leadership, leading sales teams and sales strategy required.
  • Experience in growth, market expansion, account retention, referral development, and revenue-generating initiatives, including building new programs, expansion of services, and creating new capabilities required.
  • Experience working with executive leaders to develop and execute strategic business plans, operational initiatives, and organizational growth strategies required.
  • Strong understanding of specialty pharmacy operations, provider workflows, referral management processes, reimbursement models, patient access programs, and healthcare delivery systems required.
  • Experience utilizing CRM platforms, analytics, forecasting tools, and business intelligence reporting to drive decision-making and operational performance required.
  • Proven success influencing executive stakeholders and translating provider insights into strategic business recommendations and organizational improvements required.
  • Established relationships within specialty pharmacy, provider organizations, health systems, physician practices, and healthcare industry networks preferred.
  • Participate in, adhere to, and support compliance program objectives.
  • The ability to consistently interact cooperatively and respectfully with other employees.

jobs.excerpt: About HighLevel: HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale.
jobs.description:
About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.

About the Role:

    We're looking for a Staff Front-End Engineer to own the architecture of our platform UI. This is a core platform role, not a feature role — you'll own the layer every other team builds on: the application shell, our module federation topology, the shared component library, build tooling, and the performance bar that applies across every surface of the product. You'll stay hands-on with code and architecture while setting technical direction across multiple teams and leading multi-quarter migrations without stalling feature delivery. Our stack is primarily Vue 3; strong engineers from React, Angular, or Svelte backgrounds are welcome, and existing Vue experience is a plus.

Responsibilities:

  • Failure Isolation: Design so a broken or slow remote degrades one surface, not the whole application — with fallbacks, timeouts, and the observability to identify which remote caused an incident.
  • Release Strategy: Own the deployment and versioning story for independent releases, including contract testing across host/remote boundaries, staged rollout, and fast rollback of a single remote.
  • Load Performance: Attack bundle size and dependency-graph bloat through code splitting, shared-chunk strategy across federated remotes, preloading/prefetching, and caching/CDN strategy.
  • Runtime Performance: Attack main-thread cost through long-task analysis, reactivity and re-render cost, list virtualization, and memory leak diagnosis in long-lived sessions. You're the person engineers escalate production-only regressions and render thrash to.
  • Performance Measurement: Define the metrics that matter (Core Web Vitals, INP, route transition time), instrument them in real-user monitoring, and enforce budgets in CI so regressions are caught before they ship.
  • Quality Bar: Set and enforce accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), internationalization, and cross-browser support through automated checks, not documentation alone.
  • Technical Leadership: Write proposals that build genuine consensus, review designs and code where decisions are expensive to reverse, and mentor senior and mid-level engineers across the org.

Requirements:

  • 9+ years of front-end development experience.
  • Expert-level JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, with a first-principles understanding of the browser — rendering/layout, the event loop, network/caching, and memory.
  • Deep production experience with a modern component framework. Primarily Vue 3 (Composition API); strong React, Angular, or Svelte experience is welcome if you're willing to go deep on Vue.
  • Demonstrated architectural ownership — you've defined a front-end architecture and moved a real codebase from one state to another without freezing feature work.
  • Hands-on production experience with micro-frontends or module federation, including the failure modes. Equivalent experience decomposing a large monolith by other means also considered.
  • Proven track record optimizing large-scale, complex web applications. Be ready to walk through a specific example with numbers.
  • Experience with modern build tooling at scale (Vite, Webpack, Rspack, Turborepo, or Nx), with enough depth to debug the build when it breaks.
  • Working knowledge of accessibility as an engineering discipline — semantics, focus/keyboard behavior, ARIA where genuinely needed, screen reader testing.
  • Strong written communication. On a remote-first, async team, most of your influence travels as design docs, RFCs, and PR descriptions.
  • A track record of mentoring engineers and driving change across teams you don't manage.
  • Nice to have: familiarity with Node.js, server-side rendering, and open-source contributions.

What You'll Lead:

  • The target architecture for our front-end, and the migrations that get us there — sequenced into reversible steps, driven with codemods and adoption metrics, agreed across teams rather than imposed on them.
  • The application shell and its contracts: bootstrapping, routing, auth-aware navigation, error and loading boundaries, and cross-application state.
  • Our module federation topology: host and remote boundaries, shared dependency and singleton management, and version skew between independently deployed remotes.
  • The shared component library and design system implementation, with APIs that are hard to misuse and safe to version.

jobs.title: YouTube Product Manager Intern – FR
jobs.excerpt: Are you the kind of person who spots a strong YouTube angle before everyone else?
jobs.description:
Are you the kind of person who spots a strong YouTube angle before everyone else? 🎯

We're looking for a YouTube Product Manager Intern to join our French-speaking team. You'll work alongside an experienced team and progressively take ownership of your own channels, with one simple goal: understand YouTube better than the competition and find what works before they do. 🚀

This is not a traditional content creator internship. You'll learn how to build YouTube channels as real products: finding the right opportunities, launching them, producing at scale, ranking for the searches that matter, analysing performance and constantly testing.

🏆 Our playing field is iGaming, mainly online casino. It is one of the most competitive markets on the internet, which is exactly what makes it interesting.

Our business model is affiliate marketing: our channels send viewers to the brands we work with, and we get paid when they sign up. This makes performance very concrete. You rank, you get traffic, you generate sign-ups.

The role

Your work starts well before the first video: identifying opportunities in the French-speaking market through keywords, search intent, competitors and content angles. Then you turn that research into channels and videos.

In practice, your work will revolve around five things:

  • Find opportunities: keywords, search intent, competitors and channel angles
  • Build and produce: launch channels, develop ideas, scripts, voice-overs, thumbnails and publish videos
  • Rank: build YouTube SEO-driven content strategies and optimise titles, thumbnails and hooks
  • Analyse: rankings, CTR, retention, traffic and conversions
  • Test and adapt: run experiments, understand the results and decide what to try next

You'll use AI and automation throughout the workflow and learn how to operate within YouTube's policies and the constraints of a regulated industry.

Most of your tests will not work. That's normal, and it's an important part of the job. What matters to us is your ability to understand why something works or doesn't, and then adjust quickly.

Who we're looking for

We care much more about your curiosity and the way you think than your degree or previous experience. We're not looking for someone who already knows how to do everything. We're looking for someone who wants to understand how YouTube works and who can become very good, very quickly.

The people who fit well here are usually heavy YouTube users who naturally notice why one video performs better than another. They prefer testing over guessing, are comfortable with numbers, and don't get discouraged when a test fails: they want to understand what it teaches them. They're resourceful and look for solutions themselves rather than waiting to be told what to do.

On the practical side:

  • You have some experience with video editing or content creation
  • You understand the basics of SEO, or you are genuinely interested in learning it
  • You already use AI tools and enjoy experimenting with new ones
  • Native French, as you will write and record voice-overs for a French audience
  • Good English, as it is the working language of the team

A strong plus: you've already launched a YouTube channel, website, social media account or another digital project. It didn't work? No problem. What matters to us is what you tried and what you learned from it.

What you'll get

💪 Real responsibility — not an internship where you just watch other people work
🎓 Support and training — you'll work with an experienced YouTube team
🛠️ Tools and data — several years of internal automation, processes and market data
🎯 Progressive autonomy — the more you show you can make good decisions, the more responsibility you get

💰 €1,000 / month

🌍 Full remote — with at least 4 hours of overlap with Bangkok working hours

🕒 35 hours / week, flexible schedule

What happens after the internship?

Our teams are young and built much more around performance than seniority. Several of our current Team Leads started at GreenTomatoMedia as interns. 🌟

This internship is designed as a way into the team, not as a temporary standalone assignment. Our YouTube department is continuing to grow, and interns who perform well are regularly offered permanent positions at the end of their internship.

From there, growth can happen quickly: more channels, ownership of a full portfolio, new markets, and eventually managing a team. 🚀

GreenTomatoMedia

We're a digital media company with more than 1,500 websites across 8 languages, several million visitors every month and a fast-growing YouTube department.

We don't work with clients or agency briefs. We build and grow our own products and brands, which means fast decisions, plenty of room to experiment, and the ability to directly see the impact of your ideas.

Our team brings together more than 45 nationalities 🌍 and we believe a good idea should win because it works, regardless of who came up with it.

The hiring process

  1. HR interview — background, experience and motivation
  2. Practical test — a real YouTube growth problem
  3. Final interview — meet your future manager

To apply: send us your CV and answer our screening questions. Send a link to a YouTube video you think is particularly well packaged — either your own or someone else's. Add a few lines explaining what makes its title, thumbnail and hook effective.

Salary: 1000

About us

Niricson is driving innovation in civil infrastructure inspection and risk management. Our technology (sensors, AI data analytics, software) delivers actionable insights into structural integrity—more efficient, reliable, and accurate than traditional inspection methods. We’re committed to excellence, growth, and building strong client relationships. As we expand and scale in the European region, we are seeking talented sales professionals who want to make a real impact.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced Sales Account Manager (Independent Contractor) to help lead Niricson’s business development and client relationship efforts across Europe. In this role, you’ll focus on expanding our presence within the infrastructure sector by developing new client relationships, identifying opportunities for collaboration, and representing Niricson’s technology and service offerings with professionalism and enthusiasm.

You will operate independently as a contractor, managing your own schedule and approach, while collaborating closely with our internal Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams to help grow Niricson’s reach and reputation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify, research, and engage potential clients across the infrastructure, engineering, and asset management sectors (e.g., public agencies, hydro dam operators, engineering consultants, asset owners). Utilizing various channels such as cold calling, email outreach, and networking events/conferences to generate leads and build a pipeline of opportunities.
  • Manage the full business development cycle, from initial contact to negotiation and deal facilitation.
  • Build and nurture relationships with existing and prospective enterprise and government-level clients through discovery meetings, delivering sales pitches, product demos, and tailored solution presentations.
  • Collaborate with our internal marketing team to develop and execute targeted campaigns to generate interest and engagement from enterprise clients.
  • Effectively navigate complex sales cycles and overcome objections to close deals within agreed timelines.
  • Develop long-term client rapport (e.g., with C-level executives, decision-makers, and influencers within target accounts).
  • Develop a deep understanding of the competitive landscape and industry trends to position our offerings and differentiate them from competitors effectively.
  • Collaborate with the product team to provide customer feedback, market insights, and suggestions for product enhancements.
  • Achieve and exceed assigned sales targets, including quarterly and annual revenue goals.
  • Ensure accurate and timely reporting of sales activities and opportunities in the CRM system.
  • While this is a remote role, you’ll collaborate regularly with the rest of the North American teams via virtual meetings. Flexibility in working hours may be required to accommodate time zone differences.

We aim to provide as much support and guidance as is helpful to you, but we encourage you to help set the path forward - your ideas matter here!

Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field. A basic understanding of civil engineering/infrastructure in general is also a plus.
  • 3–5+ years of enterprise sales experience, preferably within infrastructure, SaaS, construction tech, or engineering services
  • Proven track record of success in enterprise sales, preferably in the technology industry, with a focus on B2B & B2G solutions.
  • Strong business acumen and understanding of enterprise-level buying processes, including complex sales cycles and multi-stakeholder decision-making.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively articulate value propositions and build rapport with executive-level contacts.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented, with a demonstrated ability to meet and exceed sales targets.

  • Strong negotiation and closing skills, with a strategic and consultative approach to selling.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems and sales tools to manage and track sales activities.
  • Willingness to travel as required to attend client meetings, industry conferences, and other
    business-related events.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Able and keen to work in a lean, fast-paced, continuously growing environment.
  • Familiarity with European public procurement processes (federal, state, municipal)

Diversity and Inclusion

Niricson is a diverse and inclusive equal-opportunity employer. We encourage diversity, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, products, and our community. We are committed to fostering belonging through a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate against any race, gender, religious affiliation, ethnicity, or any other demographic - instead, we celebrate diversity.

We’re a close-knit, mission-driven team that celebrates curiosity, diversity, and excellence. If that sounds like you, we can’t wait to meet you!

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives.
