Students need transparent, competitive private options, exactly what Juno provides.

Your mission:

We're seeking a Partnerships Coordinator to be the operational backbone of our graduate team. Our vertical leads drive volume through partnerships — with schools, student organizations, prep companies, and creators — and every one of those partnerships comes with setup, deliverables, events, and follow-through. You'll own that layer, so the leads can spend their time on the deals that actually move volume.

What you’ll do:

  • Own partnership setup: Get new partnerships live — onboarding, tracking links, assets, and deliverable schedules — so nothing stalls between signed and launched
  • Activate and manage existing partnerships: Keep a calendar of every deliverable we owe and are owed, chase what's late, and flag what's underperforming
  • Coordinate events end to end: Webinars, campus events, and conference presence — logistics, scheduling, materials, and follow-up
  • Be the glue with marketing and design: Turn vertical leads' needs into clear requests for our central marketing and design resources, and shepherd them to done
  • Keep the system of record clean: Partner contacts, terms, deliverables, and performance tracked well enough that anyone on the team could pick it up

LiveOnNY is a federally designated organ procurement organization (OPO) dedicated to honoring, saving, and transforming lives through organ and tissue donation. You've found us at a good time. Hapana is opening new markets, shipping new products, and welcoming new brands onto the platform we're looking for the people who'll grow with us. This could be one of those right-place, right-time moments. Here's everything you need to know.

WHO WE ARE

Hapana powers the world's best fitness brands. Walk into a Fitstop, KX, Gold's Gym or J.I.M and there's a good chance our platform is running the whole show: memberships, bookings, marketing, payments, growth.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're looking for an Account Executive – SMB to drive new business growth across the USA.

You'll own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through discovery, solution design, negotiation and close. Your primary focus will be acquiring and growing relationships with SMB fitness brands. This is a consultative sales role. You'll work closely with prospective customers to understand how their businesses operate, uncover their commercial and operational challenges, and demonstrate how Hapana can help them scale.

You'll partner closely with our Solutions Engineer, Marketing, Customer Success and Product teams to deliver a compelling buying experience and successfully navigate multi-stakeholder sales processes.

You'll also be expected to build your own pipeline, develop strong relationships across the fitness industry and take genuine ownership of your territory and revenue target.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Negotiate commercial terms and confidently manage opportunities through to contract execution.

  • Develop a strong understanding of Hapana's product, integrations, payments offering and partner ecosystem.
  • Stay close to the fitness industry and understand emerging trends, competitors and the changing needs of operators.
  • Represent Hapana at industry events, conferences and trade shows across the USA as required.
  • Provide market and customer feedback to Product, Marketing and leadership to help shape our go-to-market strategy and product roadmap.
  • Partner effectively with Customer Success to ensure a strong transition from sales through to onboarding and long-term customer success.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

We're looking for an experienced salesperson who is commercially driven, naturally curious and genuinely enjoys understanding how businesses operate.

You'll ideally bring:

  • 3+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally within SaaS, technology, payments or another solution-led environment.
  • A demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and closing SMB opportunities.
  • Experience managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting through to negotiation and close.
  • Strong consultative selling skills and the ability to uncover business challenges rather than simply sell product features.
  • Resilience when navigating objections or changing circumstances.
  • Experience selling to multiple stakeholders and navigating more complex buying processes.
  • Confidence in engaging with and building rapport with founders, executives and senior decision-makers.
  • Strong prospecting skills and a willingness to generate your own pipeline alongside inbound opportunities.
  • Excellent presentation, negotiation and commercial communication skills.
  • Strong pipeline management and forecasting discipline.
  • The ability to manage multiple opportunities at different stages of the sales cycle without losing attention to detail.
  • Experience using HubSpot or a similar CRM.
  • A self-motivated approach and the ability to thrive in a remote, fast-moving and high-growth environment.
  • The ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, Product and Customer Success.
  • Experience within the fitness, wellness or franchise industry is highly desirable, but not essential.
  • Experience selling to multi-location or franchise businesses would be a strong advantage.

If you're reading this thinking, "I don't tick every single box, but this sounds like me," we'd still love to hear from you. We hire for potential as much as experience

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By the end of your first year, you'll have:

  • Build a strong, sustainable pipeline of SMB opportunities across your territory.
  • Establish yourself as a trusted commercial partner to prospective customers and as a credible voice within the fitness market.
  • Consistently demonstrated strong pipeline management, forecasting accuracy and sales discipline.
  • Built productive relationships across Hapana's Sales, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success and Product teams.
  • Developed a deep understanding of Hapana's platform, our customers and the commercial challenges facing multi-location fitness businesses.
  • Successfully closed new SMB customers and contributed meaningful new ACV to Hapana's US growth.
  • Demonstrated the ability to navigate larger and more complex opportunities, including Enterprise deals.
  • Built a clear territory strategy and repeatable approach to generating new opportunities.
  • Developed thoughtful approaches to connect with prospective clients, sharing successful strategies with the team.
  • Achieved or exceeded your annual sales target.

LIFE AT HAPANA

We believe great work happens when people are trusted, supported and given room to do their best work.

What you'll enjoy:

  • Remote Working – The flexibility to do your best work remotely.
  • Health, Dental & Vision Coverage – Supporting you and your wellbeing.
  • Helping you plan and invest for your future offering 401k
  • Summer Fridays – Finish at 3pm during summer and start your weekends early.
  • Birthday Leave – Take your birthday off, on us.
  • Wellness Days – Two additional wellbeing days each year, separate from annual leave.
  • Work From Anywhere – Spend up to two weeks each year working from anywhere in the world.
  • Home Office Allowance – Create a workspace you'll genuinely enjoy.
  • Paid Parental Leave – Supporting both primary and secondary carers.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Confidential support when you need it.
  • And we're continuing to evolve our benefits as Hapana grows.

JOIN US

We're building the technology powering the future of fitness, and we're only just getting started.

If you're an ambitious sales professional who loves building relationships, solving meaningful business problems and closing deals—and you want the opportunity to make a genuine impact in a growing global SaaS company—we'd love to hear from you.

Hapana is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. Different perspectives make us stronger, and they're one of the reasons we've come this far—and will continue to grow.

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

POS-33475

Senior Business Systems Analyst, Partner Systems & Automation

About the Team

HubSpot's Partner Systems & Automation team builds the systems, automations, and integrations that power HubSpot's partner ecosystem — one of the most strategically important parts of the business, representing a significant share of HubSpot revenue. We work across HubSpot's internal CRM portals, Workato, ServiceNow, Snowflake, and a range of third-party systems, and we are actively expanding our use of AI-assisted workflows to move faster from problem identification to working solutions.

We identify problems, design solutions, build them, ship them, and own them. Our BSAs sit at the boundary between business operations and technical execution — close enough to the business to understand what matters, and technical enough to build it. We are looking for a Senior BSA who thinks like a builder, operates like an engineer, and communicates like a business partner.

In This Role, You'll Get To

  • Take ownership of complex, cross-functional automation and systems work across HubSpot's Solutions Partner program — one of the most mature and technically demanding parts of our partner ecosystem
  • Identify inefficiencies and root causes across partner operations workflows, then design, build, test, and ship solutions
  • Build and maintain integrations, automations, and data pipelines using Workato and HubSpot CRM, with SQL and REST APIs as standard tools of the trade
  • Prototype AI-assisted workflows and automation agents, bringing them from idea to working implementation and iterating based on real usage data
  • Scope work rigorously — define the problem, quantify the impact, propose the right-sized solution, and know when to prototype before committing to a full build
  • Partner with stakeholders across Partner Operations, Partner Product, Engineering, Finance, and Analytics to translate business problems into technical solutions
  • Push back constructively when a request does not justify the investment, and help stakeholders understand why
  • Operate across multiple partner program domains over time — Solutions Partners is your primary home, but this team is deliberately moving toward cross-domain capability and you will be part of that shift
  • Contribute to the team's technical standards and share what you learn, so useful discoveries by one person become capabilities for everyone

We Are Looking For Someone With

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in a role where you built and shipped production systems — business systems analyst, automation engineer, internal tools engineer, or similarly technical operations role
  • Technical fluency across the systems stack — SQL, REST APIs, Python, and JSON are standard tools for you; you use them to understand, diagnose, and extend systems
  • Hands-on experience with iPaaS tools (Workato, Zapier, Boomi, or similar) — building and maintaining multi-step automations and integrations across complex systems
  • Comfort with engineering hygiene for production systems — version control, incremental rollouts, and basic testing practices that make what you build safe to operate and easy for others to maintain.
  • Either shipped an AI-assisted feature or automation that real users used, or have a strong production track record and genuine interest in applying AI to operational workflows
  • Comfort working in ambiguous environments where the right problem is not always the stated problem — you ask the questions that reframe the work before you start building
  • Experience working across multiple stakeholder groups with different incentives and priorities, and the ability to align people without formal authority
  • Strong written and verbal communication — you can explain a complex system to a non-technical audience and a complex business problem to an engineer
  • A sense of ownership that extends past delivery — you define expected outcomes before you build, check them after you ship, and treat the systems you own as your ongoing responsibility

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

jobs.description:
About Sundays for Dogs

Sundays for Dogs is a founder-led, direct-to-consumer brand reimagining pet food so dog owners can spend more quality time with their dogs — now and later. We make human-grade, air-dried food that supports long, healthy lives, and we build our company around shared core values that guide how we work and how we treat each other.

We’re headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, with a primarily remote team of ~50 full-time employees across the U.S. While we work distributed day to day, we come together in person on a quarterly basis because relationships matter. Our business today is 100% DTC, with our subscription model at the core of how we serve customers — and we’re building to scale with intention. We’re just getting started...

About your team and position:

The Operations team at Sundays for Dogs spans supply chain, fulfillment, quality, and is responsible for getting a premium, perishable product into customers' hands reliably as we scale from roughly $110M toward $250M. We run on an EOS/L10 operating cadence, which means clear ownership, weekly accountability, and a bias toward solving root causes over patching symptoms. We're in the middle of standing up a formal S&OP process and rebuilding our co-manufacturing network, so there's real ground to break in this role rather than a process to simply maintain.

The Sr. Planner will own the S&OP process end to end: demand planning, supply planning, and the monthly cycle that brings them together into one forecast the business can trust. You'll build the demand forecast, translate it into supply and purchasing plans across our co-manufacturing network, and own the inventory and service level outcomes that follow. This is a highly analytical, highly cross-functional role. You'll be the person who can say with confidence what we expect to sell, what we need to make, and what that means for inventory and cash.

The Sr. Planner reports to the Sr. Director, Supply Chain. No direct reports today, with room to grow the team as the S&OP process matures. You'll work closely with Purchasing and Logistics on execution, with Finance on inventory and cash implications, with R&D and Quality on new recipe launches and co-manufacturing transitions, and Marketing on demand model inputs and levers.

Your day-to-day:

  • Own the monthly S&OP cycle end to end, building the demand forecast, reconciling it with supply capacity, and driving the meeting where the business aligns on one number.
  • Build and maintain the demand forecast by SKU and channel, incorporating promotional activity, subscription trends, and new product launches.
  • Translate the demand forecast into a supply and purchasing plan across our co-manufacturing network, flagging capacity constraints before they become stockouts.
  • Own inventory targets and turns, balancing service level against working capital so we're neither out of stock nor overstocked.
  • Build the reporting that gives the business a clear, trusted view of forecast accuracy, inventory health, and supply risk.
  • Partner with Purchasing and Logistics to convert the supply plan into purchase orders and inbound schedules that actually land on time.
  • Flag and help resolve OOS risk early, working with Marketing, Fulfillment and Customer Care so the business isn't surprised by a stockout.

What success looks like:

First 30 days: Full visibility into current demand and supply data, forecast history, and open OOS risks, with a documented view of how planning works today across every SKU and facility.

First 90 days: A monthly S&OP cycle running on a fixed cadence with a documented process, feeding a single forecast that Purchasing, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain leadership all plan against.

Ongoing Metrics: Forecast accuracy, fill rate, and inventory turns tracked and reported on a consistent schedule, with OOS incidents caught and flagged before they hit the customer.

30/60/90 Plan: The scorecard (metrics of performance) and the 30/60/90 day plan for the Sr Planner role is met.

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in demand planning, supply planning, or S&OP, ideally in a food, CPG, or DTC subscription business.
  • You have proven experience building or running an S&OP process, not just participating in one someone else designed.
  • You have strong Excel or modeling skills and are comfortable building your own forecasts rather than relying on someone else's output.
  • You have experience planning across a multi-facility or co-manufacturing network, including navigating capacity constraints and lead times.
  • You have the ability to work cross-functionally and hold your ground on the numbers when priorities compete.
  • You have a track record of catching risk early and communicating it clearly, rather than letting it surface as a surprise.
  • You have the ability to operate with real autonomy in a fast-growing environment where you're building process as you go.

About Lively

Lively set out to raise the bar on benefit solutions, because we believe no one should have to sacrifice personal wellness for financial wellness. While traditional benefits focus more on transactions and less on the humans using them, Lively harnesses user-centric design and innovative technology to deliver an effortless experience for employers and account holders alike. Our modern HSA is consistently top-rated, and we have since expanded our offerings to provide a full suite of other benefits and services for companies, consumers, and financial institutions.

Lively is a remote-first company, headquartered in San Francisco with employees across the US. Come join us and help make getting the value out of your benefits as simple as it should be.

THE ROLE

Lively is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own how data moves between our platform and the systems our customers and partners rely on — payroll and HR platforms, benefits administration systems, carriers, and third-party administrators. You will own enrollment and eligibility data, file-based and API-based exchange, and the integration roadmap that connects Lively to its ecosystem.

You will also own the AI agent experiences that sit on top of that data layer, with a focus on onboarding and validation: agents that help customers and partners get their data into Lively correctly the first time, interpret what arrives, surface problems in plain language, and propose corrections. Integration work at Lively is increasingly AI-assisted, and this role decides where that assistance belongs and where human review stays mandatory.

Alongside this, you will shape Lively's forward data integration strategy: how our connectivity model evolves as the ecosystem moves toward real-time exchange, where we invest in building versus partnering, and how we make each additional integration cheaper and faster than the last.

This is a technically grounded product role. You will work closely with engineering on system behavior, data design, and agent behavior, and you will be the person partners and internal teams come to when they need to understand how the data actually flows. You will own large initiatives end-to-end and operate as the primary subject matter expert for your areas.

Please note: As a majority of our engineering team sits in Pacific time, candidate preference will be given to those in the Pacific and Mountain timezones.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Responsibilities are listed in order of anticipated time investment:

  • Integration Ownership — Own the data exchanged between Lively and its partners: what moves, in what form, on what cadence, and what happens when something goes wrong. Define the contracts that both sides build against.
  • AI-Assisted Data Onboarding & Validation — Own the AI agent experiences that accelerate getting partner and customer data into Lively: interpreting unfamiliar file structures, mapping fields, catching errors before they propagate, explaining what went wrong in language a non-technical administrator can act on, and recommending fixes. Define where the agent acts, where it advises, and where a human must approve.
  • Enrollment & Eligibility Data — Own the enrollment data lifecycle end to end, including how changes, corrections, and exceptions are handled, and how Lively proves its records match the partner's.
  • Reliability, Data Quality & Scale — Own the non-functional requirements of Lively's data integration platform: throughput, latency, availability, recovery, and the guarantee that data is never silently lost or partially applied. Define how failures are detected, communicated, and resolved. Plan capacity for the benefits industry's seasonal enrollment peaks and for growth in partner and record volume. Set the accuracy bar AI-assisted validation must clear before production use.
  • Integration Strategy — Set the multi-year direction for how Lively connects to its ecosystem: the target architecture, the migration path from today's model, the role AI plays in reducing integration effort, and the build/buy/partner decisions that get us there.

jobs.description:
CaptivateIQ is transforming the way companies plan, manage, and optimize sales performance. We started by revolutionizing incentive compensation management, and now we're expanding our platform to solve broader sales planning challenges. Recognized by industry analysts like Forrester and G2 and backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia, ICONIQ, Accel, and Sapphire Ventures, we empower high-growth companies like Netflix, Figma, and Stripe with the flexibility and insights needed to drive revenue performance.

About the Role

The Modeling Platform team is the backbone of every product in CaptivateIQ's modeling suite and sits at the core of CaptivateIQ's multi-year product strategy. This team is a force multiplier — the components, interfaces, and infrastructure it builds are what let every product engineering team ship modeling experiences fast, without re-solving foundational problems each time.

The team's surface area spans service-layer APIs, a modeling SDK, and extensible frontend components — and our goal is to evolve this into a self-service framework: simple enough to ship new modeling products at a fraction of today's build time, reliable enough that product teams don't think about the plumbing, and opinionated enough that they aren't re-solving the same problems every iteration. We're also building this as an AI-native platform, with first-class access and support for AI agents to build alongside human engineers.

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to own the technical direction of that evolution — a technical leader with strong engineering chops who embodies CaptivateIQ's values of ownership, bias toward action, and delivering real impact. You'll set the architectural direction for how the platform evolves, drive the multi-year technical strategy (with your EM and senior EPD leadership as partners, not gatekeepers), and make the tradeoffs that determine how product teams build on top of it.

It's a highly collaborative role — you'll work daily with cross-functional partners (Product, Design, EM) and with the product engineering teams building on the platform. You'll also partner closely with the SmartGrid team — CaptivateIQ's proprietary DAG-based computation engine that powers the framework underneath — helping shape architectural direction for the Modeling Platform Pillar as a whole. You'll drive technical alignment across teams, and invest deeply in coaching and developing engineers toward senior and staff-level impact.

Job Location

Remote - US

Responsibilities

    • Own the technical direction of the modeling platform's framework and SDK layer, partnering closely with the SmartGrid team on the underlying computation engine

    • Own and evolve the platform's framework, SDK, and interfaces — including agentic/tool-based interfaces for AI consumers — turning today's API surface into a self-service framework with the extensibility points that let internal teams build modeling products fast

    • Make the platform-level tradeoffs that shape it: what belongs in the framework vs. a product team's responsibility, build vs. buy, refactor vs. patch, flexibility vs. opinionated speed

    • Operate with high ownership and autonomy — drive ambiguous or contested decisions forward by pulling in the right stakeholders early rather than letting them stall, and own the outcomes months later, good or bad

    • Set the multi-year technical strategy for the modeling platform, in partnership with your EM, PM, Design, and senior EPD leadership

    • Drive technical alignment across teams — build the credibility and relationships that align consuming product teams around the platform's roadmap

    • Stay hands-on as a backend-primary fullstack engineer — the platform spans backend APIs, SDKs, and the frontend components product teams extend and build modeling experiences on top of

    • Grow and develop engineers on the team — coach toward senior and staff-level impact, set the technical bar through design leadership and review standards, and provide architectural guidance that scales beyond your own output

Requirements

    • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience with progression into staff-level technical leadership

    • Strong Python fundamentals with production experience in Django or similar Python web frameworks

    • Demonstrated experience owning a platform or framework layer — not just a service — that multiple internal teams built on top of

    • Strong backend engineering foundation with hands-on experience building frontend components that other engineering teams consume, extend, and build on top of

    • Track record of setting multi-year technical strategy for a platform or major system, with evidence of the strategy shipping and delivering impact

    • Track record of growing engineers to the next level — mentoring, coaching, and leading their technical development toward senior and staff-level impact

Bonus

    • Familiarity with Go, for collaboration with the SmartGrid computation engine team

    • Experience designing interfaces for AI agent consumption — tool-use schemas, MCP-style protocols, structured function-calling interfaces

    • Familiarity with columnar data formats (Apache Arrow, Parquet) and OLAP storage engines (ClickHouse, DuckDB, or similar)

    • Working knowledge of DAG-based or dependency-graph-driven computation systems

    • Experience designing SDKs or self-service developer platforms consumed by multiple internal teams

    • Experience at a B2B SaaS company during periods of significant growth or platform expansion

    • Familiarity with sales performance management, incentive compensation, or adjacent enterprise domains

Benefits

  • Flexible Time Off: Flexible vacation days plus quarterly mental health days to ensure you have the space to recharge.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Observability)
jobs.excerpt: introductionIAM Cloud builds software that simplifies IT management in the cloud.
jobs.description:
introduction

IAM Cloud builds software that simplifies IT management in the cloud. We are a fully employee owned, bootstrapped company - which means we answer to our customers and our team, not investors. With around 35 employees, we serve more than 3,000 organisations worldwide.

Being employee owned shapes how we work. Decisions are long-term, the culture is collaborative, and the people who build the company share in its success. We have leaned deliberately into AI and agentic workflows across the business as a core part of how a focused team competes with companies ten times our size. We are fully remote with employees in the UK, Ireland, Spain, Germany and Argentina and have been remote for years, as a deliberate choice about how good work gets done.

about the role

IAM Cloud is an Azure-first SaaS company with a small, fully remote engineering team. We run our own platform end to end: infrastructure, pipelines, releases and production operations all sit with the same handful of engineers. That means ownership is broad, documentation matters, and reducing toil is treated as a first-class goal rather than a side project.

We recently added a Senior Cloud Platform Engineer to own our CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code foundations. This role is the reliability counterpart: the person who owns how we see, measure and respond to what production is doing. You will own monitoring, observability, alerting and on-call at IAM Cloud, as the person who sets the standards, writes the policy and makes the engineering team better at running its own services.

Today our telemetry lives in Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights, with Azure Managed Grafana for dashboards and alerting. It works, but it has grown organically. Alert thresholds are inherited rather than designed, retention and cost are not governed, instrumentation is inconsistent across services, and our on-call tooling is reaching end of life and must be replaced on a fixed deadline in the first half of 2027. We want someone who can come in, take a clear-eyed look at all of that, and turn it into something deliberate.

Where we are heading

Over the medium term we intend to move more of our workloads onto Kubernetes (AKS), with Prometheus alongside Azure Monitor and OpenTelemetry as the instrumentation standard. That is a direction rather than a dated plan, and it is not the focus of this role in its first year. What matters now is that whoever owns observability here has a view on what good looks like on that platform, so that the standards you set today carry over cleanly when we get there.

What you will own (outcomes)

  • Define and evolve the observability strategy, target architecture and standards for the platform - what we instrument, how, where it lands, how long we keep it and what it costs.
  • Make Grafana the place engineers go to understand production: dashboards and alerting designed around services and customer journeys, not around whichever metrics happened to be available.
  • Establish service level objectives for our customer-facing services, with error budgets that engineering and product actually use to make decisions.
  • Rationalise alerting so that every page is actionable, owned and has a runbook - and so that the on-call engineer's phone is quiet when nothing is wrong.
  • Lead and champion the move to a modern incident response and on-call platform (incident.io or similar) integrated with Microsoft Teams, and design the on-call model around it: rota, escalation, and the post-incident review process that feeds back into the backlog.
  • Champion observability-first thinking across the engineering team, so developers instrument their own services well without needing you in the loop.

First-quarter deliverables

  • A written telemetry governance policy covering Log Analytics table plans, retention tiers, sampling and cardinality controls - with a baseline of current ingestion and spend and a target.
  • An alert rationalisation pass across Azure Monitor and Grafana: every remaining alert mapped to a service, an owner, a severity and a runbook; noisy or unowned alerts removed or downgraded.
  • Selection, delivery and cutover of a new incident response and on-call platform (incident.io or similar, Teams-integrated) to replace our current tooling before its end-of-life date, including parallel running and a documented on-call model.
  • SLOs and SLIs defined for the top customer-facing services, with dashboards and burn-rate alerting.
  • Looking further out: as our Kubernetes and Prometheus direction firms up, you will own the observability standards for it - collector topology, log routing, dashboards and alerting - so that it lands well-instrumented from day one.

Day to day

  • Design and implement OpenTelemetry instrumentation across our .NET services, and the collector pipelines that shape, sample and route telemetry.
  • Own Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights configuration, managed as code alongside the rest of our estate (Bicep first).
  • Own Grafana end to end: data sources, dashboards-as-code, alert rules and the conventions the team follows when adding to them.
  • Run the incident response and on-call platform once it is in place: routing, escalation policies, integrations with Azure Monitor and Grafana alerting, and the Teams workflow around an incident.
  • Contribute observability requirements and standards to our Kubernetes and Prometheus direction as it takes shape, alongside the platform engineer who owns that work.
  • Build and maintain Grafana dashboards and alert rules that answer real operational questions, and retire the ones that don't.
  • Lead incident response when it matters, run blameless post-incident reviews, and turn findings into engineering work.
  • Track and reduce reliability metrics that matter: MTTR, alert volume per on-call shift, incident recurrence, telemetry cost per service.
  • Evaluate tooling and AI-assisted operations capabilities on their merits, and give the team a clear recommendation rather than a shortlist.
  • Write things down: standards, runbooks, decision records, and the "why" behind thresholds.
  • Take part in a light-touch on-call rotation with the rest of the engineering team.

what we're looking for

What we're looking for (must-haves)

  • 6+ years in engineering, with 3+ in a reliability, observability or production-operations role where you owned outcomes rather than executed tickets.
  • You have defined SLOs, SLIs and error budgets for real services and can talk through how they changed decisions.
  • You have reduced alert noise - you can describe an alerting estate you inherited, what you cut, what you kept, and how you knew it was safe.
  • Hands-on OpenTelemetry: instrumenting services, running collectors, and making deliberate choices about sampling and cardinality.
  • Telemetry cost and retention governance: you understand that observability has a bill, and you have managed it.
  • Deep Azure Monitor / Log Analytics / Application Insights experience, including KQL, and strong Grafana skills - dashboards, alerting and managing both as code.
  • Infrastructure as code - Bicep is our standard; strong Terraform experience is fully transferable.
  • Clear written and spoken communication at C1 level or above, or native-level business English. You will be setting policy for a remote team; if it isn't written down, it doesn't exist.

Nice to have

  • Experience selecting, implementing or migrating incident-management and on-call platforms - strongly desirable given the first-quarter deliverables.
  • Prometheus-based monitoring and alerting, including exporters, recording rules and cardinality management.
  • Kubernetes in production, ideally AKS, and the observability patterns that go with it.
  • A software development background, ideally .NET, so instrumentation conversations with developers are peer to peer.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted operations and coding tools, and a considered view on where they help and where they don't.
  • Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305) or the CKA.
  • Experience in a small or scale-up environment where you were the observability function.

why us?

How we work

  • Fully remote across the UK. We meet in person a few times a year for team events, but day-to-day work is remote.
  • Small, senior team. You will work directly with engineering leadership and have real input into technical decisions.
  • Async-friendly. We use writing as our default mode of communication and avoid meetings when a written update will do.
  • On-call is shared and light. We invest in making the platform boring rather than relying on heroics.

Our Offer
£80,000 - £95,000 salary (dependent on skills & experience)

Guaranteed £2,000 pay rise every year you're with us, separate from any merit or promotion increases.

Time off and flexibility

  • 26 days holiday plus public holidays, with the option to swap public holidays for days that are more meaningful to you.
  • Your birthday and work anniversary day off, every year.
  • Up to 4 weeks per year working from anywhere in the world.
  • Genuinely flexible, fully remote working - we trust you to manage your own time.

Health, family, and wellbeing – UK employees

  • Generous Becoming a Parent leave, designed to support every kind of family.
  • Medical scheme including remote GP, dental, optical, and diagnostics.
  • Access to Support Room - confidential counselling, therapy, and coaching.
  • Help@Hand employee assistance programme.
  • 5x salary life insurance through Unum.

Money and growth

  • Up to 10% pension match (UK employees).
  • Annual learning and development budget per function.

Interview process

We respect your time and aim to keep this efficient. Our typical process looks like this:
  • Initial conversation (45-60 minutes): a chat with our Head of People about you, the role, and any questions you have.
  • Technical conversation (60-90 minutes): a discussion with a couple of our senior engineers about your experience, our stack, and how you've approached real problems. This will also include a short, scoped live exercise relevant to the work you'd actually do here.
  • Final conversation (45-60 minutes): meet our CIO and one or two future team-mates to talk about the team, the company, and the road ahead.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Job Title: LLM Engineer

Experience Required: 10+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are looking for an LLM Engineer to design, execute, and operationalize fine-tuning workflows for large language models across supervised, preference-based, and reinforcement learning approaches. The role requires deep practical experience with modern training stacks, careful dataset construction, rigorous evaluation methodology, and the engineering discipline to operate complex training pipelines reliably. The ideal candidate combines strong ML intuition with production-grade engineering practices, and is comfortable navigating the trade-offs between data quality, compute budget, evaluation rigor, and shipping velocity. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and execute fine-tuning experiments for large language models using supervised, DPO, RLHF, and related techniques.
  • Lead dataset construction, curation, and quality assurance processes for instruction tuning and preference data.
  • Build scalable training pipelines on top of modern distributed training frameworks.
  • Tune hyperparameters, optimizer configurations, and training stability strategies for large-model fine-tuning.
  • Implement parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA, QLoRA, and adapter-based methods.
  • Design rigorous evaluation suites including automated benchmarks, human evaluation, and capability-specific probes.
  • Implement safety, refusal, and policy evaluations to track model behavior across releases.
  • Operate large-scale training jobs on GPU clusters, diagnosing failures and recovering training state reliably.
  • Optimize training throughput using mixed precision, sequence packing, and efficient attention implementations.
  • Manage model artifacts, lineage tracking, and reproducibility across many concurrent experiments.
  • Collaborate with product, research, and platform teams to align fine-tuning roadmaps with business needs.
  • Document training methodology, results, and decisions clearly for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Mentor engineers on fine-tuning best practices, evaluation rigor, and responsible deployment.
  • Stay current with LLM research and translate advances into production-ready fine-tuning recipes.
Required Qualifications
  • Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
  • Six or more years of combined ML research and engineering experience, with significant LLM exposure.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks, especially PyTorch.
  • Hands-on experience fine-tuning transformer-based language models at non-trivial scale.
  • Familiarity with distributed training strategies including FSDP, ZeRO, and pipeline parallelism.
  • Experience with RLHF, DPO, or other preference optimization techniques.
  • Strong understanding of evaluation methodology, benchmarks, and human evaluation design.
  • Experience operating training jobs on GPU clusters and recovering from failures.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Track record of shipping or publishing impactful LLM work.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Publications at top-tier ML venues.
  • Experience with multimodal model fine-tuning.
  • Familiarity with synthetic data generation and dataset distillation.
  • Open-source contributions to LLM training libraries.
  • Exposure to responsible AI evaluation and red-teaming practices

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Senior Accountant, Inventory Accounting will support inventory-related accounting activities, including month-end close, journal entries, reconciliations, account analysis, controls, and audit support. This role requires a detail-oriented accounting professional who can work with large volumes of operational and financial data, identify and resolve reconciling items, and support accurate and timely financial reporting in a complex operating environment.


This position will partner with cross-functional teams to understand inventory activity, improve documentation, strengthen account reconciliations, and support consistent execution of inventory accounting processes. This role is especially important in a control-focused environment where the company is strengthening processes, documentation, and controls related to journal entries and account reconciliations. The successful candidate should be comfortable working in a dynamic environment, researching issues independently, and helping build practical, repeatable processes.


How you will Own It:


  • Prepare and support monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities related to inventory accounts.
  • Prepare journal entries, account reconciliations, variance analyses, and supporting schedules.
  • Analyze inventory-related activity to identify trends, discrepancies, reconciling items, and potential process issues.
  • Research and resolve differences between operational records, subledger activity, and general ledger balances.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready documentation supporting accounting conclusions, reconciliations, journal entries, and close deliverables.
  • Reconciliations, Controls & Compliance
  • Prepare and maintain complex reconciliations for inventory and related balance sheet accounts.
  • Investigate reconciling items and exceptions, perform root-cause analysis, and partner with cross-functional teams to drive timely resolution.
  • Execute assigned SOX controls and maintain evidence demonstrating effective control performance and review readiness.
  • Support improvements to reconciliation quality, documentation standards, control evidence, and close consistency across assigned accounting areas.
  • Support a control-focused accounting environment by preparing well-supported journal entries, maintaining high-quality reconciliations, resolving reconciling items timely, and improving documentation to support review, audit, and SOX requirements.
  • Assist with internal and external audit requests by preparing clear schedules, support, explanations, and follow-up responses.
  • Process Improvement & Cross-Functional Partnership
  • Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, IT, FP&A, Internal Audit, SOX, and other accounting teams to obtain information, resolve issues, and support accurate financial results.
  • Identify opportunities to improve manual workflows, strengthen documentation, enhance reconciliation quality, and improve consistency across assigned accounting areas.
  • Communicate questions, risks, open items, and recommended solutions clearly and timely to management.

What you’ll Bring:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of progressive accounting experience, including experience with month-end close, journal entries, account reconciliations, variance analysis, and audit support.
  • Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP, internal controls, and accounting documentation requirements.
  • Experience working with operational or financial data and reconciling activity across multiple systems or data sources.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage deadlines and follow up on open items.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, conditional logic, data validation, and ability to analyze large data sets.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain accounting issues clearly to both accounting and non-accounting stakeholders.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, completeness, documentation discipline, and timely escalation.
  • Preferred
  • CPA or CPA candidate preferred.
  • Public company, public accounting, multi-location, high-volume transaction processing, or other complex operating environment experience.
  • Experience with inventory accounting, cost accounting, balance sheet reconciliations, controls, or related operational accounting activity.
  • Experience operating in a control-focused, remediation, transformation, or high-change environment.

The successful candidate is a hands-on, detail-oriented accounting professional who is comfortable working with inventory-related activity, reconciling complex accounts, and supporting accurate financial reporting in a dynamic environment. Success in the role will be demonstrated through timely close execution, accurate reconciliations, audit-ready support, strong cross-functional partnership, and the ability to improve documentation and processes over time.

jobs.description:
Muck Rack is the leading SaaS platform for public relations and communications professionals. Our mission is to enable organizations to build trust, tell their stories, and demonstrate the unique value of earned media. Muck Rack’s AI-powered, comprehensive, and integrated platform streamlines the PR workflow to help businesses generate positive media coverage, monitor mentions to manage brand reputation, and analyze PR’s impact on business outcomes. By combining media database, monitoring, and reporting into one dynamic platform, we empower teams to collaborate seamlessly, pitch effectively, and analyze results faster and more efficiently.

Founder-controlled, fully distributed, and growing sustainably, Muck Rack has received several awards for its unparalleled culture and product from organizations like Inc., Quartz, G2, and BuiltIn. We value resilience, transparency, ownership, and customer devotion, and infuse these values into everything we do.

We’re looking for a collaborative, self-motivated Analytics Architect to join our Business Data Analytics team.

Reporting to the VP, Analytics, you’ll serve as the lead architect for Business Data Analytics, defining and driving an AI-first data and analytics architecture that modernizes our analytics platform and enables new ways for teams to access and interact with data.

You’ll establish the technical blueprint for a modern data analytics stack supporting Data Ingestion to Snowflake / Databricks, Data Modeling / Semantic Layers (dbt, Python, SQL), Natural Language Analytics (Agents), Data Activation (rETL, System to System), and Self-Service Analytics (BI Tools). You’ll collaborate across Data Science, Engineering, Product, and Revenue Operations to establish scalable architecture, integration patterns, governance, and engineering practices that enable trusted data and AI-powered analyticsacross the business.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and drive the target architecture for an AI-first enterprise data and analytics platform, establishing the technical direction and patterns needed to modernize and consolidate the analytics technology stack
  • Architect scalable data infrastructure, ingestion and transformation frameworks, storage models, and integration patterns across Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, Python, SQL, and related systems
  • Design governed semantic data layers and the supporting architecture for AI agents, natural language querying, conversational analytics, and other AI-powered data experiences
  • Establish architecture patterns for retrieval, APIs, and integrations that allow AI agents and applications to securely discover, understand, and interact with trusted enterprise data
  • Lead the evolution of data governance, security, privacy, access control, and compliance patterns across the analytics stack, balancing accessibility with appropriate safeguards
  • Establish and champion engineering standards for data modeling, testing, observability, CI/CD, documentation, deployment, and system integration, improving the reliability and maintainability of the analytics platform
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the Analytics Engineers on the team

To Be Set Up for Success in This Role, You’ll Need to Have

  • 7+ years of experience designing and evolving modern data and analytics architectures, including responsibility for architectural decisions that span multiple systems, teams, or business use cases
  • Deep experience with modern cloud data platforms and analytics engineering practices, including Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, Python, and SQL
  • Experience designing scalable data models, transformation pipelines, semantic or metrics layers, and integration patterns that enable trusted self-service analytics
  • Experience architecting or implementing AI-enabled data systems, such as natural language analytics, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, or related LLM-powered data workflows
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise data governance, security, privacy, access control, and data quality practices, with experience translating those requirements into practical technical architecture
  • Experience establishing engineering practices such as automated testing, CI/CD, observability, version control, and reliable deployment patterns for data and analytics systems
  • Demonstrated ability to set technical direction, evaluate complex architectural trade-offs, and influence decisions across teams without relying on direct authority
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex data and AI architecture into clear decisions, standards, and technical direction for both technical and business partners

If Any of the Below Also Describe You, This Could Be an Exciting Opportunity

  • You’ve helped modernize or consolidate a fragmented enterprise data ecosystem into a more cohesive modern data stack
  • You’ve designed semantic or metrics layers specifically to support AI-powered, conversational, or self-service analytics
  • You have experience taking AI agents or RAG-based data applications from architecture through production implementation
  • You’ve developed reusable frameworks, standards, or platform capabilities that increased the effectiveness of analytics and engineering teams
  • You enjoy mentoring engineers and raising technical standards while remaining an individual contributor
  • You’re comfortable operating in ambiguous technical environments where the architecture is still being defined and your decisions will influence how teams build for years to come

In Addition, We’re Always Looking for Candidates Who

  • Approach architecture pragmatically, balancing immediate business needs with scalability, maintainability, security, and long-term platform health
  • Build alignment across technical and non-technical teams and communicate architectural decisions and trade-offs clearly
  • Take ownership of ambiguous, complex problems and create clarity and actionable technical direction
  • Look for opportunities to create reusable systems, standards, and patterns that increase the effectiveness of other teams

Travel & Team Engagement Expectations

POSITION OVERVIEW

The role requires strong vendor management, negotiation, contract coordination, and stakeholder engagement capabilities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Receive, review, and process purchase requisitions in accordance with approved procurement policies and procedures.
  • Source and evaluate vendors and suppliers to ensure competitive pricing, quality standards, and timely delivery.
  • Prepare and issue RFQs, RFPs, and RFIs as required.
  • Obtain, compare, and evaluate supplier quotations to achieve the best value for the organization.
  • Negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, warranties, and service agreements with suppliers.
  • Prepare Purchase Orders (POs) and ensure compliance with the approved authorization matrix.
  • Coordinate with vendors and internal stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of goods and completion of services.
  • Develop, maintain, and regularly update supplier databases and approved vendor records.
  • Conduct supplier performance evaluations and recommend improvements where necessary.
  • Coordinate with the Legal Department for contract reviews, drafting, execution, and management of service agreements and SLAs.
  • Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards.
  • Maintain complete procurement documentation, including quotations, comparative analyses, purchase orders, contracts, invoices, and correspondence.
  • Monitor procurement budgets, spending trends, and identify cost-saving opportunities.
  • Coordinate with Finance and Accounts for invoice verification, payment processing, vendor reconciliations, and procurement reporting.
  • Prepare periodic procurement reports, vendor performance reports, savings reports, and management summaries.
  • Support internal and external audits by ensuring accurate and complete procurement records.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Technical Skills

  • Strong understanding of procurement processes, sourcing strategies, and vendor management.
  • Experience with RFQs, RFPs, RFIs, contract management, and supplier negotiations.
  • Knowledge of procurement governance, compliance requirements, and audit standards.
  • Strong analytical and commercial evaluation skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with ERP systems and procurement management tools is preferred.
  • Strong documentation, reporting, and record-keeping capabilities.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience managing end-to-end procurement activities in a corporate environment.
  • Exposure to supplier evaluation, contract administration, and procurement budgeting.
  • Experience coordinating with cross-functional teams including Finance, Legal, Operations, and Business Units.
  • Familiarity with procurement best practices, supplier performance management, and cost optimization initiatives.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Commerce, Procurement, or a related field.
  • Professional certifications in Procurement, Supply Chain, or Contract Management will be considered an advantage.
  • 2–5 years of relevant experience in procurement, sourcing, purchasing, or supply chain operations.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience.
  • Exposure to enterprise-scale procurement and vendor management activities.
  • A collaborative, professional, and growth-oriented work environment.
  • Continuous learning opportunities and access to professional development resources.
  • Opportunity to work with a globally recognized professional services leader.

You'll combine hands-on work with individual teams and internal consulting to shape secure designs, solve complex problems, and turn recurring risks and requirements into secure defaults, reusable controls, self-service platform capabilities, and automated security observability. This is not a GRC or audit role. Your impact comes from deep technical judgment, effective collaboration, and making good security decisions repeatable across the organization.

What you’ll do

Build automated security monitoring and response, including CVE detection, prioritization, remediation, verification, alerting, and visibility into control failures.

What you’ll bring

  • Deep security engineering knowledge across application, cloud, Kubernetes, identity, networking, data, and software supply chain.

jobs.title: YouTube Product Manager Intern – France (marché francophone)
jobs.excerpt: GreenTomatoMedia — Full remote — Stage 3 à 6 mois, avec possibilité d'évolution vers un poste permanent Tu es du genre à repérer un bon angle YouTube avant tout le monde ?
jobs.description:
GreenTomatoMedia — Full remote — Stage 3 à 6 mois, avec possibilité d'évolution vers un poste permanent

Tu es du genre à repérer un bon angle YouTube avant tout le monde ? 🎯

On cherche un YouTube Product Manager Intern pour rejoindre notre équipe francophone. Tu travailleras aux côtés d'une équipe expérimentée et tu prendras progressivement la responsabilité de tes propres chaînes, avec un objectif simple : comprendre YouTube mieux que la concurrence et trouver ce qui fonctionne avant elle. 🚀

Ce n'est pas un stage de créateur de contenu classique. Tu vas apprendre à construire des chaînes YouTube comme de vrais produits : trouver les bonnes opportunités, les lancer, produire à l'échelle, ranker sur les recherches qui comptent, analyser et tester en permanence.

🏆 Notre terrain de jeu, c'est l'iGaming, principalement le casino en ligne. Un des marchés les plus concurrentiels d'Internet, et c'est justement ce qui le rend intéressant.

Notre business model, c'est l'affiliation : nos chaînes envoient des viewers vers les marques avec lesquelles on travaille, et on est rémunéré quand ils s'inscrivent. Ça rend le résultat très concret. Tu rankes, tu prends du trafic, tu génères des inscriptions.

Le poste

Ton travail commence bien avant la première vidéo : chercher où sont les opportunités sur le marché francophone, mots-clés, intention de recherche, concurrence, angles de contenu. Ensuite tu transformes cette recherche en chaînes et en vidéos.

Concrètement, tu passeras ton temps sur cinq choses :

  • Trouver les opportunités : mots-clés, intention de recherche, concurrents, angles de chaîne
  • Construire et produire : lancement de chaînes, idées, scripts, voice-over, miniatures, publication
  • Ranker : stratégie de contenu pensée pour le SEO YouTube, optimisation des titres, miniatures et hooks
  • Analyser : positions, CTR, rétention, trafic, conversions
  • Tester et adapter : lancer des tests, comprendre leurs résultats, décider quoi essayer ensuite

Tu utiliseras l'IA et l'automatisation tout au long du workflow, et tu apprendras à travailler dans le respect des règles de YouTube et des contraintes d'un secteur régulé.

La majorité de tes tests ne donnera rien. C'est normal, et c'est même une partie importante du métier. Ce qui nous intéresse, c'est ta capacité à comprendre pourquoi quelque chose fonctionne ou pas, puis à ajuster vite.

Le profil qu'on cherche

On s'intéresse beaucoup plus à ta curiosité et à ta façon de réfléchir qu'à ton diplôme ou à ton expérience. On ne cherche pas quelqu'un qui sait déjà tout faire, mais quelqu'un qui a envie de comprendre comment YouTube fonctionne et qui peut devenir très bon rapidement.

Les gens qui matchent ici sont d'abord de gros consommateurs de YouTube, du genre à remarquer naturellement pourquoi une vidéo marche mieux qu'une autre. Ils préfèrent tester plutôt que deviner, ils sont à l'aise avec les chiffres, et un test raté ne les bloque pas : ils veulent comprendre ce qu'il leur apprend. Ils sont débrouillards et vont chercher les solutions par eux-mêmes plutôt que d'attendre qu'on leur donne.

Côté pratique :

  • Tu as déjà touché au montage vidéo ou à la création de contenu
  • Tu connais les bases du SEO, ou tu as vraiment envie de les apprendre
  • Tu utilises déjà des outils d'IA et tu aimes en tester de nouveaux
  • Français natif, puisque tu écriras et poseras ta voix pour une audience française
  • Bon niveau d'anglais, c'est la langue de travail de l'équipe

Un gros plus : tu as déjà lancé une chaîne YouTube, un site, un compte social ou un autre projet digital. Ça n'a pas marché ? Aucun souci, ce qui nous intéresse c'est ce que tu as essayé et ce que tu en as appris.

Ce que tu vas trouver chez nous

💪 De vraies responsabilités — pas un stage où tu regardes les autres travailler

🎓 De l'accompagnement — tu travailleras avec une équipe YouTube expérimentée

🛠️ Des outils et des données — plusieurs années d'automatisation, de process et de data internes

🎯 De l'autonomie progressive — plus tu montres que tu sais décider, plus tu prends de responsabilités

💰 1 000 € / mois

🌍 Full remote — avec au moins 4h de recouvrement avec l'heure de Bangkok

🕒 35h / semaine, horaires flexibles

Et après le stage ?

Nos équipes sont jeunes et fonctionnent beaucoup plus à la performance qu'à l'ancienneté. Plusieurs de nos Team Leads actuels ont commencé chez GreenTomatoMedia en stage. 🌟

Ce stage est pensé comme une porte d'entrée dans l'équipe, pas comme une mission temporaire. Notre département YouTube continue de grandir, et les stagiaires qui performent bien se voient régulièrement proposer un poste permanent à la fin de leur stage.

Ensuite l'évolution peut aller vite : plus de chaînes, la responsabilité d'un portfolio complet, de nouveaux marchés, puis le management d'une équipe. 🚀

GreenTomatoMedia

Une boîte de médias digitaux avec plus de 1 500 sites dans 8 langues, plusieurs millions de visiteurs chaque mois et un département YouTube en forte croissance.

On n'a ni clients ni briefs d'agence. On construit et on développe nos propres produits et nos propres marques, ce qui veut dire des décisions rapides, beaucoup de place pour expérimenter, et la possibilité de voir directement l'impact de tes idées.

Notre équipe réunit plus de 45 nationalités 🌍 et on considère qu'une bonne idée doit gagner parce qu'elle fonctionne, peu importe d'où elle vient.

Le process de recrutement

  1. Entretien RH — parcours, expérience et motivation
  2. Test pratique — une vraie problématique de croissance YouTube
  3. Entretien final — rencontre avec ton futur manager

Pour candidater : envoie-nous ton CV et le lien d'une vidéo YouTube dont tu trouves le packaging particulièrement réussi, la tienne ou celle de quelqu'un d'autre. Ajoute quelques lignes sur ce qui rend son titre, sa miniature et son hook efficaces.

  • You're comfortable solving problems and figuring things out
  • You learn quickly and adapt as things change
  • You care about the team, not just your own work
  • You bring a sense of humor and perspective to what you do

About the Opportunity

ClearGov is looking for a strong, hands-on Controller to lead the Company’s accounting organization and build a scalable, high-quality finance function.

Reporting to the CFO, the Controller will be responsible for the integrity and accuracy of the Company’s financial reporting, strengthening the monthly close process, leading the annual audit and tax processes, establishing and maintaining effective internal controls, and developing a high-performing accounting team.

This role is ideal for an experienced accounting leader who is comfortable operating both strategically and hands-on. The right person will be able to step into the details when needed, identify gaps, establish strong processes and controls, and build the accounting infrastructure required to support a growing SaaS business.

Key Responsibilities:

Accounting & Financial Reporting

  • Lead all accounting operations, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll accounting, fixed assets, accruals, prepaid expenses, intercompany accounting, and revenue recognition.
  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process and continuously improve the speed, accuracy, and discipline of the close.
  • Prepare and review accurate financial statements in accordance with U.S. GAAP.
  • Ensure balance sheet accounts are properly reconciled, supported, and reviewed.
  • Establish and maintain accounting policies, procedures, and documentation.
  • Research and document technical accounting matters and ensure appropriate application of U.S. GAAP.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the Company’s financial results and be able to explain key movements, risks, and accounting judgments.

Audit, Tax & Compliance

  • Lead the annual financial statement audit and serve as the primary day-to-day contact for external auditors.
  • Own audit readiness, including PBC coordination, supporting schedules, technical accounting memos, financial statements, and footnote disclosures.
  • Partner with external tax advisors and oversee federal, state, local, and international tax compliance.
  • Ensure timely completion of tax filings, information requests, and other regulatory requirements.
  • Proactively identify accounting, tax, and compliance risks and drive issues to resolution.

Internal Controls & Financial Governance

  • Design, implement, and maintain a strong internal control environment.
  • Establish appropriate review, approval, and segregation-of-duties processes across accounting and financial operations.
  • Develop controls around cash, payments, purchasing, vendor management, revenue, payroll, and other key financial processes.
  • Identify control gaps and process weaknesses and drive practical solutions.
  • Build scalable policies and procedures that improve accountability without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop the accounting team.
  • Assess team structure, capabilities, and resource needs and build a strong accounting organization.
  • Establish clear roles, responsibilities, performance expectations, and accountability.
  • Create a culture focused on accuracy, ownership, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.
  • Effectively manage and collaborate with team members across multiple locations and international teams.
  • Build strong relationships across Finance and with leaders throughout the organization.

Systems & Process Improvement

    • Evaluate current accounting processes and identify opportunities for simplification, automation, and improved controls.
    • Partner with the CFO and other leaders on financial systems strategy and optimization.
    • Support ERP and financial systems implementations, integrations, and process improvements.
    • Reduce manual processes and improve the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of the accounting function.
    • Ensure accounting systems, processes, and data support accurate and timely reporting.

Critical Skills/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
  • CPA strongly preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including meaningful leadership experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or similar role.
  • Deep knowledge of U.S. GAAP and strong technical accounting capabilities.
  • Demonstrated experience leading external financial statement audits.
  • Experience overseeing corporate tax compliance and working with external tax advisors.
  • Strong understanding of internal controls and experience designing and improving control environments.
  • Experience managing and developing accounting teams, including distributed or international teams.
  • Experience in SaaS, software, technology, or another high-growth environment strongly preferred.
  • Experience with multi-entity accounting and consolidations preferred.
  • Strong ERP and financial systems experience.
  • Advanced Excel and financial reporting skills.
  • A hands-on accounting leader who is willing to get into the details when necessary.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to distinguish between what is urgent, what is important, and what can wait.
  • High standards for accuracy, documentation, controls, and follow-through.
  • A builder who can assess what exists today and create stronger, more scalable processes.
  • Someone who takes ownership of problems and drives them through resolution.
  • Strong communicator who can work effectively with executives, auditors, advisors, and cross-functional teams.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with competing priorities.
  • Practical and solutions-oriented — able to strengthen controls and processes without over-engineering them.
  • High integrity, strong accountability, and a collaborative leadership style.

Compensation:

  • In the spirit of transparency, we are excited to share the base salary for this position is $160,000 - $200,000 USD and exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. If you are hired at ClearGov, your final base salary compensation will be determined by factors such as skills, interview performance, education and/or experience. In addition to those factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above is the full base salary for the role. Hiring beyond the base range would not be typical in order to allow for future & continued salary growth. We also offer a generous compensation and benefits package (more information on benefits listed below).

Why Join ClearGov

jobs.companyName: Center for Survivor Agency and Justice
jobs.description:
CSAJ Seeking New Members for Board of Directors

The Center for Survivor Agency and Justice (CSAJ) is a unique national nonprofit advocacy organization that advances economic equity for survivors of domestic and sexual violence to enhance their safety and agency. It does innovative and vital work at the intersection of gender-based violence, poverty, and social inequality. See .

CSAJ envisions a world where everyone has equal access to physical safety, economic security, and human dignity. We strive toward this vision by developing and promoting advocacy approaches that remove systemic barriers, enhance organizational responses, and improve professional practices to assist domestic and sexual violence survivors.

Nonprofit Board Opportunity

CSAJ plans to add up to four new board members within the next year. We welcome applications throughout the year from individuals excited about CSAJ’s work and eager to help us increase our impact and advance our important mission. We strongly encourage applications from BIPOC (Black, Indigenous, People of Color) and LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, and members of other marginalized communities who can lend their lived experience to advance CSAJ’s mission.

The members of CSAJ’s Board of Directors, who come from both the nonprofit and for-profit sectors, are united in their dedication to the organization’s mission. Individual board members focus on one of more of five key strategic areas: (1) individual donor development and cultivation; (2) foundation and corporate fundraising development and partnership building; (3) communications, media, and public relations; (4) nonprofit management and board development; and (5) strategic planning and implementation.

At this time, CSAJ is seeking new board members who can contribute to the first two strategic areas above: individual donor development and foundation/corporate fundraising.

Application Instructions

Please provide the contact information requested in the online application and upload a current resume and letter of interest. Please limit your letter of interest to no more than 1,000 words, and in the course of the letter, please be sure to address the following questions:

  • Which one or two of the five key strategic areas listed above would you be most interested in focusing on as a board member? Explain.
  • What special skills or experience would you bring to the board that bears on the strategic areas in which you are most interested?
  • More broadly, in what ways do your personal experiences and perspectives make you especially well-suited to contribute to the mission and goals of our organization?
  • What strategies would you employ to engage diverse stakeholders and foster partnerships that align with CSAJ's mission?

The Board Recruitment Committee will review applications on a rolling basis. If you have any questions, please contact CSAJ’s Founder and Executive Director, Erika Sussman, at .

More about CSAJ and Its Work

There is no safety for domestic violence survivors without access to economic security. Domestic violence leads to economic hardship, and economic hardship in turn, leads to increased vulnerability to violence. Almost all (99%) of domestic violence survivors report that they experience economic abuse. The impacts of abuse result in an economic ripple effect that compounds and creates lifelong barriers to safety for survivors. People marginalized by race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, immigration status, and ability are disproportionately subject to poverty due to structural inequities that are built into our policies and institutions. With unequal access to economic resources, survivors from marginalized communities are substantially (almost two times) more vulnerable to violence.

CSAJ has mounted several highly impactful efforts since its inception. The Consumer Rights for Domestic and Sexual Violence Survivors Initiative enhances economic justice for survivors of domestic and sexual violence by building the capacity of and building partnerships between domestic and social violence attorneys and anti-poverty lawyers. The Race and Economic Equity for Survivors Initiative addresses the systemic economic inequities facing survivors of color. The Access to Justice for Survivors Project lifts up, and enhances the advocacy of non-lawyer advocates in addressing the costs of domestic violence. The Accounting for Economic Security Atlas Project aims to shift the paradigm of economic justice from one emphasizing individual self-sufficiency to one focused on expanding economic agency. Our newest initiative, the Mapping and Advancing Equity for Survivors Project, is a groundbreaking project that builds the capacity of coalitions and programs to address the systemic economic and racial inequities facing survivors through systems and policy advocacy.

CSAJ carries out its work through three Levels of Impact: (1) enhancing Individual Advocacy by lawyers and other advocates for survivor agency and justice; (2) enhancing Community and Organizational efforts to create institutional change that will further survivor agency and justice; and (3) supporting and leading efforts to put in place Systems and Policy changes aimed at economic barriers to survivor agency and justice.

More about Board Member Responsibilities

Board members are expected to:

  • Actively participate in the board’s four regular meetings each year and any special meetings that are called. Because our board members live in cities across the country, all meetings other than one regular meeting per year are virtual rather than in person.
  • Actively participate in one or more board committees, which meet between the quarterly board meetings.
  • Play an active fundraising role to secure the financial resources necessary for CSAJ to achieve its mission. This includes making personal financial contributions and leveraging personal and professional networks to ensure the success of CSAJ’s fundraising efforts.
  • Be knowledgeable and enthusiastic spokespeople for CSAJ’s mission, programs, and services to their local communities and those in their personal and professional networks.
  • Read and understand CSAJ’s financial statements and help the board fulfill its fiduciary responsibilities in other ways.

Board members serve 3-year terms, with opportunity for renewal. CSAJ board service is unpaid.
