Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About PODS Team

People and Talent support the members of our Consensys community. We strive to be the destination employer of choice for our ecosystem. That goal is embedded in all the work we do to attract, retain and support our incredible talent.

PODS — People Operations, Data & Systems — is the infrastructure layer behind everything our People team does — the systems, data, and operational processes that make it possible to hire, pay, onboard, develop, and support people at scale. When this function works well, it's invisible. When it doesn't, everyone notices.

We're looking for someone to take ownership of our core People systems. In this role, you will be the primary subject matter expert on ADP Workforce Now and the broader HR technology ecosystem, the person Finance calls when People data doesn't match, the person Legal calls when they need audit evidence, and the person the People & Talent team relies on for system builds, enhancements, and troubleshooting.

What you’ll do

HRIS administration and system integrity

You are the technical owner of ADP Workforce Now and the PODS technology ecosystem. System health, configuration, data integrity, and day-to-day administration are yours — not tasks you contribute to, but outcomes you own.

  • Platform ownership — Manage day-to-day ADP WFN configuration, security roles, workflows, custom fields, and system health. You know where everything is, why it's set up the way it is, and what breaks if it changes.
  • Business process design — Take business needs from requirements through configuration, testing, and post-launch validation — end to end, without handing off. When a stakeholder brings you a problem, you translate it into a working system solution and own it through to adoption.
  • Product releases — Own configuration, testing, and rollout of new ADP product releases and system enhancements. Proactively flag opportunities to simplify or automate existing processes before problems surface.
  • Integration management — Own all system integrations across payroll entities, benefits carriers, finance tools, and core HR platforms — both automated API connections and manual data flows. Monitor, troubleshoot, and escalate when things break.
  • Security and access — Manage role-based access across HR systems, enforce least-privilege standards, and maintain SOX-ready access review evidence on a defined cadence.
  • Vendor management — Own day-to-day vendor relationships across the stack — performance accountability, escalation paths, SLA tracking, and contract awareness. Not just ticket submission.

Technical project ownership and process automation

You lead technical workstreams from intake through completion — representing the People Operations perspective on systems, data, and integration projects across the organization.

  • Technical project ownership — Own HR systems and data projects end to end — scoping, configuration, testing, rollout, and documentation. You represent PODS interests in cross-functional projects and ensure the People Operations perspective is built into technical decisions, not bolted on afterward.
  • Process automation — Systematically replace manual, error-prone workflows with automated processes. Use AI-assisted tools to rapidly prototype and build People Operations automations — turning process ideas into working solutions on fast, business-critical timelines. Measure the reduction in manual effort and error rates over time.
  • SOX and compliance — Maintain documented controls, gather and organize audit evidence, and partner with Legal and Finance to ensure People systems meet compliance requirements at every stage.
  • Change management — Test before deploying. Document after deploying. Communicate to stakeholders before either. Every system change has a testing plan, a rollout plan, and a runbook.

Data management and stakeholder enablement

You are the check-and-balance for People data across the organization — and the person who makes that data accessible and understandable to the people who depend on it.

  • Data governance — Establish and maintain data definitions, quality standards, field ownership, and retention policies. When two stakeholders get different answers to the same question, you are the reason that stops happening.
  • Reporting and analysis — Prepare, review, and analyze People data and reports. Build custom reports and executive-facing dashboards in ADP and connected tools. Translate outputs into clear, actionable information for Finance, FP&A, Legal, and People leadership.
  • Audits — Run recurring data audits, maintain audit logs, and ensure evidence is organized and retrievable. Catch discrepancies before they reach stakeholders.
  • Documentation and training — Maintain up-to-date process documentation and deliver training materials for new system enhancements. Build genuine self-service capability in the HR team — reducing the ad hoc support load over time.

Operational support

You provide timely, effective support for daily system needs and cyclical operations — and you use patterns in that support to build lasting fixes rather than repeat the same interventions.

  • Employee and manager support — Provide responsive support for system questions, access issues, and ad hoc requests. Identify recurring patterns and build runbooks or automations to address root causes.
  • Cyclical operations — Own the systems side of open enrollment, compensation cycles, re-orgs, payroll close, and year-end processes. These run on a schedule — they need to run without heroics.
  • Vendor relationships — Hold vendors accountable to SLAs, manage escalations above the support queue, and keep contract renewal dates on the radar.

Would be great if you brought this to the role

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in HR systems administration, HRIS configuration, or HR technology operations
  • A track record of business process design end to end — you've taken requirements from a stakeholder conversation through configuration, testing, launch, and post-launch validation without handing off
  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business needs into working system solutions — you ask the right questions, design the right solution, and build it
  • Experience with process automation and AI-assisted tooling — you've used modern tools to prototype and build automations that eliminated meaningful manual effort, and you can point to the results
  • Strong data management instincts — you've built custom reports, run data audits, caught data quality issues before they became business problems, and you understand what governance actually means in practice
  • SOX or audit compliance experience — you understand what controls mean, what evidence looks like, and what an auditor will ask for
  • Project management capability — you've managed a high volume of requests and shifting priorities without losing track of what matters most, and you communicate status without being asked
  • Intellectual curiosity and sound judgment — you ask why something works the way it does, and you know when to move fast and when to slow down and think
  • A bias for action paired with resilience in ambiguity — you've operated in fast-moving environments where requirements changed mid-project and you didn't wait for perfect information to make progress

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. Compensation for candidates based outside the US (including Canada, EMEA, and LATAM) will be determined based on location, experience, and skills during the interview process, and may differ from the listed US range.

jobs.excerpt: About UnconventionalSince 2022, AI has entered the mainstream, reshaping entire industries from education and software development to fundamental consumer behaviors.
jobs.description:
About Unconventional

Since 2022, AI has entered the mainstream, reshaping entire industries from education and software development to fundamental consumer behaviors. This revolution has created an unprecedented demand for computation - a demand that is now fundamentally limited by energy, not just in the datacenter, but at a global scale.

At Unconventional, our mission is to solve this. We are rethinking computing from the ground up to build a new foundation for AI that is 1000x more efficient. We're doing this by exploiting the rich physics of semiconductors, mapping neural networks directly to the device physics rather than relying on layers of inefficient abstraction.

The Role

As a Member of Technical Staff, System Modeling (Computation), you will be part of a hands-on R&D team building simulation frameworks that enable evaluation and rapid iteration across all layers of unconventional physics-based computing systems for machine learning workloads. “Extreme co-design” is our guiding principle.

System Modeling is a multi-disciplinary effort, and the team we’re building reflects that. The role involves development of physics-based system models, GPU-accelerated ML system simulations, and cross-layer system integration. You don’t need to be an expert in all of these, but you have to be very strong in at least one, and solid in the rest.

Responsibilities

You will be responsible for one or more of the following tasks:

  • Architecting Foundational Solvers: Building large-scale, GPU-accelerated, high-fidelity numerical differential equation solvers (ODE, SDE, CDE, PDE). You will build tools that enable rapid iteration, multiple architectures, and rich metrics/visualization, leveraging frameworks best suited for scientific ML (e.g., JAX, PyTorch, or custom CUDA/Triton kernels).
  • Bridging Physics and Machine Learning: Developing physics-based surrogate models of device- and system-level behavior in unconventional compute. You will create clean, composable abstractions that expose algorithm–hardware tradeoffs and enable cross-layer optimization via end-to-end autodiff.
  • Extreme Co-Design & Collaboration: Working closely with hardware and algorithm teams to understand their simulation needs, supporting everything from high-level algorithm development to the low-level verification of novel, analog hardware.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Education
    • MS/PhD in a quantitative field (AI/ML, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Applied Math), or BS with substantial, clear evidence of equivalent research/engineering depth.
  • Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) & Numerical Methods(replaces Dynamical computation knowledge)
  • Deep expertise in numerical differential equation solvers (e.g., ODE, SDE, DDE) and their implementation on parallel architectures (e.g., Rosenbrock methods, Euler-Maruyama, adjoint methods, implicit solvers).
  • Experience with high-performance, customized GPU kernel development for numerical methods, including GPU memory optimization and multi-GPU scaling.
  • Experience building effective neural network surrogate models (e.g., Neural ODEs) for complex dynamical systems.
  • ML and systems fluency
    • Solid understanding of modern AI/ML architectures and training/inference workflows.
    • Strong experience implementing and debugging ML models in PyTorch (preferred) or similar, with practical experience profiling, optimizing, and stabilizing non-trivial large-scale ML systems.

Preferred Qualifications

We are looking for well-rounded candidates. While the minimum qualifications focus on the core modeling and ML expertise, candidates who possess the following qualities will be the most impactful.

  • Software Engineering & API Craftsmanship
    • Exceptional Python engineering skills with a passion for Developer Experience (DX), elegant API design, strong typing, and composability.
    • Experience with compiler-friendly ML paradigms and internals (e.g., JAX vmap/pmap/jit, PyTorch autograd/torch.compile, custom XLA or Triton kernels).
    • A track record of building open-source tools, scientific libraries, or serious simulation/modeling frameworks from scratch.
  • Dynamic Systems Knowledge
    • Familiarity with analog dynamic systems, including transient responses, and nonidealities such as nonlinearity, quantization, random noise, and feedback/stability.
  • Systems Thinking
    • Demonstrated ability to reason across multiple layers of the stack: algorithm, software, compiler, runtime, and hardware.
    • Able to cleanly connect model architecture choices to system performance implications (memory bandwidth, communication patterns, latency, energy, and numerical stability).
    • Experience applying efficiency techniques natively within modeling frameworks (quantization, sparsity, pruning, distillation, kernel fusion, etc.).

Why Join Us?

  • The Mission: Redefine computing for the next 50 years by solving the fundamental energy limitation of AI at a global scale.
  • The Impact: Shape the company's future as a foundational team member. Enjoy massive ownership and an outsized opportunity to drive change.
  • The Challenge: Dive into deeply complex, intellectually stimulating, and unsolved problems at the cutting edge of multiple, converging fields.
  • The Perks: A comprehensive package including best-in-class health benefits, 401k matching, truly unlimited PTO, and complimentary meals when working from our Palo Alto office.

jobs.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Our Enterprise Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our top customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

This role is a remote position open to candidates residing in Germany. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

Will require travel to customer sites in Germany, The Netherlands and the United Kingdom, for up to 20% of the time, which may include overnight stays.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether a customer achieves their sustainability goals, or whether power gets restored quickly after an incident
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform
  • Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, and timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value
  • Orchestrate executive business reviews with our customers’ decision-makers and our executive leadership where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to get the most out of their Samsara products
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more
  • Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 4+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution
  • Fluency in German required

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
  • Experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies
  • Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.excerpt: POSITION SUMMARY: The RCM Transformation Senior Manager provides specialized depth and breadth of operational expertise across front, middle, and back-office Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) functions—including coding, charge capture/charge integrity, hospital and professional billing, cash posting, denials management, and accounts receivable follow-up.
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:


The RCM Transformation Senior Manager provides specialized depth and breadth of operational expertise across front, middle, and back-office Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) functions—including coding, charge capture/charge integrity, hospital and professional billing, cash posting, denials management, and accounts receivable follow-up. Reporting to the Senior Director of Finance Transformation, with a dotted-line relationship to the Executive Director of Revenue Cycle Transformation, this role serves as an internal subject matter expert for assigned RCM transformation initiatives / projects. Working independently, with guidance in only the most complex situations, the Senior Manager validates and stress-tests design recommendations against real-world operational conditions to ensure redesign decisions are practical, sustainable, and tailored to BMCHS's environment.

The RCM Transformation Senior Manager leads assigned workstreams and projects with moderate resources requirements, risk, and complexity within the RCM operating model redesign and helps build the financial case supporting the program's cost-to-collect and net revenue targets. This role's impact is realized through the successful redesign and stabilization of RCM operations over a multi-year horizon, positioning BMCHS for sustained financial and operational performance.


Position: Revenue Cycle Management Transformation Senior Manager

Department: Finance Administration

Schedule: Full Time


ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES / DUTIES:

  • Serve as RCM subject-matter expert. Serves as the revenue cycle operations subject-matter expert on assigned transformation workstreams, applying specialized knowledge of back- and middle-office RCM functions—including coding, charge capture, hospital and professional billing, cash posting, denials management, and AR follow-up—to validate current-state findings, stress-test recommendations, and ensure design decisions are operationally credible.
  • Support target operating model design Partners day-to-day with internal stakeholders and external consulting resources to benchmark current-state cost-to-collect and net revenue yield against industry standards, and to co-design the future-state target operating model, process workflows, and organizational structure for in-scope RCM functions.
  • Lead assigned transformation workstreams. Leads assigned RCM transformation workstreams of moderate complexity from current-state diagnostics through future-state design, pilot testing, and go-live, directing the day-to-day work of consulting resources and cross-functional contributors on an initiative basis without formal supervisory authority.
  • Build and maintain workstream financial models. Builds and maintains the financial and quantitative models to evaluate workstream impact, tracks benefit realization against the program's cost-to-collect reduction and net revenue uplift targets. Monitors operational metrics, identifies variances and recommends corrective actions to leadership.
  • Evaluate vendor and technology options. Evaluates outsourcing, managed-services, and technology/automation options (including AI and RPA) for in-scope back- and middle-office RCM functions, and contributes RCM subject-matter expertise to vendor selection and contracting discussions.
  • Drive change management and stakeholder alignment. Leads change management and stakeholder alignment across RCM operations, revenue cycle leadership, and Finance, translating recommendations into practical guidance for the operational teams affected by the redesign; leverages deep subject matter expertise to resolve operational conflicts and build consensus across RCM
  • Report progress to leadership. Prepares and presents progress updates, risk assessments, and analytical summaries on assigned workstreams to Finance and Revenue Cycle Transformation leadership and other stakeholders.

(The above statements in this job description are intended to depict the general nature and level of work assigned to the employee(s) in this job. The above is not intended to represent an exhaustive list of accountable duties and responsibilities required).


Disclaimer: Percentages are approximations used for job evaluation purposes. Actual time spent on specific duties may fluctuate based on operational needs and department priorities


JOB REQUIREMENTS


REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, healthcare administration, or a related field; and 8+ years of experience in revenue cycle operations, healthcare finance, or healthcare-focused strategy consulting, including hands-on experience in one or more back- or middle-office RCM functions (e.g., coding, billing, denials management, cash posting, or AR follow-up);or equivalent combination of education and experience.

PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • MBA, MHA, or other advanced degree; experience leading RCM transformation initiatives delivered in partnership with external consulting firms, including outsourcing/managed-services evaluation or AI/automation adoption; experience with Epic revenue cycle modules and reporting tools (e.g., Resolute HB/PB, Slicer Dicer, Cogito).

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS REQUIRED:

  • N/A

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS PREFERRED:

  • CRCR (Certified Revenue Cycle Representative), CHFP, or similar revenue cycle/healthcare finance certification.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES (KSAs):

  • Deep working knowledge of back- and middle-office revenue cycle functions—including coding, charge capture, hospital and professional billing, cash posting, denials management, and AR follow-up—and how they interact to drive cost to collect and net revenue.
  • Ability to partner effectively with external consulting teams, translating consulting frameworks and recommendations into operationally credible process and organizational designs.
  • Skill in building and interpreting financial models that quantify cost-to-collect and net revenue impact, and in tracking benefit realization against defined program targets.
  • Working knowledge of Epic revenue cycle modules and reporting tools sufficient to independently validate underlying data and findings.
  • Ability to operate independently and with sound judgment in ambiguous, fast-paced transformation environments, and to lead workstreams without formal authority over the teams involved.
  • Ability to build credibility and influence revenue cycle operations leaders and staff who are not direct reports, and strong written and oral communication skills sufficient to present complex findings to Finance and Revenue Cycle leadership.
  • Ability to apply structured project management methodology to plan, execute, and track complex, multi-workstream initiatives.

Compensation Range:

$97,500.00- $141,500.00

This range offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications. However, our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and a broad range of factors is considered when making an offer. This includes education, experience, skills, and certifications/licensures as they directly relate to position requirements; as well as business/organizational needs, internal equity, and market-competitiveness. In addition, BMCHS offers generous total compensation that includes, but is not limited to, benefits (medical, dental, vision, pharmacy), discretionary annual bonuses and merit increases, Flexible Spending Accounts, 403(b) savings matches, paid time off, career advancement opportunities, and resources to support employee and family well-being.

NOTE: This range is based on Boston-area data, and is subject to modification based on geographic location.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disabled/Veterans

We do not ask or require downloads of any applications, or “apps” job offers are not extended over text messages or social media platforms. jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe're looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead strategy and product direction for Printify Sales Experience — the merchant-success layer that helps merchants convert intent into real commercial activity and build the behaviors that drive sustainable growth.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead strategy and product direction for Printify Sales Experience — the merchant-success layer that helps merchants convert intent into real commercial activity and build the behaviors that drive sustainable growth.

Merchants don't need another dashboard telling them what already happened — they need a system that understands where they are, tells them what matters next, and helps them act. We're starting with new merchants, guiding them from onboarding and product creation through store launch on sales channels, first sale, and early GMV. Our merchant-success system spans AI-led onboarding, merchant intelligence, gamification, lifecycle interventions, sales channels expansions as well as connections to mentorship and community, and serves other segments and channels.

This is a product leadership role with company-level impact. You will manage a team of two product managers and drive outcomes across multiple squads and functions through product judgment, strategic clarity, and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into coordinated action.

Who You Are

A product leader who pairs systems thinking with strong commercial and execution judgment — equally comfortable in merchant research, funnel data, AI opportunities, and business cases. You can take an ambiguous question like "how do we materially grow merchant success?" and turn it into a problem model, KPI tree, and prioritized roadmap. You lead through influence, aligning Engineering, Design, Data, Lifecycle Marketing, Commercial, and leadership around a shared view of the problem, and you know when the answer is a new feature versus a platform capability, better intelligence, or not building at all.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy, Discovery & Business Ownership

  • Define and evolve Sales Experience's product strategy, owning the merchant-success problem end-to-end — activation, first sale, early GMV, retention — rather than a fixed feature set.

  • Set the North Star and KPI tree, and define how the journey should differ by merchant segment, starting with Shopify while architecting for reuse across other sales channels.

  • Build a deep understanding of why merchants progress or stall using research, behavioral data, cohort analysis, and experimentation; map the journey end-to-end and identify the highest-leverage interventions.

  • Continuously reprioritize — kill low-confidence ideas and make explicit trade-offs between near-term metric gains and capabilities that compound over time.

AI-Led Merchant Success

  • Shape how AI drives the Sales Hub experience: a context-aware system, not a generic assistant, that uses merchant, catalog, and behavioral data to guide next steps.

  • Explore and validate experiences such as personalized onboarding, next-best-action recommendations, and proactive interventions; define where gamification (missions, milestones, streaks) genuinely changes behavior versus adding superficial engagement.

  • Partner with Engineering, Data, and AI/ML on feasibility, cost, trust, and scalability, ensuring AI initiatives tie to measurable merchant and business outcomes rather than adoption for its own sake.

Cross-Domain Execution & Commercial Leadership

  • Translate strategy into phased initiatives with clear outcomes, scope, dependencies, and decision gates, driving alignment across Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, and Lifecycle before work starts.

  • Lead complex trade-offs without defaulting to escalation, and build post-launch discipline — measuring outcomes and deciding to scale, iterate, or stop.

  • Make data a decision-making tool: build rigorous understanding of funnels, cohorts, and economics, and define success metrics and instrumentation before development begins.

  • Connect product investment to commercial outcomes (GMV, retention, LTV) and be explicit about opportunity cost, including what not to pursue.

Organizational Leverage

  • Act as a trusted partner to senior leadership on merchant growth and AI strategy, bringing structure and evidence to ambiguous or contentious decisions.

  • Balance your own individual contribution with coaching and mentoring Product Managers, and create reusable frameworks so the organization gets better at solving merchant-success problems without depending on you for every decision.

What Success Looks Like

  • Sales Experience has a clear multi-year strategy, merchant segmentation, KPI tree, and prioritized roadmap that's understood across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and leadership.

  • More high-intent merchants progress from onboarding to first sale, early GMV, and continued activity including sales channel expansion, with measurable improvement in early cohort performance.

  • AI-driven guidance shows repeated, measurable value rather than novelty-driven usage, and becomes increasingly personalized by merchant intent, behavior, and stage.

  • Shopify proves the model, with successful capabilities becoming reusable across other channels.

  • Cross-team initiatives run with clear ownership and decision rights, and experiments consistently produce explicit decisions to scale, iterate, or stop.

  • Senior leaders rely on your judgment for merchant growth and investment decisions, and PMs grow through your coaching.

What You'll Bring

  • Extensive Product Management experience in high-growth SaaS, marketplace, e-commerce, creator economy, or platform businesses, with a track record of driving significant customer and commercial impact across complex, multi-squad domains.

  • Deep expertise in activation, onboarding, retention, growth loops, and experimentation, plus strong AI product judgment — able to distinguish real customer value from technology-led novelty.

  • Advanced analytical skills (funnels, cohorts, segmentation, KPI trees, opportunity sizing) and strong commercial judgment connecting product decisions to GMV, revenue, retention, or LTV.

  • Proven ability to operate in highly ambiguous problem spaces, think in systems, and lead cross-functionally — aligning senior stakeholders around difficult trade-offs.

  • Strong technical fluency to partner with Engineering, Data, and AI teams, plus excellent written and verbal communication for both executive and delivery audiences.

  • Demonstrated experience leading and coaching Product Managers, enabling them to succeed and grow.

  • A plus: background with Shopify, Etsy, TikTok Shop, or other merchant/seller-ecosystem platforms.

What we offer:

  • A global, inclusive team that’s as supportive as it is ambitious and serious about getting things done

  • An opportunity to work remotely or in a modern and welcoming office in Riga

  • Flexible working hours (start your day as late as 11 AM)

  • Private health insurance

  • 2 extra paid days off to focus on your mental or physical well-being

  • 1 extra paid day off to celebrate a Birthday or any other celebration of your choice

  • Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons, both on-site and online

  • Free and healthy lunch if you work from the Rīga office

  • Design and order your own merch using our platforms with an employee discount

  • Exciting team-building events and parties you’ll never forget!

FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience.

If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job.

Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team!

jobs.excerpt: job descriptionWe are modernizing a business-critical Payroll product where correctness matters.
jobs.description:
job description

We are modernizing a business-critical Payroll product where correctness matters. As part of this transformation, we are building quality engineering AI-first and automation-first from the beginning.

This is not a traditional manual QA role, and it is also not a conventional test-automation role where AI is simply used to work faster. We want to use AI as a core part of how we understand existing behaviour, create test coverage, generate and manage test data, identify gaps, analyse failures and continuously improve quality.

You will help establish this capability from the ground up.

your tasks

  • Build an AI-first, automation-first quality engineering approach for Payroll
  • Create automated regression coverage for existing and newly modernized Payroll capabilities
  • Use AI as the primary tool to discover, generate and continuously improve relevant test scenarios
  • Create characterization and golden-master style tests for existing behaviour that is not sufficiently protected today
  • Build automated API, integration and service-level testing
  • Establish AI-driven test-data management as a core capability:
    • generate realistic and controlled test data
    • create variations and edge cases
    • maintain reusable test-data sets
    • identify missing scenarios
    • manage data safely and reproducibly
  • Work with Payroll domain experts to translate complex business rules into automated, repeatable validation
  • Use AI to analyse existing system behaviour and identify regression risks
  • Use AI to analyse test failures, cluster defects and help identify likely root causes
  • Integrate automated quality controls and quality gates directly into the delivery process, making quality engineering part of development rather than a separate phase at the end

your profile

  • Several years of experience in QA automation, quality engineering or software testing, with a strong understanding of automated testing principles
  • Practical experience with API, integration and backend testing as well as CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates
  • Good scripting skills and the ability to automate repetitive technical tasks
  • Strong analytical thinking and the ability to understand complex business rules, working closely with engineers and domain experts
  • An automation-first mindset: repetitive validation is automated by default, not performed manually
  • An AI-first mindset: you naturally consider AI and automation when solving quality-engineering challenges.
  • Payroll knowledge is not required, you will work closely with experienced Payroll domain experts.
Mandatory: AI-first test data management
A core requirement of this role is the ability to use AI as a fundamental part of the quality strategy when creating and managing test data. This includes generating representative Payroll scenarios, producing controlled variants and edge cases, identifying gaps in existing test data, and maintaining reusable, deterministic data sets as business rules evolve, ensuring test data remains explainable and suitable for automated regression testing.

your benefits

  • Collaboration within an empathetic and supportive team
  • You can put your knowledge and personal strengths to good use, and continue to develop your skills and grow
  • You’ll start with a structured onboarding process and learn ‘on the job’, through training sessions or informal learning formats and working in interdisciplinary and international teams
  • You’ll have the opportunity to benefit from our hybrid work concept, which includes working in the office, from home, on the move and on workations
  • A modern tech stack and agile working methods are a given
  • A wide range of benefits, e.g. pension scheme, health management – right through to staff discounts
  • Well-behaved dogs are very welcome at all our locations

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Senior Bookkeeper / Accounting Operations Specialist to manage financial records and support accounting operations. You will be responsible for keeping the books accurate, reconciling 10+ accounts, managing vendor and customer payments, tracking trip profitability, and maintaining accurate financial and booking records. You will also help improve systems, reporting, and automation to reduce manual work. The role requires strong Xero, Excel and Google Sheets experience, along with the ability to work independently and handle confidential financial information.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting & Reconciliation

  • Perform monthly and quarterly reconciliations across 10+ bank, credit card, HubSpot and accounting accounts.
  • Review and categorize expenses in Xero.
  • Identify duplicate payments, missing transactions, unusual charges, and discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation.

Payments & Vendor Management

  • Track vendor and customer payments, outstanding balances, and payment status.
  • Coordinate domestic and international payments, including foreign currency transactions.
  • Manage payments through platforms such as Convera (GlobalPay).
  • Work with vendors, operators, and internal teams to resolve payment issues.

Trip Profitability & Reporting

  • Track gross and net margins by trip or flight.
  • Monitor trip-related costs including aircraft, catering, transportation, and other operational expenses.
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual expense and financial reports.
  • Maintain vendor variance and fixed-cost reports.
  • Provide management with clear reporting on expenses, margins, and payments.

CRM & Systems Management

  • Keep HubSpot deal stages and booking information up to date.
  • Maintain accurate trip details, pricing, invoicing, and payment status.
  • Reconcile HubSpot data with Xero and other financial records.
  • Organize financial documents and shared accounting folders.

Process Improvement

  • Build and maintain Excel and Google Sheets templates, dashboards, and reporting tools.
  • Use formulas, pivot tables, and data validation to improve reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive accounting and reporting tasks.
  • Improve processes to reduce manual work and prevent errors.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in bookkeeping, accounting operations, or financial analysis.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Xero, including reconciliation, expense coding, and reporting.
  • Experience reconciling 10+ accounts on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets skills, including XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, pivot tables, and data validation.
  • Experience handling international payments and foreign currency transactions.
  • Strong understanding of financial reporting and account reconciliation.
  • Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to handle confidential financial information.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Convera GlobalPay and international payment workflows.
  • Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM.
  • Experience in private aviation, charter, luxury travel, or hospitality.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based companies and USD accounting.
  • Experience building automated reports or workflows.
  • Xero Advisor Certification.
  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Remote & Availability Requirements

  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated, secure workspace.
  • Must be available during 9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET, Monday–Friday.
  • Occasional after-hours, weekend, or holiday availability is required for urgent matters such as operator payments, declined cards, or vendor issues affecting active flights.
  • Must be reachable by phone and able to respond promptly during urgent situations.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, you will be expected to learn the company's systems and vendor network, reconcile all 10+ accounts, align HubSpot records with the books, complete a monthly close, and deliver trip-level margin reporting.

Over time, you will help make the accounting and reporting process faster, more accurate, and more automated while providing leadership with reliable financial information for business decisions.

  1. AI Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Offer Stage

ABOUT GENERATION:

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have a 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

jobs.description:
Help Shape What AI Looks Like in Hospitality.

AI is changing how businesses operate. At Crescent Hotels & Resorts, we’re focused on something bigger than simply adopting new technology—we want to put AI to work solving real business problems across our hotels.

We are seeking a Regional Vice President of AI Enablement & Implementation to help turn that vision into reality.

This is an opportunity for a builder.

You’ll work alongside Crescent leaders, hotel operators, ownership partners, and functional experts to identify where AI can create meaningful value—and then help take those ideas from opportunity to solution to implementation to measurable results.

We aren’t looking for someone to simply tell us what AI could do.

We’re looking for someone who can help us make it happen.

What You’ll Build

Imagine helping create AI-enabled solutions that could:

  • Give a General Manager a daily “GM Pulse” that brings together revenue, labor, cost, guest satisfaction, and operational signals into one actionable briefing.
  • Help a sales team qualify an inbound RFP and develop a tailored group proposal in a fraction of the time.
  • Optimize hotel labor schedules against forecasted demand to reduce overtime, overstaffing, and unnecessary contract labor.
  • Automate repetitive accounting processes, reconciliations, cash-flow forecasting, and reporting.
  • Monitor F&B inventory and purchasing patterns to identify waste and over-ordering.
  • Help recruiting teams source, screen, schedule, and communicate with candidates more efficiently.
  • Turn financial, STR, guest satisfaction, revenue, and operating data into recurring ownership and investor reporting.
  • Make it easier for hotel associates and leaders to find information, make decisions, and spend less time on administrative work.

And those are just the opportunities we see today.

A major part of your role will be helping us discover what we haven’t thought of yet.

What You’ll Do

You’ll help establish and execute the AI roadmap for a designated portfolio of Crescent-managed hotels, identifying the opportunities with the greatest potential business impact.

You’ll work across Operations, Commercial, Revenue Management, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Human Resources, and Technology to understand how work gets done today—and where AI, automation, data, or process redesign can make it better.

You’ll help determine whether the right solution should be built, bought, configured, or integrated, and you’ll lead initiatives beyond the idea stage through implementation, adoption, measurement, and optimization.

You’ll partner closely with Crescent’s technology teams around systems, integrations, data, security, and governance while helping operators translate business challenges into practical AI-enabled solutions.

Most importantly, you’ll make sure the solutions we introduce actually get used.

Because successful AI transformation isn’t measured by how many pilots we launch.

It’s measured by what changes because of them.

Who We’re Looking For

You understand AI—but you think like a business leader.

You naturally start with:

“What problem are we trying to solve?”

Then you determine whether AI, automation, data, process redesign—or some combination—is the right answer.

You’re comfortable discussing strategy with executives one moment and sitting with an operator to understand a manual process the next.

You understand technologies such as generative AI, AI agents, workflow automation, APIs, data integration, and emerging AI platforms, but you don’t believe technology is the objective.

Business impact is.

You know how to build a business case, evaluate technology and vendors, lead cross-functional implementation, drive organizational adoption, and measure ROI.

Hospitality experience would be valuable, but we’re also interested in leaders who have successfully driven AI or digital transformation in other complex, multi-unit businesses.

What Success Looks Like

Your work should ultimately help Crescent and our hotels achieve measurable outcomes:

More revenue.

Better productivity.

Smarter labor deployment.

Faster decision-making.
Less administrative work.
Better guest experiences.
More empowered associates.
And demonstrable ROI from AI investments.

Why Crescent?

At Crescent Hotels & Resorts, hospitality is a people business—and we believe technology should make our people better at what they do, not take away from the human experience that defines great hospitality.

This role offers the opportunity to help shape our approach to AI at an important moment in its evolution.

You won’t be stepping into a mature AI program and maintaining someone else’s roadmap.

You’ll help build it.

If you are energized by the opportunity to turn emerging technology into practical solutions, challenge how work gets done, and help shape the future of AI in hospitality, we’d like to hear from you.

ITC Federal, LLC (ITC) connects technology advancements in automation and AI, customer experience, and financial services to solve government mission challenges, enabling smoother operational efficiency and bolstering national security. We leverage the latest technology innovations and proven approaches to better serve the mission and support the DHS, DOJ, and DoW workforce, customers, and programs, regardless of scale or complexity. We are seeking an experienced Courtroom Presentation Specialist to support ITC Federal’s work for the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) under the anticipated MEGA 6 automated litigation support (ALS) program. This is a fully remote position supporting DOJ’s complex litigation mission.

Important: This opening is being established in connection with the MEGA 6 contract vehicle award itself. ITC Federal must still be awarded individual task orders under the vehicle before employees can be onboarded. Accordingly, this position is full-time and contingent upon both contract award and the award of the applicable task order.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Works with the trial team, including expert witnesses, to develop plans for trial or hearings using a courtroom presentation system.

PROGRAM CONTEXT:

This position supports the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) under the anticipated MEGA 6 procurement. MEGA 6 is expected to continue DOJ’s multiple-award contract vehicle for automated litigation support (ALS) services, following the structure of the MEGA 5 contract. These contracts are designed to provide DOJ offices, boards, divisions, and other federal agencies with information technology, professional services, and litigation support tools to manage complex legal proceedings efficiently.

Responsibilities

jobs.title: Consultant - Finance Track - Evergreen - All Levels
jobs.excerpt: The Role We are looking for a Finance Consultant to join our Consulting Services team.
jobs.description:
The Role

We are looking for a Finance Consultant to join our Consulting Services team. As an evergreen posting, we hire across experience levels, prioritizing the right match for our team. If you have a strong Deltek Finance background and you are looking for a place to do good work with good people, we want to hear from you regardless of where you are in your career.

Finance Consultants at FSP work with clients to implement, configure, and optimize Deltek Vision and Vantagepoint Finance modules. You will be a trusted advisor to your clients - the person they call when they need to understand how their system works, why something is not working the way they expected, or how to get more out of their investment. You will manage engagements, build relationships, and deliver implementations that actually stick.

The right candidate for this role understands project-based accounting, knows their way around the Deltek Finance suite, and is comfortable being in front of clients. We can help with all the rest.

What You Will Do

Lead Client Implementations

You will work with clients to implement and configure Deltek Finance modules - from initial scoping and discovery through go-live and beyond. That means running sessions, making configuration decisions, managing scope, keeping projects on schedule, and making sure clients understand the tool when you are done.

Build Real Client Relationships

Our clients are not tickets in a queue - they are ongoing relationships. You will be the person they trust to tell them the truth about their system, help them think through a decision, and get them unstuck when something is not working. At more senior levels, you will manage those relationships at the executive level and serve as an escalation point for the broader team.

Contribute to the Practice

We are a small firm, which means that everybody contributes. What that might look like is: mentoring less-experienced colleagues, contributing to internal knowledge resources, participating in proposals and scoping conversations, and occasionally representing FSP at conferences or webinars. The more senior you are, the more of this you do - but even at the Staff level, you are a contributor, not just an attendee.

Grow in the Direction That Fits You

We have built out formal tracks for Finance, CRM, and Development consulting because we want people to be able to grow in the direction that plays to their strengths. If you are interested in developing a specialty in Resource Planning, a particular Finance module, or even in bridging into development work on the technical side of Deltek, there is a path for that here. We do not hand you a career plan on day one, but we take development seriously and we build structure around it.

What You Bring

We hire across experience levels, so not everything below is required at every level. What we are always looking for is solid Deltek Finance knowledge, a genuine comfort with client work, and the kind of professional judgment that comes from real-world experience.

The Foundations

  • Experience with Deltek Vision or Vantagepoint in a Finance or accounting role - either as a consultant or as a power user on the client side.
  • Working knowledge of project-based accounting concepts - billing, revenue recognition, GL structure, and how those things live inside Deltek.
  • Comfort working directly with clients - you can run a meeting, manage a difficult conversation, and keep a project moving without constant oversight.
  • Clear written and verbal communication - you can explain a complex configuration decision in plain English to someone who does not live in the system.
  • A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field - or the kind of hands-on experience that makes the degree irrelevant.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience delivering Deltek implementations as a consultant, not just as an end user.
  • Depth in specific Finance modules - billing, multi-company, revenue generation, project reporting, or any of the specialized modules in the Deltek suite.
  • Experience writing proposals, scoping engagements, or managing a client portfolio.
  • A track record of mentoring colleagues.
  • Any exposure to Deltek's development-adjacent tools - custom UDICs, workflows, or BI reporting - is a genuine differentiator.

Experience Levels

We are intentionally hiring across a range of experience levels. Here is a rough guide to how we think about each:

Staff

1-5 years of Deltek Finance experience. You work under the guidance of more senior consultants and are building toward independent delivery. You know the system and you are ready to apply that knowledge in a client-facing consulting role.

Senior

5-7 years of experience, including at least 2 years in a consulting delivery role. You lead implementations for less complex clients independently, manage the client relationship, and are starting to draft proposals and mentor Staff Consultants.

Principal

7-10 years of experience, with 3 or more years in consulting. You lead complex engagements independently, own executive-level client relationships, and contribute meaningfully to proposals, business development, and staff mentoring.

Senior Principal

10+ years of experience, with deep expertise across the Deltek Finance suite. You lead the firm's most demanding engagements, help shape how we deliver, and play an active role in developing the next generation of consultants at FSP.

Compensation

We offer competitive salaries based on experience and level, with a discretionary bonus program. The range for this role is $75,000 to $140,000 depending on experience, with bonus on top of that.

We believe in paying people well and giving them the flexibility and autonomy to do their best work.

Benefits

We offer a benefits package that matches or exceeds what larger firms can offer.

  • Health insurance - FSP covers 100% of your individual premium and 50% of dependent coverage in our most popular plan, but offer multiple UnitedHealthcare plan options including HSA-eligible plans. Coverage begins the first of the month following your hire date.
  • 401(k) with match - company matches 100% on the first 3% of your contribution and 50% on the next 2%, for an effective 4% match on the first 5% you put in. Eligible after 3 months.
  • PTO - up to 160 hours per year in your first five years, 200 hours after that. Available after your 90-day probationary period. Plus 8 paid holidays and 16 hours of paid volunteer time annually.
  • Equipment allowance - up to $250/month reimbursement for phone, internet, and cell service for roles with travel and demo requirements.
  • Flexible schedule - fully remote with flexible hours. We care about the work getting done well, not when you start your day.
  • Dental and vision, life insurance, short and long-term disability, FSA, EAP, and voluntary supplemental coverage also available.

Life at Full Sail Partners

Fully Remote, Actually

We do not have a headquarters that everyone is quietly expected to commute to. We are a remote-first company and have been for a long time. Some client work requires travel, and we will be upfront about what that looks like for this role - but your day-to-day is yours to manage from wherever you work best.

Small Enough to Matter

At FSP, you are not a resource in a staffing model. You are a person with a name, a reputation, and a direct line to leadership. When you do good work, people notice. When you have an idea, you can say it out loud and expect a response. We are intentionally the kind of firm where your contribution is visible.

Depth Over Breadth

We focus on Deltek. That is it. We are not trying to be everything to everyone - we are trying to be the best Deltek partner our clients have ever worked with. That means our consultants develop real depth in a specific platform, with real clients who have real problems, and they build expertise that is genuinely valuable in the market.

Growth That Reflects Your Strengths

We have built formal career tracks because we think people deserve to know what advancement looks like and what is expected of them at each level. But beyond the titles, we try to find ways for people to grow in the direction that fits them - whether that is deeper technical expertise, client leadership, or something in between. If you are someone who grows, we will find ways to make room for it.

How to Apply

If this sounds like a place you want to work, we would like to hear from you, Using the 'Apply' option above, submit your information to us.

We review applications on a rolling basis. Because this is an evergreen position, response time may vary - but we read everything and we will follow up if there is a fit.

Full Sail Partners is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.description:
Who we are

At CloudFactory, we are a mission-driven team passionate about unlocking the disruptive potential of AI for the world. By combining advanced technology with a global network of talented experts, we make unusable data usable and inference reliable and trustworthy, driving real-world business value at scale.

More than just a workplace, we're a global community founded on strong relationships and the belief that meaningful work transforms lives. Our commitment to earning, learning, and serving fuels everything we do, as we strive to connect one million people to meaningful work and build leaders worth following.

Our culture

At CloudFactory, we believe in building a workplace where everyone feels empowered, valued, and inspired to bring their authentic selves to work. We are:

  • Mission-driven: we focus on creating economic and social impact.
  • People-centric: we care deeply about our team's growth, well-being, and sense of belonging.
  • Innovative: we embrace change and find better ways to do things, together.
  • Globally connected: we foster collaboration between diverse cultures and perspectives.

About the Project

We are looking for native or near-native Malay and Tamil speakers in Singapore to contribute to a short-term speech data collection project supporting the development of AI and speech technologies.

You will record short spoken audio clips based on provided scripts and conversational scenarios. Topics will include everyday conversations, consumer banking interactions, and health-related scenarios.

This is not simply a read-the-script exercise. The recordings should sound natural and conversational, and some prompts may need to be rephrased while preserving their intended meaning.

The expected scope is approximately 2–3 hours of final, accepted audio per speaker, made up of short clips generally lasting 5–20 seconds.

What You'll Do

  • Record short audio clips in Malay or Tamil based on provided scripts and scenarios.
  • Deliver natural, conversational speech using authentic pronunciation, pacing, tone, pauses, and expressions.
  • Follow the project's audio quality, privacy, and recording guidelines.

Requirements

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Are a native or near-native speaker of Malay or Tamil.
  • Were born and raised in Singapore or have spent most of your life in Singapore.
  • Speak Malay or Tamil naturally in a way that reflects how the language is commonly used in Singapore.
  • Can make scripted content sound natural and conversational rather than simply reading it aloud.
  • Have strong pronunciation and verbal communication skills.
  • Can follow detailed instructions and maintain consistency across recordings.
  • Are comfortable contributing voice recordings to a dataset intended for AI/model training and commercial use.

Experience in voice-over, dubbing, theatre, broadcasting, podcasting, presenting, content creation, or similar voice-based work is strongly preferred.

Recording Requirements

You will need access to a quiet, controlled recording environment and suitable equipment capable of producing high-quality WAV audio.

Recordings must be delivered raw and unprocessed. Noise suppression, audio enhancement, compression, EQ, voice transformation, pitch shifting, AI cleanup, or other post-processing must not be applied.

Detailed technical and recording instructions will be provided before recording begins.

Voice Sample

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to provide approximately one minute of raw, unprocessed voice recordings.

The sample will help us assess naturalness, pronunciation, audio quality, recording environment, and suitability for the project.

AI-generated speech, text-to-speech, voice cloning, or voice conversion may not be used to produce any recordings.

Lead Unity SDK Engineer

About LoopMe

LoopMe is an AI company solving one of advertising’s hardest problems: making brand advertising actually measurable — and making it perform. Our platform runs patented machine learning models across billions of consumer signals in real time, optimising campaigns toward outcomes like purchase intent, brand lift, and foot traffic rather than proxy metrics like clicks. The result is 2–5x better performance than industry benchmarks, at scale.

We operate a high-load programmatic infrastructure — processing millions of ad requests per second with sub-200ms response times globally. This isn’t a layer on top of someone else’s stack; it’s built from the ground up, in-house, by the team you’d be joining. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in London, we now have 400+ people across 19 cities and have sustained 40% revenue CAGR since 2018. The engineering problems here are real, the ownership is genuine, and the scale is significant.

The opportunity

You’ll own the entire Unity product surface at LoopMe — the SDK layer that bridges our native iOS and Android products into the Unity ecosystem for game and app developers. You’ll have full architectural autonomy over how our Unity packages are designed, tested, and shipped, working closely with our iOS, Android, and QE teams to keep native and Unity experiences in lockstep. This role reports to the VP Engineering, SDK

What you’ll do

  • Own and operate the entire Unity product surface, with full architectural autonomy and per-platform customisation.
  • Build and manage open source publishing for LoopMe’s Unity packages, applying licensing best practices.
  • Establish and run CI/CD pipelines for the Unity product surface.
  • Drive parity between native iOS and Android platforms through proactive cross-team collaboration.
  • Build generic, reusable tooling that Unity packages across the SDK portfolio can share.
  • Develop and maintain LoopMe’s Unity validator app.
  • Manage Unity license administration across the SDK organisation.
  • Partner with QE on cross-platform testing and support integration partners with clear SDK documentation.

What you’ll bring

Essential:

  • Experience across cross-platform mobile and SDK development — iOS, Android, and Unity — including dependency resolution and wrapping native code and binaries inside Unity.
  • Strong architectural background in modular Unity SDK design: dependency injection, bridging native iOS/Android SDKs into Unity through C/C++, and building Unity Editor tooling.
  • Proficiency in C#, Kotlin, Swift, and Objective-C++.
  • A track record publishing and maintaining open source software, with working knowledge of licensing and distribution through NPM, NuGet, and Unity Package Manager.
  • Working knowledge of privacy and consent frameworks used in ad tech — GDPR, CCPA, TCF, GPP, COPPA, CMPs, and App Tracking Transparency.

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with ad tech industry practices and client-server architecture patterns.
  • Experience with CI/CD and build tooling such as GitHub Actions, Fastlane, Gradle, or Bazel.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Technical Product Experience Specialist to ensure Military Community and Family Policy (MC&FP) products are useful, usable, feasible, accessible, testable, and aligned to the intended experience before they move through delivery. The role supports the Service Design & Experience team under the MODES III contract. This role serves as a critical integration point between user and service experience strategy and technical product delivery, helping translate research, design intent, stakeholder needs, and business requirements into actionable product requirements and measurable digital experiences.

Working under the Strategic Design and Experience Lead (SDEL), the Technical Product Experience Specialist collaborates across Task 2 Outreach and Engagement and Task 3 IT, Cybersecurity, and Data Operations to maintain alignment between experience objectives and technical execution. The role works closely with UX researchers and designers, experience strategists, architects, product and development teams, QA/test personnel, data and analytics teams, and Government stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.

The Technical Product Experience Specialist supports product visioning and roadmapping, requirements definition, backlog refinement, user stories and acceptance criteria, design-to-development handoffs, release readiness, and post-release evaluation. The role brings sufficient technical experience to understand software delivery, system dependencies, integration considerations, and implementation tradeoffs while maintaining a strong focus on user needs and desired experience outcomes.

Accessibility and inclusive design are embedded throughout this role. The Technical Product Experience Manager ensures Section 508, WCAG, usability, responsive design, and other experience-quality requirements are incorporated early into product definition and acceptance criteria rather than treated solely as downstream compliance activities.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Serve as a product management and technical integration resource within the Service Design & Experience team, supporting the SDEL in translating experience strategy and design intent into executable digital product requirements.
  • Bridge Task 2 experience, research, content, and engagement activities with Task 3 product, application development, architecture, data, CMS, API, DevSecOps, QA/testing, and other technical capabilities.
  • Translate user research, journey maps, service-design findings, analytics, stakeholder requirements, and strategic objectives into clear product requirements, capabilities, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable experience outcomes.

  • Evaluate technical feasibility, system dependencies, integration considerations, and implementation constraints in partnership with architects, engineers, developers, cybersecurity, and other technical SMEs.
  • Identify and communicate tradeoffs among user needs, business and mission requirements, accessibility, technical feasibility, security and privacy considerations, delivery constraints, and desired experience outcomes.

  • Use user feedback, usability findings, product analytics, digital performance measures, customer-support insights, and other available data to identify opportunities for product optimization and continuous improvement.
  • Maintain product and experience documentation needed to support decision-making, requirements traceability, knowledge transfer, and continuity across Task 2 and Task 3 teams.

Product Researcher

Pathstream | Product & Design | Remote

ROLE / DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW

Pathstream is seeking a Product Researcher to uncover insights that help us improve our product, expand our business, and progress towards our mission. This role will sit within our Product & Design department and will work closely with product managers, designers, and teams across the company.

We believe that building a successful product and business today requires being highly intentional about understanding our clients and users and how we can best serve them. This role will drive that forward and thus empower all of the teams building the product at Pathstream.

WHAT WE DO

Pathstream was founded on the premise that substantial unrealized economic and human potential exists within each organization's frontline workforce. We are reshaping the way employees and managers on the frontlines excel in their careers. In this age of rapid tech evolution, our enterprise partnerships transform frontline teams from transactional to relational, and from task-oriented to strategic.

We impact companies' bottom lines with improved productivity, increased retention, and differentiated quality of customer experience — while employees experience greater success in their current roles and unlock future professional growth.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

The Product Researcher role will work cross-functionally to build our knowledge about our market, users, and more.

As Product Researcher, you'll be accountable for building and maintaining our pipeline of subject matter expert advisors, running a variety of research studies that inform product and curriculum decisions (ranging from landscape scans to usability tests), and keeping our research operations organized so that findings are accessible to the team.

You'll work with our Product and Design teams to ground feature decisions in real user behavior, running studies that inform what gets built and validating it once it ships. You’ll also work with our Learning Experience Design team to help ensure courses teach the skills that matter to our clients, translating research findings into curriculum priorities. You’ll also support our GTM teams to surface intel that will help diagnose client needs and address pain points.

RESEARCH AND ANALYSIS

  • Plan, conduct, and synthesize research, including:

DATA ANALYST/PROGRAMMER

Department: Implementation Services

Reports to: Manager of Data Operations

Division: Remote
